details.body: Each, a. sarvaM, sakala; gen. ex. by prati-anu in comp., or by repetition of word; dine dine, pratidinaM, &c.; ‘all went away, e(ach) to his own house’ ekEkaH svaM svaM gfhaM nirjagAma; ‘e(ach) one’ ekEka a.; ekEkaSaH, pfTak pfTak; ‘e(ach) other’ anyonyaM, itaretaraM, parasparaM.

EACH: v. Every. Ph.: went e. to his own house: svaM svaM DAma jagmatuH, B. p.; e. of these: ezAmekEkam, K.; gave one code to e.: ekEkAM saMhitAmekEkasmE dadO, B. p.: v. Everybody; we are ashamed of e. other: anyonyasya jihnImaH, Ki. v.: One another.

EACH , a. (All) sarvvaH -rvvA -rvvaM, viSvaH -SvA -SvaM, sakalaH -lA -laM; ‘Each’ is usually expressed by prati or anu prefixed; as, ‘each day,’ pratidinaM, pratidivasaM, anudinaM, anvahaM; ‘each night,’ pratirAtraM; ‘each month,’ pratimAsaM; ‘each one,’ pratyekaM. ‘Or by doubling the word; as,’ ‘each day,’ dine dine, divase divase, aharahaH; ‘in each house,’ gfhe gfhe; ‘each one,’ ekEkaH -kA -kaM, ekEkaSas, pfTak pfTak; ‘each other,’ parasparaM -rAM, anyonyaM, itaretaraM; ‘each [Page215-a+ 51] man,’ ekEkajanaH, pratijanaM; ‘in each direction,’ pratidiSaM, sarvvadikzu; ‘each man related his own dream,’ ekEko janaH svaM svaM svapnam akaTayat.

Eager, a. (Of persons) utsuka, lAlasa, lolupa, atyAkAMkzin, vyagra, sotkaMWaM, Asakta, rata, sotsAha. 2 gAQa, prabala, utkawa, pracaMqa, sAtiSaya; tIvra, tIkzRa; oft. ex. by uttam 4 P, (uttAmyati me hfdayaM taddarSanAya Ka. 349). [Eager]ly, adv. saspfhaM, satfzRaM; sotkaMWaM, kutUhalAt, ativAMCayA, utkawaM. [Eager]ness, s. lAlasA; OtsukyaM, utsAhaH, atispfhA-vAMCA, utkawatA, vyagratA, kutUhalaM, kOtukaM.

EAGER: I Desirous:(1) lAlasaH (sA, saM) (best equiv.), e. to see Śiva: ISAnasaMdarSanalAlasaH (sA, saM), Ku.;(2) lolupaH (pA, paM), e. for an embrace: ASlezalolupaH (pA, paM), Si.II Impe- -tuous, fervent:(1) vyagraH (grA, graM);(2) utsukaH (kA, kaM), the spring is very e.: paryutsuka eza mADavaH, Ku.III Brittle: q. v.

EAGER , a. atIcCaH -cCA -cCaM, atyaBilAzI -ziRI -zi (n), atyAkAMkzI -kziRI -kzi (n), kutUhalI -linI -li (n), kOtUhalAnvitaH -tA -taM, vyagraH -grA -graM, utsukaH -kA -kaM, tIkzRaH -kzRA -kzRaM, saraBasaH -sA -saM, udyuktaH -ktA -ktaM, sacezwaH -zwA -zwaM, vyavasitaH -tA -taM, AsaktaH -ktA -ktaM, avasaktaH -ktA -ktaM, rataH -tA -taM, utkaH -tkA -ktaM, SIGrakarmmA -rmmA -rmma (n), uccaRqaH -RqA -RqaM, pracaRqaH -RqA -RqaM, uttapnaH -ptA -ptaM.
EAGERLY: (1) saspfham (= longingly);(2) satfzRam (= thirstily);(3) sotsAham (= zealously); (4) vyagram (= impetuously).
EAGERLY , adv. atyaBilAzeRa, atIcCayA, atimpfhAtas, kOtUhalena, kutUhalAt, kOtukena, ativAYCayA, IhAtas, satEkzRyaM, saraBasaM, vyavasitaM.
EAGERNESS: I Eager desire:(1) lAlasA;(2) tfzRA (= thirst).II Impetuosity: vyagratA. III Zeal: utsAhaH.

EAGERNESS , s. kOtUhalaM, kutUhalaM, kOtukaM, atyaBilAzaH, atispfhA, ativAYCA, atiSayecCA, tEkzRyaM, tIkzRatA, uttApaH, uccaRqatA, pracaRqatA, vyagratA, OtsukyaM, udyogaH, prOQiH f., raBasaH, AgrahaH, gardDaH, upmaH.
Eagle, s. garutmat m., utkroSaH; See Garuda; ‘e(agle) eyed’ sUkzmadfzwi.
EAGLE: prob. KawvANgaH of Mat.; pakziviSezaH.
EAGLE , s. utkroSaH, kuraraH -rA -rI, gfDraH, KaraH, samutkroSaH, pakzirAjaH, rAjapakzI m. (n).
EAGLE-EYED: gfDradfS (mfn.) or -dfzwi (mfn.).
EAGLE-EYED , a. utkroSadfzwiH -zwiH -zwi, sUkzmadfzwiH -zwiH -zwi.
EAGLE-STONE: upalOhaviSezaH.
EAGLET: KawvANgaSAvakaH (?).
EAGLET , s. utkroSaSAvakaH, kuraraSAvakaH, utkroSapotakaH, kuraraSiSuH m.

Ear, s. karRaH, kzotraM, Sruti f., SravaRaM; SravaH, SabdagrahaH, ‘outer e(ar)’ SrutimaMqalaM-vezwanaM; ‘lobe of e(ar)’ karRapAli f.; ‘root of e(ar)’ karRa-mUlaM, karRajAhaM; ‘tip of e(ar)’ SravaRapAli-lI f.; ‘having the e(ar)s pricked’ stabDakarRa; ‘give e(ar)’ attend to q. v.; ‘he has his lordʼs e(ar)’ sa BarturviSraMBasTAnaM-viSvAsaBUmiH; ‘e(ar)-ache’ karRaSUlaH-laM; ‘e(ar)-drop’ karRapUraH; ‘e(ar)-lap’ karRapAliH, karRaSazkulI; ‘e(ar) pick’ karRakaMqUyanakaH; ‘e(ar)-ring’ karRAvataMsaH, kuM-qalaM; karRaBUzaRaM, karRikA, uttaMsaH; ‘e(ar) shot’ karRa-SravaRa-gocaraH-vizayaH; ‘be within e(ar)-shot’ SravaRagocare tizWa; ‘e(ar)-wax’ karRa-malaM, piMjUzaH ‘e(ar)-witness’ SrutasAkzin m. ‘e(ar)-wig’ karRakIwaH-jalUkA. 2 SIrzakaM; kaRiSaM maMjarI.

EAR (subs.): I Of animals:(1) karRaH, to come to one's e.s: karRapaTam AyAti, Sa.; to shut the e.: karRO pidaDAti, M.; to lend an e.: karRaM dadAti, Sa.; to whisper into one's e: karRe kaTayati, Mu.; the boring of the e. s (a religious ceremony) karRaveDaH; the root of an e.: karRamUlam, R., or karRAntaH. R., or karRajAham, B.; the middle e. or drum of the e.: karRakUpaH, N.;(2) Srotram, e. -enchanting: Srotra- hArin (f. RI), K.;(3) SrutiH, being of the same name to the e.: SruteH sanAmnaH, Mu. Ph.: the tip of an e.: pAliH; the outer e.: SazkulI, C. s. [Page227] II Of other objects: perh. karRaH.III Of corn:(1) kaRiSa (mn.);(2) SasyamaYjarI.

EAR , s. karRaH, SrotraM, SrutiH f., SravaH -vaRaM, SrotaH n. (s), SravaRapaTaH, SabdagrahaH, DvanigrahaH, SabdADizWAnaM, pEYjUzaH, kuharaM. — (Organ of hearing) SravaRendriyaM; ‘outer ear,’ SrutimaRqalaM, vezwanaM; ‘tip of the ear,’ pAliH f.; ‘lobe of the ear,’ karRalatikA; ‘root of the ear,’ SrutimUlaM, karRajAhaM; ‘hollow of the ear,’ SravaRodaraM; ‘ringing in the ear,’ karRanAdaH, karRakzveqaH; ‘boring the ear,’ karRaveDaH; ‘having the ears pricked up,’ stabDakarRaH -rRA -rRaM; ‘this noise splits the ear,’ ayaM SabdaH SrutiM Cinatti; ‘he gives ear,’ karRaM dadAti. — (Ear of corn) kaRiSaH -SaM, DAnyaSIrzakaM, SasyamaYjarI. — (Handle) karRaH, vAraNgaH.
EAR LAP: karRapAliH.
EAR-ACHE: karRaSUlam, Sr., creates a bad man's e.: upajanayati SravaRasTitaM SUlamaBavyasya, K.
EAR-ACHE , s. karRaSUlaM, karRavedanA, karRavyaTA.
EAR-BORED , a. vidDakarRaH -rRI -rRaM, CidritakarRaH -rRI -rRaM, CinnakarRaH -rRI -rRaM.
EAR-BORER , s. karRaveDanikA -nI, karRArA.
EAR-LESS: (1) akarRaH (rRA, rRaM);(2) karRahInaH (nA, naM); and sim. comp.s.
EAR-MARK: I Lit.: karRacihnam.II Any mark: cihnam.
EAR-PICK , s. karRakaRqUyanakaH, karRanirGarzaRakaH, karRaSoDanI.
EAR-PIERCING , a. karRaveDI -DinI -Di (n), karRaBedI -dinI -di (n).
EAR-RING: (1) kuRqalam, gold e.: kAYcanakuRqalam, Si.;(2) karRapAlI;(3) karRikA;(4) karRaBUzaRam; (5) karRavezwanam.

EAR-RING , s. kuRqalaM, karRikA, avataMsaH, karRAlaNkAraH, karRAlaNkftiH f., karRABaraRaM, karRavezwanaM, karRavezwakaM, karRenduH f., uttaMsaH, karRAnduH f., tuzwuH m.; ‘wearing ear-rings,’ kuRqalI -linI -li (n), kuRqalaDArI -riRI -ri (n), avataMsitaH -tA -taM.
EAR-SHOT: karRavizayaH; karRagocaraH; and sim. comp.s.
EAR-SHOT , s. karRagocaraH -rA -raM, karRavizayaH -yA -yaM, SrudiparyyantaM.
EAR-TRUMPET: *karRanAdinI.
EAR-WAX: (1) karRamalaH;(2) karRagUTam;(3) tokmam.
EAR-WAX , s. karRamalaH -laM, karRagUTaH, karRaviw f. (z), tokmaM, vAruRqaH -RqaM.
EAR-WIG: karRakIwI (?).
EAR-WIG , s. karRakIwI, karRajalUkA, karRajalOkA f. -kAH f. (s), karRadunduBiH f.
EAR-WITNESS , s. SrutasAkzI m. (n), svakarRena SrutvA sAkzyaM dadAti yaH.
EARDROP: karRapUraH (?): v. Ear-ring.
EARED: I Having ears:(1) karRin (f. nI); (2) karRavat (f. tI);(3) karRilaH (lA, laM).II Spiked: maYjaritaH (tA, taM).
EARED , a. (Having ears) karRI -rRinI -rRi (n), karRavAn -vatI -vat (t), karRilaH -lA -laM, -rRikaH -kA -kaM. — (Having spikes) maYjaritaH -tA -taM, sakaRiSaH -SA -SaM.
EARL: upADiviSezaH; *upanAyakaH. E. dom: *upanAya- katvam.
EARL , s. kulInapadAnAM maDye tftIyapadaBAk m. (j), tftIyakulInapadasTaH.
EARLAP , s. karRapAliH f., SravaRapAliH f., karRalatikA, karRaSazkulI.
EARLDOM , s. tftIyakulInapadaM, tftIyakulInapadasTitasya ADipatyaM or aDikAraH.

EARLINESS , s. SIGratA, kzipratA, avilambaH, pUrvvatvaM, prAktvaM, prAgBAvaH, agratvaM, pratyagratvaM, sadyastvaM, aciratvaM. — (Early maturity) prAgvi- -hitakAlAt pakvatA or pariRatatvaM. — (Of the day) supraBAtaM, atipraBAtaM, atipratyUzaH

Early, a. Adya, praTama, pUrva. 2 acira, sadyaska, pratyagra, aBinava, nUtana. 3 akAla, apUrRakAla, AkAlika (kI f.), anavasara-pariRata or pakva. 4 prAtaHkAlIna, pUrvAhRatana-pragetana (nI f.), vi-pra-BUtIya, uzasya, Ozasa (sI f.), praBAta-prAtaH in comp. adv. prAtar, pratyuzasi, pratyUze; viBAte, prAtaHkAle, praBAte, vyuzwe, prage; ‘e(arly) in the morning’ mahati pratyUze; ‘getting up e(arly)’ laGulaGUtTita. 2 sadyaH, SIGraM, satvaraM, ASu, sapadi. 3 pUrvaM, agre, prAk. [Early]ness, s. pUrvatvaM, agratvaM. 2 pratyagratA, aciratvaM. 3 akAlatA, akAlapariRati f. 4 supraBAtaM. 5 kzipratA, avilaMbaH, SIGratA.

EARLY (adj.): I Commencing: Ph.: e. drops of rain: varzAgrabindavaH, Me.; in the e. part of the day: divasasyAdyaBAge, Dak.; e. twilight: agrasanDyA, Sa.; e. youth: praTamaM vayaH.II Ancient: q. v.: in e. times: pUrvakAle.III Forward: the winter is e. this year: *asmin varze SIGraM samAgataM SItam; e. death: akAlamftyuH.IV In the morn- -ing: pragetanaH (nI, naM): v. Morning.
EARLY (adv.): I In the morning:(1) prAtar; (2) pratyUzasi: v. Morning. Ph.: very e. in the morning: atipratyUze or mahati pratyUze, Sa.II Soon: q. v.:(1) SIDram;(2) acireRa.III First: q. v.: pUrvam.

EARLY , a. (Forward, prior in time) pUrvvaH -rvvA -rvvaM, agraH -grA -graM, pratyagraH -grA -graM, prAktanaH -nA -naM, sadyaskaH -skA -ska, sadyaskAlInaH -nA -naM, aciraH -rA -raM. — (Mature before the time) apUrRakAlaH -lA -laM, prAgvihitakAlAt or niyamitakAlAt pUrvvaM pariRataH -tA -taM or pakvaH -kvA -kvaM; ‘early decrepitude,’ yuvajarA. — (Early in the day) pragetanaH -nI -naM, atipragetanaH -nI -naM, pUrvvAhnetanaH -nI -naM, prAtaHkAlInaH -nA -naM, praBAtIyaH -yA -yaM, OzikaH -kI -kaM, uzasyaH -syA -syaM OzasaH -sI -saM, vEyuzwaH -zwI -zwaM.

EARLY , adv. (Soon) sadyas, acireRa, ASu, Jawiti. — (In advance) agre, prAk, pUrvvaM, pUrvve. — (Betimes in the morning) praBAte, ati- -praBAte, prage, atiprage, pratyUze, atipratyUze, prAtar, prAtaHkAle, sakAlaM, uzA, prAhle, pUrvvAhne, prAk, vyuzwaM, samayA, samaye, velAyAM.
Earn, v. t. arj 10, upArj, upAdA 3 A, Ap 5 P; laB 1 A, nirviS 6 P; See Get. 2 arh 1 P; ‘e(arn) livelihood’ vfttiM kxp c. or saM-pad c. [Earn]ings, s. upArjitaM, vetanaM, laByAMSaH.

EARN (v.): (1) arjayati, upa-, (arj, c. 10.), e. ing fleeting fortune: arjayan gatvarIH SriyaH, Ki,; (2) arjanaM or upArjanaM karoti, after e. ing three hundred sovereigns: suvarRaSatatrayopArjanaM kftvA, P.: v. To acquire.

To EARN , v. a. arj (c. 10. arjayati -yituM), upArj, laB (c. 1. laBate, labDuM), upalaB, prAp (c. 5. -Apnoti -AptuM), avAp, aDigam (c. 1. -gacCati -gantuM), aS (c. 5. aSnute, aSituM), upAS; AdA (c. 3. -dadAti -datte -dAtuM), upAdA, nirviS (c. 6. -viSati -vezwuM), kxp (c. 10. kalpa- -yati -yituM); ‘to earn money by labour,’ SrameRa Danam upArj; ‘earn wages,’ vetanam arh (c. 1. arhati -rhituM).
EARNED , p. p. arjitaH -tA -taM, upArjjitaH -tA -taM, SrameRIpArjjitaH -tA -taM, labDaH -bDA -bDaM, upAttaH -ttA -ttaM, nirvizwaH -zwA -zwaM.

Earnest, a. udyukta, kftodyama; See Eager; ‘e(arnest) desire’ gAQABilAzaH, atispfhA, kutUhalaM. 2 nivizwa, ekAgra, samAhita, Asakta, ekatAna, ekAyana, ekasarga, ekAgrya, ananyAsakta, ekAgracitta, aBinivizwa, ananyavizaya, udyogin; Asaktacitta, ananyavftti, nivizwamanas (of persons). 3 aparihAsaSIla. s. aparihAsaH, alAGavaM; ‘I am in e(arnest)’ na parihasAmi, nAyaM parihAsasya samayaH; ‘take in e(arnest)’ paramArTena grah 9 P, (parihAsavijalpitaM vacaH paramArTena na gfhyatAM S. 2). 2 satyaMkAraH; satyAkfti f., satyApanaM-nA. 3 pUrvaBukti f. 4 upanyAsaH, nikzepaH, ADiH. [Earnest]ly, ‘in e(arnest)’, adv. samAhita-nivizwa-cetasA, yatnataH, sodyogaM, ekAgramanasA, aBiniveSena, utsukaM, sotsAhaM; ‘e(arnestly) desirous’ atyABilAzin, gAQABilAza. 2 aparihAsena, paramArTataH, alAGavaM. [Earnest]ness, s. ekAgratA, utkawatA, OtsukyaM, aBiniveSaH, cittAsakti f., utsAhaH, aBiyogaH, udyogaH.
EARNEST (adj.): I Eager, zealous: q. v.: (1) vyagraH (grA, graM);(2) sotsAhaH (hA, haM). Ph.: e. wish: ekAntakAmanA.II Intent:(1) ekAgraH (grA, graM);(2) nivizwaH (zwA, zwaM).III Seri- -ous: q. v.
EARNEST (subs.): I Reality: satyam. Ph.: I am in e.: na parihasAmi.II Eagerness, intentness: q. v.III Part-payment:(1) satyApanam;(2) satyaNkAraH, to give e.: satyaNkAraM dadAti, Vy.

EARNEST , a. (Zealous) vyagraH -grA -graM, udyuktaH -ktA -ktaM, udyogI -ginI -gi (n), AsaktacetAH -tAH -taH (s), samudyataH -tA -taM, utsukaH -kA -kaM, prayatnavAn -vatI -vat, mahodyamaH -mA -maM, kftaprayatnaH -tnA -tnaM, sacezwaH -zwA -zwaM, pracaRqaH -RqA -RqaM, uccaRqaH -RqA -RqaM, utsAhI -hinI -hi (n), vyavasAyI -yinI -yi (n), tIkzRaH -kzRA -kzRaM, atyanurAgI -giRI -gi (n). — (Intent) nivizwaH -zwA -zwaM, aBinivizwaH -zwA -zwaM, nivizwamanA. -nAH -naH (s), AsaktaH -ktA -ktaM, kftaniScayaH -yA -yaM, ananyavizayAtmA -tmA -tma (n), ekAgracittaH -ttA -ttaM; ‘earnest desire,’ atispfhA, kOtUhalaM, gAQABilAzaH, atiSayecCA.

EARNEST , s. (Seriousness, not jest) gOravaM, alAGavaM, DIratvaM, apari- -hAsaH; ‘in earnest,’ aparihAsena, sagOravaM, alAGavena, saDEryyaM. — (Part paid beforehand) pUrvvadattaBAgaH, pUrvvadattamUlyaM. — (Foretaste) pUrvvaBuktiH f. — (Pledge) upaniDiH m., upanyAsaH, ADiH m., nikzepaH.
EARNESTLY: I With fixed attention:(1) ekAgracittena;(2) nivizwamanasA.II Eagerly: q. v.: sotsAham.III Seriously: q. v.

EARNESTLY , adv. yatnatas, yatnAt, sotsAhaM, mahAyatnapUrvvaM, mahodyamapUrvvaM, AsaktacetasA, vyagraM, nivizwamanasA, aBiniveSena, nirbanDena, sodyogaM, utsukaM, IhAtas, atyanurAgeRa; ‘earnestly desiring,’ atIcCaH -cCA -cCaM, atyaBilAzI -ziRI -zi (n).
EARNESTNESS: I Eagerness: vyagratA.II Intentness: ekAgratA.III Seriousness: q. v.

EARNESTNESS , s. vyagratA, niveSaH, aBiniveSaH, manoniveSaH, cittAsaktiH f., udyuktatA, udyogaH, manonirbanDaH, uccaRqatA, OtsukyaM, utsAhaH, cezwA, anurAgaH, ugratvaM, tEkzRyaM, AtmEkAgryaM, aBiyuktatA.
EARNING (subs.): arjitam, upa-, one's own e. s: svayamarjitam, Ga.; e. s of valour: SOryArjitam, Da.
EARNINGS , s. pl. upArjjanaM, upArjjitaM, arjjanaM, labDiH f., laByaM, laByAMSaH, vetanaM, varttanaM, nirveSaH, karmmaRyA, BaraRyaM, nizkrayaH.

Earth, s. mahI, pfTivI, pfTvI, vasuDA, urvI, vasuMDarA, DarA, DaritrI, medinI, vasumatI, DaraRI, avani f. -nI, BUH, BUmi f., kzo(kzO)Ri f. -RI, kziti f., acalA, anaMtA, rasA, viSvaMBarA, sTirA, kASyapI, sarvaMsahA, ku f., ilA, jyA, gotrA, kzmA, kzamA, BUtaDAtrI, ratnagarBA, jaga-tI. 2 mfd f., mfttikA. v. i. BUmO bilaM kftvA nivas 1 P. v. t. BUmO niviS c. or niDA 3 U or nikzip, 6 P; ‘e(arth)-born’ BU-mija, mahIja; ‘e(arth)ling’ BUjaMtu m., martyaH, pA-maraH; ‘e(arth)-quake’ kaMpaH-calana in comp. with (s.); kzmAyitaM, BUkaMpaH, &c.; ‘e(arth)worm’ BUjaMtu m.; nIcajanaH, aDamaH. [Earth]en, a. mfRmaya (yI f.), mArtika (kI f.); ‘e(arthen)ware’ mfdBAMqaM, kOlAlaka, mArtikaM. [Earth]ly, a. pArTiva (vI f.), sAMsArika (kI f.), Ehika (kI f.), martya; naSvara; vinASaDarman; ‘e(arthly)-minded’ saMsArAsaktacitta; vizayopa-Bogarata. [Earth]y, a. pArTiva, BOma (mI f.) mArtika.

EARTH (subs.): I The globe:(1) pfTivI; (2) pfTvI;(3) vasuDA;(4) vasumatI;(5) vasunDarA; (6) avani: (f.);(7) medinI;(8) mahI;(9) DaritrI;(10) BUH;(11) BUmiH;(12) DarA;(13) kzitiH;(14) DaraRI.II The dry land: sTalam. III Clay:(1) mfttikA;(2) mfd (f.).
EARTH (v.): I Trans: BUmO nidaDAti (DA, c. 3.).II Intrans: [BUmO] vasati (vas, c. 1.).

EARTH , s. (The globe) pfTivI, pfTvI, BUH f., DaraRI, mahI, vasuDA, DaritrI, DarA, medinI, BUmiH f., kzitiH f., avaniH f. -nI, jagatI, urvvI, kzmA, kzoRI -RiH f., kzORiH f., vasunDarA, vasumatI, DAriRI, DAtrI, BUgolaH, BUmaRqalaM, BUlokaH, BUrlokaH, rasA, gOH f. (go), jyA, sTirA, acalA, niScalA, anantA, kuH f., marttyaH, kASyapI, viSvamBarA, BUtaDAtrI, viSvaDAriRI, DArayitrI, sarvvaMsahA, saMsAraH, gotrA, ilA, ilikA, Burik or BUrik f. (j), BuvanaM, vizwapaH -paM, vizwaBaM, sAgarameKalA, udaDimeKalA, samudrAmbarA, ilAgolaM, KastanI, vyomasTalI, ratnagarBA, girikarRikA, vIjasUH f. (-mU), narADArA, dEtyamedajA, viSvaganDA, nftUH m. [Page216-a+ 51] — (Ground, surface of the earth) BUmiH f., BUtalaM, pfTivItalaM, kzititalaM, mahAtalaM, kzmAtalaM. — (Particles of earth, soil) mft f. mfttikA, mfdA, mftKaRqaM, kzitiKaRqaH.

EARTH-WORM: I Lit.: pIluH.II Fig.: kIwaH.

EARTHLY , a. pArTivaH -vI -vaM, BOmaH -mI -maM -mikaH -kI -kaM, lOkikaH -kI -kaM, EhalOkikaH -kI -kaM, mAheyaH -yI -yaM, sAMsArikaH -kI -kaM, EhikaH -kI -kaM.
EARTHLY-MINDED , a. vizayAsaktacetAH -tAH -taH (s), saMsArAsaktamanAH -nAH -naH (s), vizayopaBogavyagraH -grA -graM.
EARTHQUAKE: (1) BUmikampaH, Raj.;(2) kziti- kampaH,V m.;(3) avaniprakampanam, Ku. and sim. comp.s.

EARTHY , a. pArTivaH -vI -vaM, BOmaH -mI -maM. See EARTHEN, EARTHLY.

Ease, s. suKaM, sOKyaM, viSrAmaH, nirvfti f., nirudvegatA, svAsTyaM, svasTatA; ‘I am at e(ase)’ labDaM svAsTyaM mayA; ahaM nirvftaH, vItaciMtaH; ‘this my soul is completely at e(ase)’ jAto mamAyaM viSadaH prakAmaM aMtarAtmA (S. 4); ‘at oneʼs e(ase)’ yaTAkAmaM, paryAptaM, ya-TecCaM, prakAmaM, suKena, suKa in comp., a-kutoBayaM, nirvftyA; ‘sleeping at e(ase)’ suKa-supta. 2 sOkaryaM, anAyAsaH, sukaratvaM, suKaM, lIlA. v. t. laGayati (D.), laGUkf 8 U, pra upa-Sam c. (Samayati), sAM (SAM)tv 10; hf 1 P, apanI 1 P; ‘e(ase) from griefs, burden &c. &c.’ duHKAt &c. muc c., duHKaM-BAraM-apanI, udDf, &c. Easy, a. sukara, ayatnasADya, anAyAsa, suKasADya. 2 suboDa, sugama, avizama; agahana; gen. ex. by suKa or su in comp., ajYaH suKamArADyaH; bA-lAnAM suKaboDAya, &c.; ‘e(asy) of utterance’ suKoccArya; ‘e(asy) style’ sugamA BAzAsaraRiH; ‘e(asy) to get’ sulaBa, suKalaBya, &c.; ‘e(asy) in going’ suKacAra; ‘e(asy) case’ niHSalyorTaH. 3 nirvfta, susTa, nircita, svasTa, suKin, ni-rudvega, SAMta, vItaciMta, nirvftimat, viSada; ‘e(asy) circumstances’ susTiti f., dravyAnu-kUlyaM; ‘heart, be not une(asy)’ hfdaya mA uttAmya (S. 1). 4 anukUla, anuroDin, anuviDAyin. [Easi]ly, adv. anAyAsena, suKaM, suKena, ayatnena, lIlayA, aSrameRa, sukaraM, akleSaM, sOkaryeRa; su or suKa in comp. 2 nirudvegaM, niScitaM, svAsTyena. 3 sAvakASaM, yaTAvasaraM. [Easy]ness, s. sOkaryaM, anAyAsaH, suKasADyatA. 2 sugamatvaM, avEzamyaM. 3 SAMti f., svAsTyaM, akleSaH, suKaM. 4 anuroDaH, Anu-kUlyaM, anuvartanaSIlatA.

Ease (subs.): I Comfort: suKam, at e.: suKena or nirudvegena.II Peace, tranquillity:(1) nirvfttiH, how could he have e. kaDaM syAttasya nirvftiH, P.; (2) svAsTyam, I am now at e.: labDamidAnIM svAsTyam, Sa.III Facility: anAyAsaH, with e.: v. Easily.IV Of style, etc.: svAcCandyam (?).
EASE (v.): I To comfort: svasTayati (nomi.).II To alleviate: laGayati (nomi.)III To move gently: IzaccAlayati (c. of cal).IV To dung: aSOcaM karoti, V. s.

EASE , s. suKaM, sOKyaM, anAyAsaH, viSrAmaH, viSrAntiH f., SamaH, upaSamaH, nirvfttiH f., nivfttiH f., viratiH f., SAntiH f., svAsTyaM, susTatA, susTitiH f.; akazwaM, aduHKaM, akleSaH, nirudvegaH, prasAdaH. — (Facility) sOkaryyaM, sukaratvaM, anAyAsaH, sOgamyaM; ‘love of ease,’ suKecCA; ‘at ease,’ suKena, yaTAsuKaM, nirvftaH -tA -taM, nirudvignaH -gnA -gnaM.

To EASE , v. a. (Free from pain) duHKaM hf (c. 1. harati, harttuM) or Sam (c. 10. Samayati -yituM), kleSaM or udvegaM hf. — (Alleviate) Sam, praSam, upaSam; SAntv or sAntv (c. 10. sAntvayati -yituM), upasAntv; laGa (nom. laGayati -yituM), laGUkf, SAntiM dA. — (Free from labour, remove a burden) nirAyAsaM -sAM -saM kf, BAraM hf or udDf or apanI (c. 1. -nayati -netuM). — (Free from any thing) muc (c. 6. muYcati, moktuM).
Easel, s. citrADAraH, citraPalakaM.

Easement, s. malavisargaH. 2 paraBUmAvaDikAraH.
EASEMENT: I Assistance: q. v.II In law: paraBUmAvaDikAraH.
EASEMENT , s. suKaM, sOKyaM, upakAraH -karaRaM, sAhAyyaM. — (Evacuation) malavisargaH, malaSudDiH f.

EASILY: I With facility:(1) suKena, or suKam, or suKa in comp., e. to be got: suKena laBya (f. ByA), Ki. i. 17.; digests e.: suKaM jIryati, Sr.;(2) anA- yAsena or nirAyAsena (= without exertion), to sustain e.: anAyAsena biBarti, K.(3) akleSena (= without trouble).II Without anxiety: (1) nirudvegena;(2) niScintam.III Gently, gracefully: q. v.

EASILY , adv. (Without difficulty) suKena, suKaM, yaTAsuKaM, anAyAsena, anAyAsaM, nirAyAsaM, sukaraM, sOkaryyeRa, ayatnena, ayatnatas, aduHKena, akazwena, akleSena, aSrameRa, duHKaM vinA, kleSaM vinA, helayA. Often expressed by su or suKa prefixed; as, ‘easily borne,’ susahaH -hA -haM; ‘easily obtained,’ sulaBaH -BA -BaM; ‘easily cut,’ suKaCedyaH -dyA -dyaM; ‘easily attained,’ suKasADyaH -DyA -DyaM; ‘easily done,’ anAyAsakftaH -tA -taM; ‘doing easily,’ suKakaraH -rA -raM. — (With tranquillity) saviSrAmaM, SAntyA, Samena, nirudvignaM, svAsTyena. — (Leisurely) sAvakASaM. — (Readily) kAmaM.
EASINESS: I Comfort: suKam.II Good- -nature: sOjanyam.III Credulity: q. v.IV Of style, etc.: strAcCandyam (?).V Facility: sOkaryam; better expr. by adj.: v. Easy (I).

EASTERLY , EASTWARD, adv. purastAt, pUrvveRa, puras, prAk, pUrvvaM, pUrvvadiSaM, pUrvvadeSe, sUryyodayaM prati, purA, pUrvvapArSve.

EASY: I Not difficult:(1) sukaraH (rA, raM), ayatnasADyaH (DyA, DyaM), etc. (= e. to do), it is not e. to break great men's contemplation: na hi mahatAM sukaraH samADimaNgaH, Ki.;(2) sugamaH (mA, maM) (= e. to go or understand), the rest is e.: SezaM sugamam, Go.;(3) su in comp., fortune is not e. to keep: asurakzAH SriyaH, Ki.; Indra is e. to worship: svArADyo marutvAn, Ki.II Quiet, calm: q. v.:(1) nirvftaH (tA, taM);(2) susTaH (sTA, sTaM). III Of style, etc.: svacCandaH (ndA, ndaM) (?). IV Causing ease: uttamaH (mA, maM) (= good). V Compliant: anuroDin (f. nI).

EASY , a. (Not difficult to be done) nirAyAsaH -sA -saM, nirAyAsakftaH -tA -taM, anAyAsI -sinI -si (n), suKaH -KA -KaM, sukaraH -rA -rI -raM, susADyaH -DyA -DyaM or suKasADyaH, sugamaH -mA -maM, laGuH -GuH -GvI -Gu, akazwaH -zwA -zwaM, akaWinaH -nA -naM, avizamaH -mA -maM, suKena kAryyaH -ryyA -ryyaM. — (Intelligible) suboDaH -DA -DaM, sugamyaH -myA -myaM, sugrAhyaH -hyA -hyaM, avyAKyeyaH -yA -yaM. — (Free from pain, quiet) svasTaH -sTA -sTaM, susTaH -sTA -sTaM, SAntaH -ntA -ntaM, suKI -KinI -Ki (n), duHKahInaH -nA -naM, nirudvegaH -gA -gaM, nirvfttaH -ttA -ttaM; ‘an easy, happy cha- -racter,’ suKisvaBAvaH. — (Complying) anukUlaH -lA -laM; ‘easy of utterance,’ suKoccAryyaH -ryyA -ryyaM; ‘easy of acquisition,’ sulaBaH -BA -BaM, suprApyaH -pyA -pyaM, suKalaByaH -ByA -ByaM or suKena laByaH; ‘easy in its paces,’ suKAyanaH -nA -naM, suKacAraH -rA -raM; ‘an easy case,’ niSSalyo'rTaH.

Brahmins: ahmo dvijAn, B.;(3) aSnAti (aS, c. 9.), and nobody returned without e. ing who wanted to e.: icCatA- SitumanASuzA na ca pratyagAmi, Si.;(4) Bakzati or Bakzayati (Bakz, c. 1. and 10.), will e. us all: Bakzayizyati naH sarvAn, A. r.;(5) BuMkte (Buj, c. 7.), they ate belly-ful: amIBirAkaRWamamoji, N.; (6) jakziti (jakz, c. 2.) (rare);(7) Gasati (Gas, c. 1.) (rare);(8) psAti (psA, c. 2.) (rare).II To corrode: KAdati: Ph.: to e. one's own words: svavacanaM vitaTaM karoti (?).

BuMkte, BoktuM), upaBuj, jakz (c. 2. akziti -tuM), gram (c. 1. grasate -situM), Gas (c. 1. Gasati, GastuM), psA (c. 2. psAti -tuM), cam (c. 1. camati -mituM), Asvad or AsvAd (c. 1. -svadati -svAdati -dituM), gF (c. 6. girati, garituM -rItuM), nigF, carv (c. 1. carvati -rvituM), aByavahf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM), aByAhf, pratyAlih (c. 2. -leQi -QuM), pratyavaso (c. 4. -syati -sAtuM), upayuj (c. 7. -yunakti -yuMkte -yoktuM), valB (c. 1. valBate -lBituM), AhAraM kf; ‘he bid them eat and drink,’ aSnIta pivateti tAn avadat.

EATER , s. KAdakaH, BakzakaH, attA m. (ttf), BoktA m. (ktf), BakzayitA m. (tf), BojI m. (n), ASAM m. (n); ‘great eater,’ bahvASI m. bahuBuk m. (j).

(That which is produced by an agent) utpannaM, nizpannaM, udBUtaM, sidDiH f., utpattiH f., kAryyaM, vfttaM, anuvftraM, GawanA. — (Con- -sequence) PalaM, karmmaPalaM, PalamuttaraM, prayogaH, prayuktiH f., uttaraM, anusAraH, pariRAmaH, antaH -ntaM, vfttAntaH, SezaH, anuzaNgaH, kAvyaM, anvayaH, yogaH, anuBavaH, BavyaM, PalodayaH, pratiPalaM, udarkaH, pratyayaH. — (Purpose) arTaH, prayojanaM, aBiprAyaH; ‘to what effect?’ kimarTaM; ‘he spoke to that effect,’ ityuvAca. — (Advantage, validity) PalaM, prayojanaM, arTaH, praBAvaH; ‘of no effect,’ nizPalaH -lA -laM, nirarTakaH -kA -kaM, nizprayojanaH -nA -naM; ‘to destroy the effect of any thing,’ ni- -zPala (nom. nizPalayati -yituM), moGIkf. — (Completion) nizpattiH f., sidDiH f. — (Fact) vastu n., arTaH; ‘in effect,’ vastutas, arTatas, tattvatas. — (Effects, goods) dravyARi n. pl., vastUni n. pl., sAmagryaM, sAmagrI, viBavaH, rikTaM.

Effuse, v. t. pra-niH-sf c., pramuc 6 P, ut-vi-sfj 6 P, pat c., ni-ava-sic 6 P. [Effus]ion, s. utsargaH, nizekaH, srAvaH, mokzaRaM, avapAtanaM.

(skandayati -yituM), utsic (c. 6. -siYcati -sektuM), avasic, nizic, muc (c. 6. muYcati -moktuM), pramuc, sru in caus. [Page219-b+ 51] (srAvayati -yituM), prasru, Avft in caus. (-varttayati -yituM).
EFFUSED , p. p. skanditaH -tA -taM, utsfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, srAvitaH -tA -taM.

EFT: tfRagoDA (?).

EGG-PLANT: (1) vArtAkuH;(2) vaNganaH;(3) hiRqIraH.
EGG-PLANT , s. hiRqIraH, hiNgulI, vaNganaH, vArttAkuH m. -kI, BaRqAkI, vAtigaH, duHpraDarzaRI, citraPalA, jukuwaM.
EGG-SPOON: *aRqaKAdanacamasaH.
Eglantine, s. araRyajapA-vA.

Egotism, s. ahaMkAraH, AtmaSlAGA-stuti f., AtmABimAnaH, mamatA. Egotist, s. Atma-SlAGin-ahaMkArin-AtmABimAnin m., vikatTanaSIlaH. [Egotist]ic, [Egotist]ical, a. ahaMkArin, dfpta, garvita; See Arrogant. [Egotist]ically, adv. sadarpaM, AtmaSlAGApUrvaM.

EGOTISM , s. ahaNkAraH, ahaNkriyA, ahaNkftiH f., ahantA, ahamahamikA, ahammatiH f., mamatA, AtmABimAnaM, AtmaSlAGA, AtmastutiH f.
EGOTIST: AtmaSlAGin (f. nI): v. Vain, proud.
EGOTIST , s. ahaNkArI m. (n), ahaMyuH m., AtmABimAnI m. (n), mamatAyuktaH.
EGOTISTIC, -AL: AtmaSlAGAmayAH (yI, yaM).
EGOTISTICAL , a. ahaNkArI -riRI -ri (n), ahaNkAravAn -vatI -vat (t), or ahaNkriyAvAn, ahaMyuH -yuH -yu, mAmakaH -kI -kaM, AtmanInaH -nA -naM.
EGOTISTICALLY: (1) AtmaSlAGayA; AtmaSlAGApUrvakam.

Egregious, a. atyaMta, asADAraRa (RI f.), viSizwa, praKyAta, prasidDa, uttama, pramuKa; oft. by ati pr.; ‘an e(gregious) rogue’ suprasidDaH SaWaH; atimUrKaH, &c. [Egregious]ly, adv. atyataM, atIva, BfSaM, atimAtraM, sAtiSayaM.
EGREGIOUS: asADAraRaH (RI, RaM) (= uncommon), e. mistake: asADAraRaBramaH. Ph.: e. fool: atyanta- mUrKaH.

EGREGIOUS , a. (Eminent) viSizwaH -zwA -zwaM, KyAtaH -tA -taM, prasidDaH -dDA -dDaM, utkfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, aDikaH -kA -kaM, pramuKaH -KA -kaM, uttamaH -mA -ma. — (Great) atyantaH -ntA -ntaM, ati prefixed; ‘an egregious fool,’ atimUrKaH, pratinivizwamUrKaH, atyantavinazwacittaH; ‘an egregious rascal,’ KyAtagarhaRaH, atyantaduzwaH, atigarhitaH.
EGREGIOUSLY: atyantam: v. Exceedingly.
EGREGIOUSLY , adv. atyantaM, ati, atIva, atiSayena, BfSaM, atimAtraM.
Egress, s. nirgamaH, nizkramaH, niryARaM, niHsa-raRaM, apasAraH, nirgati f.
EGRESS: (1) nirgamaH, -Ram;(2) niryARam;(3) nizkramaH, -Ram.
EGRESS , EGRESSION, s. niHsAraH -raRaM, niHsaraRaM, apasAraH, nirgamaH, nirgatiH f., vahirgamanaM, nizkramaRaM, niryARaM, vinirgamaH.
EGYPT , s. (The country) misaradeSaH.
EGYPTIAN , s. and a. misaradeSajaH, misaradeSIyaH -yA -yaM.
EIDER-DOWN: perh. haMsatUlaH, D. v.
Eight, a. azwan, azwakaM; ‘in e(ight) ways’ a-zwaDA; ‘e(ight) times’ azwakftvaH; ‘e(ight)-fold’ azwaguRa.
EIGHT: azwan (mfn.), in e. ways or parts: azwaDA; e. times: azwakftvaH or azwavArAn.
EIGHT , a. azwa or azwO m. f. n. (azwan), azwakaH -kA -kaM, azwasaMKyakaH -kA -kaM.
Eighteen, a. azwAdaSan.
EIGHTEEN: azwAdaSan (mfn.). E. th: azwAdaSaH (SI, SaM).
EIGHTEEN , a. azwAdaSa m. f. n. (n), azwAdaSasaMKyakaH -kA -kaM.
EIGHTEENTH , a. azwAdaSaH -SI -SaM.
EIGHTFOLD: azwaguRaH (RA, RaM).
EIGHTFOLD , a. azwaguRaH -RA -RaM, azwAviDaH -DA -DaM, azwakaH -kA -kaM, azwANgaH -NgA -NgaM, azwaprakAraH -rA -raM, azwaDA.
EIGHTH (adj.): azwamaH (mI, maM), in the e. place: azwamataH.
EIGHTH (subs.): (1) azwamAMSaH or azwAMSaH;(2) azwamaBAgaH or azwaBAgaH.
EIGHTH , a. azwamaH -mI -maM, azwakaH -kA -kaM; ‘one-eighth,’ azwamAMSaH, azwamaBAgaH, pAdArdDaM.

EIGHTIETH: (1) aSItitamaH (mI, maM);(2) aSItaH (tI, taM).
EIGHTIETH , a. aSItaH -tI -taM, aSItitamaH -mA -maM.
EIGHTLY: (1) azwamataH;(2) azwamam.
Eighty, a. aSIti f.
EIGHTY: aSItiH, e. times: aSItikftvaH.
EIGHTY , a. aSItiH f. sing., aSItisaMKyakaH -kA -kaM; ‘eighty years old,’ aSItikaH -kA -kaM; ‘eighty-one,’ ekASItiH f.; ‘eighty- -two,’ dvyaSItiH f.; ‘eighty-three,’ tryaSItiH f.
Either, pron. a. anyatara; ‘on e(ither) side’ uBayataH. conj. (-or) vA-vA; or vA singly.

EITHER (conj.): (1) vA ..........vA (never at the beginning of a clause), e. I dissolve on the summit of this mountain: nagamUrdDani vilIye vA, Ki.;(2) .........kiMvA, will touch e. his nails or his arrow-heads: tannaKaM kiMvA tadizumuKaM sprazwAraH, Vi.: v. Or.
EITHER (pro.): Ph.: e. of two: anyataraH (rA, rat); e. of three: anyatamaH (mA, mat); “on e. cheek”: kapolayoH; “on e. side”: uBayataH: v. Both; not e. v. Neither.
EITHER , pron. distrib. (Of two) anyataraH -rA -rat. — (Of many) anyatamaH -mA -mat; ‘either of two days,’ anyataredyus.
EITHER , conj. vA placed after a word, aTavA, vApi, kiMvA; ‘either a friend or an enemy,’ mitraM vA aTavA SatruH.
EITHER , pron. (One of two) ekataraH -rA -raM. — (Of many) ekatamaH &c.
Ejaculate, v. i. sahasA udIr 10 or uccar c., prArTanAM udAhf 1 P. 2 udgF 6 P, utkzip 6 P. [Ejaculat]ion, s. udgAraH, AkraMdanaM, sahasA udIraRaM, uccAraRaM.

(-sAra- [Page220-a+ 51] yati -yituM), nirAkf, vahizkf, vahiHkf, dUrIkf, utkzip (c. 6. -kzipati -kzeptuM), pratikzip, samAkzip, nizkas in caus. (-kAsayati -yituM). — (From office) aDikArAt or sAcivyAd BraMS in caus. (BraMSayati -yituM) or cyu in caus. (cyAvayati -yituM). — (Vomit up) utkzip, udgF (c. 6. -girati -garituM -rItuM).

ELBOW , s. aratniH m., kaPoRiH m. f. -RI, kUrparaH, kaPaRiH m. f. -RI, [Page220-b+ 51] kIlaH — (Of a river) vaNkaH, vakraM, BaNguraH, puwaBedaH. — (Corner) koRaH.
To ELBOW , v. a. aratninA tAqayitvA vahizkf, aratninA Ahan (c. 2. -hanti -ntuM).

ELDERSHIP: (1) jyezWatA, -tvam;(2) jyEzWam, Da.

[Elect]ive, a. jananiyukta; ‘e(lective) right’ varaRADikAraH; ‘e(lective) municipality’ jananiyuktasaByA grAmapAlikA. [Elect]or, s. niyojakaH, nirvAcakaH, varaRADikAraviSizwaH; ‘body of e(lector)s, electoral body’ niyo-jakagaRaH.
ELECT (v.): I To choose: q. v.II To select by vote: no equiv.: nirvAcayati (c. of vac) (?); manonItaM (f. tAM) karoti (in Bengali).
ELECT (adj.): nirvAcitaH (tA, taM) (?); sTirIkftaH (tA, taM) (?).

To ELECT , v. a. vf (c. 5. vfRoti -Rute, c. 9. vfRAti -RIte, c. 1. varati -rituM -rItuM, c. 10. varayati -yituM), Avf, udvf, pravf; udDf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM), vAvft (c. 4. vAvftyate), anuruc in caus. (-rocayati -yituM), manonItaM -tAM -taM kf. — (Take) grah (c. 9. gfhlAti, grahItuM), udgrah, AdA. — (Appoint) niyuj (c. 10. -yojayati -yituM), nirUp (c. 10. -rUpayati -yituM). — (Prefer) puroDA (c. 3. -daDAti -DAtuM); ‘they elect a god to rule over them, devaM rAjye varayanti; ‘she elects him as a husband,’ sA taM patitve varayati.

ELECT , ELECTED, a. and p. p. manonItaH -tA -taM, vftaH -tA -taM, vAvfttaH -ttA -ttaM, vfttaH -ttA -ttaM, udDftaH -tA -taM, gfhItaH -tA -taM, udgfhItaH -tA -taM. purohitaH -tA -taM; ‘to any office,’ pade niyuktaH -ktA -ktaM.
Electer, Electrum, s. kAMsyaM, miSraDAtu m.
ELECTION: I Choice: q. v.II For an office: nirvAcanam (?).III The e. s: *nirvAcana- kAryARi (n. pl.).IV Free will: icCA.V Discernment: vivekaH.
ELECTION , s. vftiH f., varaH -raRaM, udDAraH, udDaraRaM, udgrahaRaM, grahaRaM, AdAnaM, niyojanaM, manonayaH.
ELECTIONEERING: I Subs.: *nirvAcananirvAhaH. II Adj.: expr. by comp., e. agent: *nirvAcana- nirvAhakarmakaraH.
ELECTIONEERING , s. padaprepsusaMvardDanArTaM parASrayaprArTanaM.
ELECTIVE: Ph.: e. franchise: *nirvAcanADikAraH; e. office *nirvAcanIyapadam.
ELECTIVE , a. parASrayADInaH -nA -naM, parAgrahADInaH -nA -naM, varaRADikA- raviSizwaH -zwA -zwaM, varaRakArI -riRI -ri (n).
ELECTOR: *nirvAcakaH; nirvAcanADikArin (m.).
ELECTOR , s. varaRakArI m. (n), varayitA m. (tf), varaRakft m., varaRA- -DikAravAn m. (t).
ELECTORAL: expr. by comp., the e. body: *nirvAcakasampradAyaH.
ELECTORAL , a. varaRADikArasambanDI -nDinI -nDi (n), varayitfpadasambanDI
ELECTORATE , s. varayituH or varaRakAriRaH padaM or aDikAraH.
ELECTRE , ELECTRUM, s. (Amber) tElasPawikaH, SUkApuwwaH. — (Mixed metal) miSritaDAtuH m., kAMsyaM, pItalohaM.
Electric, a. vEdyuta (tI f.), vidyunmaya (yI f.), vidyudvizaya. [Electric]ity, s. taqit-vidyut-vEdyuta-Sakti f.
ELECTRIC, ELECTRICAL: (1) vEdyataH (tI, taM), e. fire: vEdyutaH kfSAnuH; Ki.;(2) by comp., e. current: *taqitpravAhaH.
ELECTRIC , ELECTRICAL, a. vEdyutaH -tI -taM, vidyutvAn -tvatI -tvat (t), taqitvAna -tvatI -tvat (t), vidyunmayaH -yI -yaM, vidyudvipayaH -yA -yaM.
ELECTRICITY: (1) taqit (f.), the science of e.: *taqidvijYAnam;(2) vidyut (f.), atmospheric e.: *vAyavavidyut.
ELECTRICITY , s. vidyut f., taqit f., vidyudvastu n., vEdyutaSaktiH f., vajrasPuliNgaH. — (The science) vidyudvidyA, vajramPuliNgavidyA.
ELECTRIFY: I Lit.: to e. a jar: *GawaM taqitvantaM karoti.II Fig., to surprise: paraM vismayaM janayati (c. of jan).
Electrobus, s. vidyut-yAnaM-vAhanaM.
Electrocute, s. vidyunmaraRena daMq 10.
Electuary, v. t. lehyaM, avalehaH.
ELECTUARY: avalehaH, Bha.
ELECTUARY , s. lehyaM, avalehyaM, avalehaH, avalehyOzaDaM.
Eleemosynary, a. daridrArTa, daridropakArin.
ELEEMOSYNARY , a. BikzAdAnasambanDI -nDinI -nDi (n), daridrapAlanArTaH -rTA -rTaM, daridropakArI -riRI -ri (n), daridrapopaRArTaM dattaH -ttA -ttaM.
ELEGANCE: (1) cArutA: v. Beauty;(2) mADuryam (of style, etc.), Kav.
ELEGANCE , ELEGANCY, s. cArutA, sOndaryyaM, vinItatvaM, vilAsaH, lAvaRyaM, SoBA, lAlityaM; ‘of form,’ rUpalAvaRyaM; ‘of speech,’ vAgvilAsaH.

Elegant, a. cAru, lalita, suMdara, surUpa, lA-vaRyavat, SlIla, agrAmya, suBaga. 2 (As composition) surasa, lalita, cAru. [Elegant]ly, adv. savilAsaM, cAru, lalitaM. Elegance, [Elegan]cy, s. cArutA, sOMdaryaM, vilAsaH, lAvaRyaM, SoBA, viBramaH, lAlityaM; ‘e(legancy) of words’ padalAlityaM.
ELEGANT: (1) cAru (f. rvI): v. Beautiful;(2) maDuraH (rA, raM) (of style, manners, etc.).

ELEGANT , a. vilAsI -sinI -si (n), cAruH -rvvI -ru, sulalitaH -tA -taM, lalitaH -tA -taM, vinItaH -tA -taM, lAvaRyavAn -vatI -vat (t), lIlA- [Page221-a+ 51] vAn &c., sundaraH -rA -rI -raM, surUzaH -zI -zaM, rocizRuH -zRuH -zRu, sureKaH -KA -KaM, BrAjizRuH -zRuH -zRu, viBrAw m. f. n. (j), SlIlaH -lA -laM, SuBagaH -gA -gaM, agrAmyaH -myA -myaM; ‘an elegant woman,’ rUpavatI, sumaDyamA. — (As composition) surasaH -sA -saM.
ELEGANTLY: (1) cAru;(2) maDuram;(3) sulalitam (of movements, etc.).
ELEGANTLY , adv. savilAsaM, vilAsatayA, salAvaRyaM, sulalitaM, cAru.
Elegiac, a. karuRAmaya (yI f.), SokapraDAna.
ELEGIAC: karuRArTagraTitaH (tA, taM), and sim. comp.s. E. metre (in Sanskrit): viyoginI- vfttam, M.n.
ELEGIAC , a. kAruRikaH -kI -kaM, karuRAmayaH -yI -yaM, SokasUcakaH -kA -kaM.
Elegy, s. karuRarasaM gItaM, SokagAnaM-gIti f.
ELEGY: karuRArTagraTitaM kAvyam (= poem) or gItam (= song).
ELEGY , s. karuRaM, kAruRikagItaM, SokagAnaM, SokasUcakagItaM.

Element, s. BUtaM, bIjaM, mUlaM, mUlavastu n. 2 tattvaM. 3 avayavaH, BAgaH, aMSaH. 4 AraMBaH, upakramaH, mUlatattvaM, bIjaBUtaM jYAnaM. 5 vastumAtraM; ‘out of his e(lement)’ asTAne. [Element]al, a. BOta (tI f.), BOtika (kI f.). [Element]ary, a. avyAkfta, SudDa, niravayava. 2 mUla in comp. prAraMBaka.

ELEMENT: I An e. ary substance:(1) BUtam, [Page233] sky, etc. are the five e.s: paYcaBUtAni viyadAdIni, D. s.; the sixth of the great e. s: BUtAnAM mahatAM zazWaH, R.;(2) mUlapadArTaH.II Rudiments: q. v.: e. s of grammer: vyAkaraRasAraH or laGuvyAkaraRam.III The proper sphere: Ph.: he is out of his e.: *na svaBUmO vartate saH.

ELEMENT , s. (First or constituent principle) mUlavastu n., mUlaM, BUtaM, vIjaM, aDiBUtaM, mAtraM, vipayaH, BUtamAtraM -trA, tanmAtraM, avayavaH; ‘the five elements,’ paYcaBftaM, pfTivyAdi n. — (Of a science, &c.) tattvaM, sUtraM. — (Letter) akzaraM. — (Rudiments) AramBaH, prAramBaH. — (Out- line) vastumAtraM, vastu. — (Ingredient) aMSaH, BAgaH, avayavaH; ‘elemen- -tary substance,’ avyAkftaM; ‘elementary property,’ kAraRaguRaH.

ELEMENT , s. (As earth, air, &c.) BUtaM, mahABUtaM; ‘the five e., or earth, air, fire, water and ākāṣa,’ paYcaBUtAni, paYcamahABUtAni, paYcatA -tvaM, DAtujAtaM; ‘reduction to order of the five e.,’ paYcIkaraRaM; ‘relation of an e. with its combinations,’ prakfti- vikftiBAvaH; ‘the five subtile rudiments of the five e.,’ paYcatanmAtrARi. — (Seven elements of the body) saptaDAtavaH m. pl. (tf). These are, 1. chyle, rasaH; 2. blood, raktaM; 3. flesh, mAMsaM; 4. fat, medas; 5. marrow, majjA; 6. bone, asTi; 7. semen, SukraM.
ELEMENTAL , a. BOtaH -tI -taM, BOtikaH -kI -kaM, ADiBOtikaH -kI -kaM, BUtaBAvaH -vA -vaM, pAYcaBOtikaH -kI -kaM.
ELEMENTARY: Ph.: e. substance: mUlapadArTaH; e. instruction: vArtAmAtrAvaboDanam, D.; e. treatise: laGuprabanDaH (?).
ELEMENTARY , a. (Simple, uncompounded) avyAkftaH -tA -taM, niravayavaH -vA -vaM. — (Primary) mUlikaH -kI -kaM, mOlaH -lI -laM. — (Rudi- -mental) AramBakaH -kA -kaM, prAramBakaH -kA -kaM.

Elephant, s. gajaH, hastin-karin m., mAtaM-gaH, mataMgajaH, kuMjaraH, nAgaH, vAraRaH, iBaH, dviradaH, dvi-aneka-paH, daMtin m., daMtAvalaH, staMberamaH; ‘she-e(lephant)’ kariRI, kareRu f. -RukA, vaSA, DenukA; ‘a young e(lephant)’ kalaBaH, kariSAvakaH; ‘e(lephant) driver’ hastipaH-pakaH, ADo-raRaH, mahAmAtraH, nizAdin m.; ‘wild e(lephant)’ vanagajaH, vanyaH karI; ‘furious or rutting (e(lephant))’ madotkawaH, madakalaH, praBinnaH, garjitaH, mattaH; ‘e(lephant) out of rut’ udvAMtaH; nirmadaH; ‘head of a herd of e(lephant)s’ yUTanATaH, yUTapaH; ‘herd of e(lephant)s’ hAstikaM, gajatA, gajayUTaM; ‘war e(lephant)s’ gajaGawA; ‘e(lephant)s of the quarters’ diggajAH; ‘frontal globe of an e(lephant)’ kuMBaH; ‘e(lephant)ʼs fore-head’ lalAwaM, avagrahaH; ‘his eyeball’ i(I)zi(zI)kA, akzikUwakaM ‘corner of his eye’ niryARaM; ‘root of his ear’ cUlikA; ‘his withers’ AsanaM, skaMDadeSaH; ‘his side’ pArSvaBAgaH, pakzaBAgaH; ‘the temple-juice’ madaH, dAnaM; ‘water emitted from the trunk’ vamaTuH, karaSIkaraH; ‘his roaring’ bfMhitaM, garjitaM; ‘the whip to strike him’ totraM, veRukaM; ‘binding-post’ AlAnaM; ‘binding chains’ SfMKalaM, aMdukaH, nigaqaH; ‘caparisoning of an e(lephant)’ kalpanA, sajjanA; ‘coloured housings’ praveRI, AstaraRaM, varRaH, parizwo(sto)maH, kuTaH.

ELEPHANT: (1) gajaH, e. -catcher: gajabanDaH, Vet.; a wild e.: vanagajaH;(2) hastin (m.);(3) karin (m.);(4) mAtaNgaH;(5) kuYjaraH;(6) nAgaH;(7) vAraRaH; a rutting e.: mattavAraRaH;(8) dantin (m.); (9) dvipaH, a newly caught e.: navagraho dvipaH, D. ii.; a musk -e.: ganDadvipaH. A she -e.:(1) kariRI;(2) hastinI;(3) gajavaSA;(4) kareRu (f.). A young e.: kara(la)BaH. The leader of a (wild) herd (of e.s): yUTanATaH or yUTapaH. A large fine e.:(1) gajendraH;(2) gajapuNgavaH;(3) kareRuvaryaH. The roaring of an e.: bfMhitam. Its trunk: (1) karaH;(2) SuRqaH;(3) hastaH (rare). Its frontal globes: kumBO (m. dual). Its temple: (1) gaRqaH;(2) kawaH.

ELEPHANT , a. hastI m. (n), gajaH, karI m. (n), dantI m. (n), dvipaH, vAraRaH, mAtaNgaH, mataNgaH, kuYjaraH, nAgaH, dviradaH, iBaH, radI m. (n), dvipAyI m. (n), anekapaH, vizARI m. (n), kareRuH m. f., lambakarRaH, padmI m. (n), SuRqAlaH, karRikI m. (n), dantAvalaH, stamberamaH, dIrGavaktraH, drumAriH m. dIrGamArutaH, vilomajihvaH, SakvA m. (n), pIluH m.; mahAmfgaH, mataNgajaH, zazWihAyanaH; ‘female elephant,’ hastinI, kariRI, padminI, DenukA, vaSA, ‘young elephant,’ kalaBaH -BI f., kariSAvakaH, kareRuSiSuH m., dikkaH; ‘a large elephant,’ gajapuNgavaH, kareRuvaryyaH; ‘wild elephant,’ vanagajaH; ‘furious elephant,’ mattaH, praBinnaH, garjjitaH; ‘rutting elephant,’ madotkawaH, madakalaH; ‘elephant out of rut,’ udDAntaH, nirmadaH; ‘leader of a herd of elephants,’ yUTanATaH, yUTapaH; ‘herd of elephants,’ yUTaH -TaM, hAstikaM, gajatA, gajavrajaM; ‘troop of war-elephants,’ GawA, GawanA; ‘elephants of the quarters,’ ErAvataH, puRqarIkaH, vAmanaH, kumadaH, aYjanaH, puzpadantaH, sArvaBOmaH, supratIkaH; ‘their females,’ aBramuH f., kapilA, piNgalA, anupamA, tAmrakarRI, SuBradantI, aYjanA, aYjanAvatI; ‘elephant's trunk,’ SuRqA; ‘his temples,’ gaRqaH, kawaH; ‘his frontal globes,’ kumBO; ‘the hollow between them,’ viquH; ‘his forehead,’ lalAwaM, avagrahaH; ‘his eye-ball,’ izIkA, IzikA; ‘corner of his eye,’ niryyARaM, nirRAyanaM; ‘root of his ear,’ cUlikA; ‘of his tail,’ pecakaH; ‘his withers,’ skanDadeSaH, AsanaM; ‘his side,’ pakzaBAgaH, pArSvaBAgaH; ‘his thigh,’ gAtraM, avaraM; ‘juice from his temples,’ madaH, dAnaM; ‘water emitted from his trunk,’ vamaTuH m., karaSIkaraH; ‘his roaring,’ karigarjjitaM, vfMhitaM; ‘clephant- -breaking,’ hastiSikzA; ‘elephant-breaker,’ hastiSikzAjIvI m. (n); ‘elephant-stable,’ vAraRaSAlA; ‘master of the elephants,’ gajADyakzaH.
ELEPHANT-APPLE: (1) kapitTaH;(2) daDitTaH.
ELEPHANT-DRIVER: (1) ADoraRaH;(2) hastipakaH; (3) mahAmAtraH, Mr.;(4) gajasya yantA or niyantA, Ki.
ELEPHANT-DRIVER , s. hastipaH -pakaH -pAlaH, mahAmAtraH, hasticArI m. (n), hastyArohaH, nizAdI m. (n), ADoraRaH.
Elephantiasis, s. SlIpadaM, SilIpadaM.
ELEPHANTIASIS: a disease of the leg: SlIpadam or SilIpadam, one effected with e. SlIpadin (f. nI), M. iii. 165.
ELEPHANTIASIS , s. (Disease of the skin) valmIkaH, tvagrogaH, duScarmmatvaM.
ELEPHANTINE: expr. by comp., e. epoch: *hastiyugam.
ELEPHANTINE , a. hAsteyakaH -kI -kaM, EBaH -BI -BaM; ‘as big as an elephant,’ hastidvayasaH -sI -saM, gajamAtraH -trI -traM.

Elevate, v. t. unnam c. (unnamayati), ucCri c., udyam 1 P, utkfz 1 P; utTA c., (u-tTApayati), unnI 1 P, aDiruh c. (ropayati), unnati-utkarzaM-nI or kf 8 U; ‘e(levate) to a high office’ uttamapade niyuj 7 A, 10, utkfzwapadaM prAp c. [Elevat]ed, a. aDiropita, unnIta; uttamapadaniyukta. 2 ucCrita, uttuMga, unnata, socCrAya; See High. [Elevat]ion, s. unnati f., utkarzaH; ucCrAyaH, utTApanaM, aDiropaRaM, uccapadaprApaRaM, udayaH. 2 utseDaH, uttuMgatA, ucCrAyaH, unnatasTAnaM; See Height.
ELEVATE: I To raise: q. v.: unnamayati (c. of nam).II To exalt: q. v.: unnamayati. E. d.: i. e. lofty: q. v.: unnataH (tA, taM).

To ELEVATE , v. a. unnam in caus. (-namayati -yituM), ucCri (c. 1. ucCrayati [Page221-b+ 51] -yituM, rt. Sri), samucCri, procCri, udyam (c. 1. -yacCati -yantuM), uccIkf, UrdDvIkf, utTA in caus. (-TApayati -yituM, rt. sTA), utkzip (c. 6. -kzipati -kzeptuM), unnI (c. 1. -nayati -netuM), udDan (c. 2. -hanti -ntuM), uddf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM), aDiruh in caus. (-ropayati -yituM), unnatiM kf. — (To a high office) utkfzwapade niyuj (c. 7. -yuMkte -yoktuM) or pratipad in caus. (-pAdayati -yituM).

ELEVATED , p. p. unnataH -tA -taM, samunnataH -tA -taM, ucCritaH -tA -taM, samucCritaH -tA -taM, aByucCritaH -tA -taM, utkfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, udDataH -tA -taM, samudDataH -tA -taM, utTApitaH -tA -taM, udDftaH -tA -taM, samudDftaH -tA -taM, aByutTitaH -tA -taM, udyataH -tA -taM, aDiropitaH -tA -taM, aDirUQaH -QA -QaM, ArUQaH -QA -QaM, aDyArUQaH -QA -QaM, udgataH -tA -taM, udvfttaH -ttA -ttaM, udvarhitaH -tA -taM, uttuNgaH -NgA -NgaM, socCrAyaH -yA -yaM, AhitagOravaH -vA -vaM, kftoccEs ind., ucCrAyI -yiRI -yi (n).
ELEVATION: I Rising:(1) unnamanam;(2) uttolanam.II Loftiness: q. v.: unnatatvam, K. III Of ground: unnataBUmiH: v. Height.

ELEVATION , s. unnatiH f., samunnatiH f., utkapaH, utkfzwatA, uDCrayaH, samucCrayaH, ucCrAyaH, samucCrAyaH, ucCritiH f., utTApanaM, aByutTAnaM, utTitiH f., utseDaH, samutseDaH, udDatiH f., uttuNgatA, OtkarzaM, unnasatA, uttolanaM, UrdDvatvaM, aDirohaH, unnayaH -yanaM, unnAmaH, unnamanaM, upacayaH, pratipattiH f., uccatA, udayaH.

details.body: Eleven, a. ekAdaSan. Eleventh, a. ekAdaSa (SI f.); ‘what is the use of doing things at the e(leventh) hour’ proddIpte Bavane tu kUpaKananaM pratyudyamaH kIdfSaH (Bh. ii. 88).
ELEVEN: ekAdaSan (mfn.). E. times: ekAdaSavArAn.
ELEVEN , a. ekAdaSa m. f. n. pl. (n), ekAdaSasaMKyakaH -kA -kaM.
ELEVENTH: I Adj.; ekAdaSaH (SI, SaM).II Subs.: ekAdaSaBAgaH.
ELEVENTH , a. ekAdaSaH -SI -SaM.
Elf, s. vetAlaH, BUtaH, piSAcaH, apadevatA. [Elf]ish, a. pESAca (cI f.).
ELF: qAkinI (?).
ELF , s. vidyADaraH, apadevatA, vetAlaH, BUtaH, rAkzasaH, piSAcaH.
ELF-LOCK: jawA, e.s: jawAjUwaH (?).
ELF-LOCK , s. jawA, jawiH f., sawA.
ELFISH , a. pESAcikaH -kI -kaM, BOtikaH -kI -kaM, rAkzasaH -sI -saM.
Elf-lock, s. jawA, sawA.
Elicit, v. t. nirgam c. (gamayati), nizkfz 1 P, udBU c., niHsf c., prakAS c., apavah 1 P or c., Avizkf 8 U, nirRI 1 P, jYA 9 U or c. (jYApayati). [Elicit]ation, s. nizkarzaRaM, nirga-manaM, &c.
ELICIT: (1) nirharati, (hf, c. 1.) (= bring out); (2) nizkarzati (kfz, c. 1.) (= draw out).

To ELICIT , v. a. nirRI (c. 1. -Rayati -RetuM), nizkfz (c. 1. -karzati -krazwuM), utkfz; nirhf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM), udDf, utpad in caus. (-pAdayati -yituM), utpattiM kf, nirgam in caus. (-gamayati -yituM), niHptf in caus. (-sArayati -yituM), udBU in caus. (-BAvayati -yituM), nirduha (c. 2. -dogDi -gDuM), udvah (c. 9. -gfhlAti -grahItuM), apavah (c. 1. -nahati -voQuM).
ELICITATION , s. nirhAraH, udDAraH, utpAdanaM, nizkarpaRaM, nirRayanaM.
ELICITED , p. p. nirhftaH -tA -taM, udDftaH -tA -taM, utpAditaH -tA -taM.
Elide, v. t. lup 6 P or c. Elision, s. lopaH.
ELIDE: lumpati (lup, c. 6.).
To ELIDE , v. a. (Cut off a syllable) lup (c. 6. lumpati, lopnuM).
ELIGIBILITY: I Lit.: *nirvAcyADikAraH.II Worthiness: q. v.: yogyatA.
ELIGIBILITY , s. varaRIyatA, vAryyatvaM, grAhyatvaM, grahaRIyatA, yogyatA.
Eligible, a. varaRIya, niyojya, grAhya, Adeya.
ELIGIBLE: I Lit.: nirvAcyADikArin (f. RI).II Worthy: q. v.: yogya (f. gyA).
ELIGIBLE , a. varaRIyaH -yA -yaM, vAryyaH -ryyA -ryyaM, vftyaH -tyA -tyaM, grAhyaH -hyA -hyaM, grahaRIyaH -yA -yaM, AdeyaH -yA -yaM, yogyaH -gyA -gyaM, upayuktaH -ktA -ktaM
Eliminate, v. t. naS c., nizkas c., vilup 6 P or c., nirAkf 8 U. [Eliminat]ion, s. lopaH, nASaH, AharaRaM, apanayanaM.

EMPRESS: (1) aDirAjYI;(2) mahArAjYI;(3) rAja- rAjeSvarI;(4) rAjADirAjYI.
EMPRESS , s. rAjADirAjasya patnI, rAjYI, aDISvarI, mahArAjapatnI.
EMPTIED , p. p. recitaH -tA -taM, virecitaH -tA -taM, SUnyIkftaH -tA -taM, gatatoyaH -yA -yaM, gatajalaH -lA -laM; ‘poured out,’ pAtitaH -tA -taM, avatAritaH -tA -taM.
EMPTINESS: I Lit.: SUnyatA;(2) riktatA.II Fig.: asAratA.
EMPTINESS , s. SUnyatvaM -tA, riktatA -tvaM, riktaM, asAratA, niHsAratA, virasatA, nIrasatA, rasABAvaH, apUrRatvaM, vitAnatvaM, tucCatvaM, PalgutA.
EMPTION , s. krayaH, krayaRaM, krayakaraRaM.

Empty, a. SUnya, pariSUnya, SUnyagarBa, rikta. 2 virasa, niHsAra, asAra, Palgu, niHsatvaniHsattva; ‘e(mpty) headed’ maMdaDI, alpabudDi, durmati; ‘an e(mpty) vessel makes most noise’ arDo Gawo GozamupEti nUnaM. v. t. ric 7 U, SUnyI-riktI-kf 8 U. 2 sAraM hf 1 P, niHsatvIkf. 3 toyaM pat c.; ava-tF 1 P, sru 1 P, viS 6 P; (kutra vA sAgaraM varjayitvA mahAnadyavatarati S. 3) ‘e(mptie)s itself &c.’. [Empty]ness, s. riktattAriktatA, SUnyatA; niHsAratA, &c.

EMPTY (adj.): I Lit.:(1) SUnyaH (nyA, nyaM), pari-, the street is e.: SUnyo rAjamArgaH, Mr. i.; today my bed is e.: pariSUnyaM SayanIyamadya me, R.; (2) riktaH (ktA, ktaM) (rare), in the e. mouth of the quiver: rikte nizaNgavaktre, Ki.II Fig.: asAraH (rA, raM), in this e. world: asAre saMsAre, Va.: v. Vain.
EMPTY (v. t.): (1) SUnyIkaroti;(2) riktIkaroti, e. ing tanks: riktIkurvan sarAMsi, K.(3) riRakti (ric, c. 7.) (rare), B.
EMPTY (v. i.): SUnyIBavati, D. Ph.: the rivers quick- ly e. themselves in the ocean: prayAnti nadyastvaritaM payoniDim, Ri.

EMPTY , a. riktaH -ktA -ktaM, riktakaH -kA -kaM, SUnyaH -nyA -nyaM, SUnyamaDyaH -DyA -DyaM, virasaH -sA -saM, nIrasaH -sA -saM, asAraH -rA -raM, niHsAraH [Page225-b+ 51] -rA -raM, niHsattvaH -ttvA -ttvaM, sArahInaH -nA -naM, vitAnaH -nA -naM, apUrRaH -rRA -rRaM, vaSikaH kA -kaM, tucCaH -cCA -cCaM.

To EMPTY , v. a. ric (c. 1. riRakti, rektuM), viric, riktIkf, SUnyIkf virasIkf, miHsArIkf, sAraM hf (c. 1. harati, harttuM). — (Pour out water, &c.) toyam avatF in caus. (-tArayati -yituM) or pat in caus. (pAtayati -yituM) or prasu in caus. (-srAvayati -yituM); ‘the river empties itself into the sea,’ nadI samudraM viSati.
EMPTY-HANDED: (1) SUnyahastaH (stA, staM);(2) riktahastaH (stA, staM), etc.
EMPTY-HANDED , a. riktahastaH -stA -staM, riktapARiH -RiH -Ri, SUnyahastaH -stA -staM.
EMPTY-HEADED: SUnyamastizkaH (zkA, zkaM), and sim. comp. s.
EMPTY-HEADED , a. SUnyamastakaH -kA -kaM, nirboDaH -DA -DaM, alpavudDiH -dDiH -dDi.
Empurple, v. t. aruRI-lohitI-kf 8 U.
To EMPURPLE , v. a. DUmrIkf, lohitIkf, aruRIkf, DUmrasavarRaM -rRAM -rRaM kf, DUmravarRena raYj in caus. (raYjayati -yituM).
Empyreal, a. Agneya-tejomaya (yI f.).
EMPYREAL: tejomayaH (yI, yaM).
EMPYREAL , a. AgneyaH -yI -yaM, uparyyuparigagaRasambanDI -nDinI -nDi (n).
Empyrean, s. uttamasvargaH, vEkuMWaM, tejolokaH.
EMPYREAN: vEkuRWam (?); tejolokaH (?).
EMPYREAN , s. uparyyuparisTagagaRaM, uttamasvargaH, sUkzmAgnisTAnaM.

Emulate, v. t. sparD 1 A, pratisparD, saMGfz 1 P (with instr.); viji desid. (vijigIzate), aBiBavituM yat 1 A or udyam 1 P, ahamahamikayA yat; See Compete. [Emulat]ion, s. sparDA, vijigIzA, saMGarzaH, ahamahamikA. [Emulat]ive, Emulous, a. pratisparDin, vijigIzu, jayecCu. s. vijigIzuH, sapatnaH, pratisparDin m.
EMULATE: sparDate (sparD, c. 1.), the accused Rāk- ṣasa is e. ing me: mayA saha sparDate rAkzasahatakaH, Mu.

To EMULATE , v. a. sparD (c. 1. sparDate -rDituM), visparD, AsparD, pratisparD with inst. c.; ji in des. (jigIzati -zituM), saMGfz (c. 1. -Garzati -rpituM), param aBiBavituM yat (c. 1. yatate -tituM), parABiBavanAya udyogaM kf, ahampUrvvam ahampUrvvamiti vad (c. 1. vadati -dituM); ‘he emulates Indra,’ SakreRa saha sparDate.
EMULATION: sparDA, as if in e. of the waters of the celestial rivers: divyasaridambupadDatisparDayeva, Si.: v. Also rivalry, contest.
EMULATION , s. spardDA, AspardDA, pratispardDA, jigIzA, vijigIzA, saNGarzaH, parABiBavecCA, parABiBavanAya udyogaH, ahampUrvvikA, sApatnyaM.

EMULATIVE , EMULOUS, a. spardDI -rdDinI -rdDi (n), pratispardDI &c., jigIzuH -zuH -zu, jigIzan -pantI -pat (t), vijigIzuH -zuH -zu, jrayecCuH -cCuH -cCu, parABiBavecCuH -cCuH -cCu, bIBatsuH -tsuH -tsu.
EMULATOR: sparDin (f. nI), prati-,: v. Rival.
EMULATOR , s. spardDAkArI m. (n), jigIzuH m., saNGarzakArI m., sapatnaH.
To EMULGE , v. a. nirduh (c. 2. -dogDi -gDuM, c. 10. -dohayati -yituM), nIrasIkf.
EMULGENT , a. nirdohanakArI -riRI -ri (n), nirdogDA -gDrI -gDf (gDf).
EMULOUS: sparDin (f. nI), E. of: sparDayA: v. Emulation. To be e. of: v. To emulate.
EMULOUSLY: sparDayA, sparDApUrvakam.
Emulsion, s. pAyasaM, payasyaM.
EMULSION , s. pAyasikam OzaDaM, pAyasaM, payasyaM.
Emunctory, s. SarIramalapaTaH, dehamalanirgamaH
EMUNCTORY , s. SarIramaladvAraM, SarIramalapaTaH, dehotsargapaTaH.
Enable, v. t. Gen. ex. by Sakya; ‘this will e(nable) you to go back’ anena tava parAvartanaM SakyaM; SaktiM-sAmarTyaM-dA 3 P, samarTa-kzama-Sakta a. kf 8 U.
ENABLE: SaktiM, sAmarTyaM or kzamatAM dadAti (dA, c. 3.), better by circumlo.; it will e. you to decamp: anena tavApasarpaRaM Sakyam.
To ENABLE , v. a. SaktiM or sAmarTyaM or kzamatAM dA, samarTaM -rTAM -rTaM kf, SaktaM, -ktAM -ktaM kf, kzamaM -mAM -maM kf, samarTIkf, kxp in caus. (kalpa- -yati -yituM).

Enact, v. t. kf 8 U, viDA 3 U, nizpad c. 2 vyavasTA c. (sTApayati), viDiM-vyavasTAM-kf, praSAs 2 P, SAsanaM kf; ‘it is e(nact)ed as follows’ ayaM viDiH kriyate, evaM vyavasTApyate. 3 naw 10, aBinI 1 P, nirUp 10. [Enact]ment, s. viDiH, SAsanaM, vyavasTA, SAsanapatraM.
ENACT: I To decree: karoti, to e. laws: *viDIn karoti.II To do, perform: q. v.: karoti.

To ENACT , v. a. (Act, perform) kf, viDA (c. 3. -daDAti -DAtuM), prayuj (c. 7. -yuMkte -yoktuM), nizpad in caus. (-pAdayati -yituM), samyad in caus. — (Decree) vyavasTAdvAreRa or SAsanadvAreRa nizpannaM kf or sidDaM kf, vyavasTAM kf, SAsanaM kf, vyavasTA in caus. (-sTApayati -yituM), praSAs (c. 2. -SAsti -SAsituM), prakxp (c. 10. -kalpayati -yituM). — (Represent in action) naw (c. 10. nAwayati -yituM), aBinI (c. 1. -nayati -netuM).
ENACTED , p. p. vyavasTApitaH -tA -taM, nizpannaH -nnA -nnaM, praSAsitaH -tA -taM.
ENACTMENT: I The act: karaRam; nizpAdanam. II A law: kftiH (?); viDiH.
ENACTMENT , s. SAsanaM, praSAsanaM, vyavasTA -sTApanaM, niyamaH, SAsanapatraM, AjYApatraM, rAjAjYA, viDAnaM, nideSaH, AdeSaH.
ENACTOR: kartf (f. trI): v. Doer.
ENAMEL (subs.): *anAmilam.
ENAMEL (v.): *anAmilayati (nomi.); anAmilena raYjayati (raYj, c. 10.). E. ’d.: *anAmilitaH (tA, taM).
ENAMEL , s. suvarRAlaNkAracitrakaraRe prayuktaM kAcavat suvilayaM maRivat sutejanIyaM snigDadravyaM.
To ENAMEL , v. a. pUrvvoktasnigDadravyeRa suvarRAlaNkArAn citr (c. 10. citra- -yati -yituM) or citravicitrIkf.
ENAMOUR: Ph.: he is e. ed of her: ayamasyAmAsakta- BAvaH, D.; I am e. ed of these books: *etezu pusta- kezu badDaBAvo'smi.

Enamoured, a. sAnurAga, Asakta, anurakta, badDaBAva, kAmAsakta (with loc.); ‘the king was e(namoured) of her’ nfpastasyAM badDaBAvaH, AsaktAnurAgaH, prItiM babaMDa; ‘to be e(namoured)’ anuraMj-AsaMj pass., Asakta &c. BU.
ENAMOURED , p. p. anurAgavAn -vatI -vat (t), anurAgI -giRI -gi (n), anuraktaH -ktA -ktaM, AsaktaH -ktA -ktaM, kAmAsaktaH -ktA -ktaM, jAtamansaTaH -TA -TaM.
Enbloc, adv. sAkalyena, saMGaSaH, gaRaSaH.
Encage, v. t. paMjare niruD 7 U or baMD 9 P.
ENCAGE: paYjare ruRadDi, ni-, ava-, saM-, (ruD, c. 7.).
To ENCAGE , v. a. piYjare praviS in caus. (-veSayati -yituM) or niruD (c. 7. -ruRadDi -rodDuM) or avaruD or banD (c. 9. baGnAti, banDuM).
Encamp, v. t. (sEnyaM) niviS c., samAvas c. v. i. niviS 6 P, samAvas 1 P. [Encamp]ment, s. niveSanaM, samAvAsaH. 2 SibiraM, niveSaH.
ENCAMP (v. i.): niviSate (viS, c. 1.), preparing to e.: nivezwumudyacCamAnA, M. n.
ENCAMP (v. t.): niveSayati (c. of viS), e. ed the forces: balAni niveSayAmAsa, R.
To ENCAMP , v. n. niviS (c. 6. -viSate -vezwuM), upaviS (-viSati), balena or sEnyena upaviS, kawake or Sivire vas (c. 1. vasati, vastuM) or samAvas or aGyAs (c. 2. -Aste -AsituM).
To ENCAMP , v. a. sEnyaM niviS in caus. (-veSayati -yituM), kawakaM samAvas in caus. (-vAsayati -yituM), SiviraM sTA in caus. (sTApayati -yituM)
ENCAMPED , p. p. nivizwaH -zwA -zwaM, upavizwaH -zwA -zwaM, samAvAsitaH -tA -taM, samAvAsitakawakaH -kA -kaM, niveSitasEnyaH -nyA -nyaM, aDyAsitaH -tA -taM.
ENCAMPMENT: niveSaH, R. v. 49.: v. Camp.
ENCAMPMENT , s. (Act of encamping) niveSanaM, vAhinIniveSanaM, balopaveSanaM, samAvAsaH. — (Camp) niveSaH, SiviraM, kawakaH, mandiraM, skanDAvAraH, balasTitiH f., pawakaH.
Encave, v. t. kaMdare pracCad 10 or guh 1 U.
To ENCAVE , v. a. kandare or kuhare or vivare guh (c. 1. gUhati, goQuM), gartte gopanaM kf.
ENCEINTE: garBavatI: v. Pregnant.
ENCEINTE , a. garBiRI, garBavatI, pUrRagarBA, sasattvA, ApannasattvA.
Enchafe, v. t. saMtap-prakup-ruz c.
To ENCHAFE , v. a. tap in caus. (tApayati -yituM), paritap, kup in caus. (kopayati -yituM), prakup, ruz in caus. (rozayati -yituM), bAD (c. 1. bADate -DituM).
Enchain, v. t. nigaqEH baMD 9 P, nigaqayati (D.), KilIkf 8 U, ava-ni-ruD 7 U. 2 Akfz 1 P, hf 1 P, niruD.
ENCHAIN (v.): nigaqErbaDnAti (banD, c. 9.) or saMya- cCati (yam, c. 1.) (lit.), K. ; (2) nigaqayati (nomi.), D.
To ENCHAIN , v. a. nigaqena or SfNKalayA banD (c. 9. baDnAti, banDuM), nigaqa (nom. nigaqayati -yituM), SfNKala (nom. SFNKalayati -yituM).

Enchant, v. t. maMtrErvaSIkf 8 U or muh c., aBicar c., aBimaMtr 10. 2 (fig.) hf 1 P. Akfz 1 P, viluB c.; ‘I was quite e(nchant)ed with thy ravishing melody’ tavAsmi gItarAgeRa hAriRA prasaBaM hftaH (S. 1). [Enchant]er, s. vi-, mohakaH, EMdrajAlikaH, mAyin m.; ‘e(nchanter) of snakes’ vyAlagrAhin m., a(A)hituMqikaH. [Enchant]ing, a. manohara, mohin, hArin. [Enchant]ment, s. mAyA, yogaH, iMdrajAlaM, mohaH, kuhakaH, aBicAraH. Enchantress, s. mA-yinI, mohinI, yoginI.
ENCHANT: I Lit.:(1) vaSIkaroti, Kuv.;(2) sADayati (c. of siD), D.II Fig.: to e. the hearers: SfRvatAM mano hartum, R. xv. 64.: v. To charm, delight. E. ing: v. Charming.

To ENCHANT , v. a. (Subdue by spells) mantradvAreRa vaSIkf or muh in caus. (mohayati -yituM), aBimantr (c. 10. -mantrayate -yituM), anumantr; aBicar (c. 10. -cArayati -yituM), mAyAM kf. — (Charm the mind) mano hf (c. 1. harati, harttuM) or ram (c. 10. ramayati -yituM), hfz (c. 10. harzayati -yituM), prahfz, zaramaharzaM jan (c. 10. janayati -yituM).

ENCHANTER: I A magician:(1) mAyAvin (m.);(2) mAyAkAraH.II A charmer: mohanaH or -kaH, vi-.
ENCHANTER , s. mAyI m. (n), aBicArI m. (n), aBicAravid, mAyA- -kAraH, mAyAkft m., mAyikaH, mohI m. (n), EndrajAlikaH, yogI m. (n), yogeSvaraH.
ENCHANTING , a. manoharaH -rA -raM, paramaharzakaraH -rI -raM, paramAnandadaH -dA -daM, mohI -hinI -hi (n). See CHARMING.
ENCHANTINGLY , adv. mAyayA, suramaRIyaM, yaTA paramaharzo jAyate taTA.
ENCHANTMENT: I The act: vaSIkaraRam, K.II The practice: vaSyakarman (n.), D. s.III Any thing enchanting: v. Charming.

ENCHANTMENT , s. mAyA, aBicAraH, vaSakriyA, yogaH, samprayogaH, aBi- mantraRaM, indrajAlaM, jAlaM, kuhakaH, mohaH, mantramohanaM, saMvadanaM -nA, mUlakarmma n. (n), citrakarmma n., kArmmaRaM, kusratiH f.
ENCHANTRESS: (1) mohinI;(2) mAyAvinI (in bad sense).
ENCHANTRESS , s. mAyinI, yoginI, aBicAriRI, mohinI, kuhakakArI.
Enchase, v. t. praRI-DA 3 U, pratibaMD 9 P, anuvyaD 4 P, Kac 10 (Kacayati).

To ENCHASE , v. a. (A gem in gold) maRiM suvarRe praRiDA (c. 3. -daDAti -DAtuM) or Kac (c. 10. Kacayati -yituM). — (Adorn silver vessels, &c., by embossed work) rAjataBARqAdIni uccareKAdinA alaNkf or upaskf.
Encircle, v. t. pari-vf 5 U, parivezw 1 A or c., parigam 1 P, pari-i-yA- 2 P, valayati-maMqalayati (D.), valaya-rasanA in comp. 2 Embrace, q. v.

ENCIRCLE: (1) pari-vezwayati (vezw, c. 10.), e. whatever be on the side: yatpArSvato Bavati tatpari- vezwayanti, P.; to e. in the arms: BujAByAM pari- vezwayanti, D.;(2) parigacCati (gam, c. 2.) (= to go round), e. d by the Vetravatī: vetravatyA parigatA, K.

To ENCIRCLE , v. a. parivezw (c. 1. -vezwate -zwituM, c. 10. -vezwayati -yituM), upavezw, saMvezw, parivf (c. 5. -vfRoti -varituM -rItuM), parizWA (c. 1. -tizWati -zWAtuM), parigam (c. 1. -gacCati -gantuM), parisf (c. 1. -sarati -sarttuM), maRqala [Page226-b+ 51] (nom. maRqalayati -yituM). — (Embrace) parizvaYj (c. 1. -zvajate -zvaMktuM).
ENCIRCLED , p. p. valayitaH -tA, -taM, maRqalitaH -tA -taM, parimaRqalitaH -tA -taM, parigataH -tA -taM, parivezwitaH -tA -taM, AvftaH -tA -taM, vyAptaH -ptA -ptaM.
ENCIRCLET , s. valayaH, maRqalaM, parimaRqalaM, cakravAlaM, parivezwanaM.

Enclose, v. t. A-pari-vf 5 U, parivezw 1 A or c. 2 ni-saM-ava-ruD 7 U. 3 prAcIreRa parivezw or Avf or avaruD, parikzip 6 P. 4 Avezw, A-saM-Cad 10, pi-DA 3 U, koSe ni-viS c., koSasTa a. kf 8 U. [Enclos]ed, a. parivfta, parivezwita, parikzipta. 2 avarudDa, sAvaraRa, prAkArAvfta. 3 koSasTa, pihita, paricCanna, Avezwita, koSAMtargata. [Enclos]ure, s. vfti f., AvaraRaM, prAkAraH, prAcIraM, AvezwanaM, avaroDakaM, varaRaH. 2 vAwaH-wI. 3 aMtargatapatraM.

ENCLOSE (v.): I To surround: q. v.: pari- vfRoti or vArayati (vf, c. 5. or 10.). e. d. me with showers of arrows: SaravarzErmAM paryavArayan, Mah. II To fence: q. v.: parivfRoti.III To shut up, confine: q. v.IV To put in a case: saha prerayati (Ir, c. 10.) (= to send with).
ENCLOSURE: I Fence: vftiH, pari-, e. s of parks: upavanavftayaH, Me.; over the e. s: vftInAmupari, Si.II That which is enclosed: there was no e. s with letter: *patreRa sahitaM na kiYcit preritam.
ENCOMIAST , s. stutipAWakaH, maNgalapAWakaH, vandI m. (n), varRakaH, guRo- -tkIrttanakft, guRakaTakaH, guRapraSaMsakaH, guRapraSaMsAkArI m. (n).
ENCOMIASTIC , ENCOMIASTICAL, a. praSaMsAkaraH -rI -raM, stutimayaH -yI -yaM, SlAGAmayaH -yI -yaM, vandAruH -ruH -ru, guRaprakASakaH -kA -kaM, kIrttipra- -kASakaH -kA -kaM.

Encomium, s. praSaMsA, SlAGA, stuti f., stavaH, stutivAkyaM, varRanaM, guRapraSaMsA. Encomiast, s. guRapraSaMsakaH, stutipAWakaH. [Encomiast]ic, [Encomiast]ical, a. stutimaya (yI f.); SlAGAmaya, praSaMsAkara (rI f.).
ENCOMIUM: stavaH: v. Eulogy, praise.

ENCOMIUM , s. praSaMsA, stutiH f., SlAGA, guRapraSasA, guRaSlAGA, guRastutiH f., stutivAkyaM, praSaMsAvAkyaM, stutivAdaH, guRotkIrttanaM, guRagAnaM, vandanA, varRanA, yaSovarRanA, stotraM, stavaH, vandipAWaH.

ENCOMPASS: parivezwayati (vezw, c. 10.): v. To encircle.
