ENTIRENESS, ENTIRETY: (1) kArtsnyam;(2) sAkalyam;(3) samagratA;(4) sampUrRatA: v. Entire.

ENTIRENESS , ENTIRETY, s. kArtsnyaM, kArtsnaM, sAkalyaM AKilyaM, sAmagryaM, sampUrRatA, samudAyaH, samastatA, samastiH f., aBinnatA, aKaRqatvaM, anyUnatA, avEkalyaM. — (Integrity) aBedyatA, sAralyaM, mAyAhInatA.

Entitle, v. i. nAma kf 8 U, aBiDA 3 U; See Call. 2 aDikAraM dA 3 P; aDikf 8 U; ex. by arh 1 P, or pot. pass. part.; ‘he is e(ntitl)ed the respect’ mAnamarhati, mAnyaH, pUjyaH; ‘persons e(ntitl)ed to a share’ aMSA-DikAriRaH, aMSaBAjaH, aMSArhAH; ‘e(ntitl)ed to praise’ praSaMsArha, praSaMsApAtraM.

ENTITLE (v.): I To call, name:(1) aBidaDAti (DA, c. 3.);(2) udAharati (hf, c. 1.)II To give a claim to: expr. by aDikAraH or arhati (arh, c. 1.) or -BAj (mfn.) in comp., who are not e. d to share: viBAgAnaDikAriRaH, Mit.; how is the youngest e. d to the kingdom in pre- ference to the eldest: kaTaM jyezWamatikramya kanIyAn rAjyamarhati, Mat.; in the absence of the former, the latter is e. d to property: pUrvasyABAve DanaBAguttaraH, Y.

To ENTITLE , v. a. (Give a title or name) nAma kf or dA, upAzwiM or saMjYAM dA, nAmaDeyaM kf, aBiDA (c. 3. -daDAti -DAtuM), AKyA (c. 2. -KyAti -tuM), kFt (c. 10. kIrttayati -yituM), udAhf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM). — (Give a claim) aDikAraM or aDikAritvaM or svatvaM dA; ‘to be entitled,’ arh (c. 1. arhati -te -rhituM), arhaH -rhA -rhaM or upayaktaH -kta -ktam as; ‘he is entitled to honour,’ mAnam arhati; ‘he is entitled to receive so much salary,’ upayukto'yam etAvad varttanaM gfhlAti; ‘knowledge entitles to respect,’ vidyA mAnyatva- kAraRaM; ‘a good man is entitled to reverence,’ sADujataH pUjanIyaH.

ENTITLED , p. p. (Named) proktaH -ktA -ktaM, aBihitaH -tA -taM, smftaH -tA -taM, saMjYitaH -tA -taM, udAhftaH -tA -taM, AKpAtaH -tA -taM. See CALLED. (Having a claim) aDikArI -riRI -ri (n), arhaH -rhA -rhaM; ‘entitled to honour,’ pUjArhaH -rhA -rhaM; ‘entitled to a sixth,’ [Page233-a+ 51] zaqBAgaBAk m. f. n. (j).
Entity, s. satvaMsattvaM, astitvaM, BAvaH, sattA.
ENTITY: (1) sat, G.;(2) BAvaH, G.
ENTITY , s. BUtaM, aDiBUtaM, sattvaM, sattA, BAvaH, vastu n., varttanaM.
Entomb, v. t. smaSAne niKan 1 P or niDA 3 U or sTA c. (sTApayati); ‘e(ntomb)ed in despair’ nErASyopahata.
ENTOMB: nidaDAti (DA, c. 3.) (= to bury).
To ENTOMB , v. a. SmaSAne or samADO sTA in caus. (sTApayati -yituM) or niDA (c. 3. -daDAti -DAtuM) or niKan (c. 1. -Kanati -nituM) or samf in caus. (-arpayati -yituM).
ENTOMBED , p. p. niKAtaH -tA -taM, samADiniKAtaH -tA -taM, BUminiKAtaH -tA -taM.
ENTOMOLOGIST: *kIwavijYAnavid (mfn.), -viSAradaH (dA, daM).
Entomology, s. kIwakaSAstraM.
ENTOMOLOGY: *kIwavijYAnam; kIwavidyA.
Entourage, s. parivAraH.
ENTOZOON (pl. -zoa): *antarjIvaH.
ENTRAIL: (1) antram;(2) purItat (n.) (rare).
ENTRAIL , ENTRAILS, s. antraM, antrARi n. pl., purItat m. n., nAqiH -qI f., DamanI, kozWaH.
Entrails, s. aMtrARi (pl.), purItat n.
Entrance, v. t. (Put in a trance) muh c., mUrcCAM prAp c. [Entranc]ed, a. mUQa, mUrcCApanna, pralIna. 2 unmatta, harzonmatta.

ENTRANCE (subs.): I The act or right of entering: praveSaH, -nam, for our e.: asmAkaM praveSAya, V. p.; give me e.: dehi Be praveSam, Mu.; e. -fee: *praveSanaSulkam.II A place for e.: praveSaH, at the e. of a certain town: kasyacinnagarasya praveSe, P. iv. 6.: v. Door, passage.

ENTRANCE (v.): I To put in a trance: mohaM janayati (jan, c. 10.), utpAdayati (c. of pad), etc. [Page244] E. d: mohAvizwaH (zwA, zwaM), mohADizWitaH (tA, taM). II To enrapture: praharzayati (c. of hfz).

ENTRANCE , s. (Act of entering) praveSaH -SanaM, niveSaH -SanaM, AveSaH -SanaM, samAveSaH, veSaH -SanaM, vezaRaM, veSikA, pratihAraRaM. — (Door, gate) dvAraM, dvAravartma n. (n), muKaM, gfhamuKaM, niHsaraRaM, pratIhAraH, paTaH; ‘principal entrance,’ siMhadvAraM; ‘private entrance,’ pracCannadvAraM.
ENTRANCED , p. p. (Put in a trance) mUrcCitaH -tA -taM, mUrcCApannaH -nnA -nnaM. — (Enraptured) sammohitaH -tA -taM, mohaprAptaH -ptA -ptaM, paramaharzamo- -hitaH -tA -taM.

ENTRAP: (1) baDnAti (banD, c. 9.) (when the meaning is clear) by means of nets, hooks, and other devices for e. ping fish: jAlavaqiSapraBftiBirmatsya- banDanopAyEH, Sa v.;(2) pASe pAtayati (c. of pat): v. To ensnare.

To ENTRAP , v. a. unmATe or pASe pat in caus. (pAtayati -yituM), jAle pAtayitvA banD (c. 9. baDnAti, banDuM) or Df (c. 1. Darati, DarttuM) or grah (c. 9. gfhlAti, grahItuM), praluB in caus. (-loBayati -yituM).
ENTRAPPED , p. p. unmATe pAtitaH -tA -taM, pASabadDaH -dDA -dDaM, jAlabadDaH -dDA -dDaM.

Entreat, v. t. aBi-pra-arT 10 A, anunI 1 P, vinayena-sAMjali-yAc 1 A or arTa, pra-sad c., savinayaM nivid c. [Entreat]ing, a. sAnunaya, savinaya, sAMjali. [Entreat]y, s. prArTanaM-nA, aByarTanA, yAcanA, vinati f., arTitA, anunayaH; sAMjaliprArTanA.
ENTREAT: upacCandayati (Cand, c. 10.), R. v. 58: v. To beg, implore.

To ENTREAT , v. a. aYjaliM kftvA prArT (c. 10. -arTayati -te -yituM), samprArT, aByarT; vinayena or kftAYjalivat prArT or yAc (c. 1. yAcati -cituM), aBiyAc, prayAc, samprayAc; prasad (c. 10. -sAdayate -ti -yituM), vinI (c. 1. -nayati -netuM), vinayena svArTaM nivid (c. 10. -vedayati -yituM).
ENTREATED , p. p. aYjalikarmmapUrvvaM prArTitaH -tA -taM or aByarTitaH -tA -taM, vinayena yAcitaH -tA -taM, prasAditaH -tA -taM, anunItaH -tA -taM.
ENTREATY: (1) aByarTanA or prArTanA, by e. s, by advice: aByarTanABiScopadeSESca, K.(2) yAcYA: v. Request.
ENTREATY , s. prArTanaM -nA, aByarTanA, arTaH, arTitvaM -tA, yAcanA, vinatiH f., mArgaRaM, vinayena nivedanaM.
Entrench, v. t. See Encroach. 2 pari-KayA rakz 1 P.
ENTREPOT: vARijyasTAnam (?)
Entrust, v. t. nikzip 6 P, A-samA-ruh c. (ropayati), niviS c., nyas 4 U, nyAsIkf 8 U (with loc.); pratipad c., dA 3 U, f c. (arpayati) (with dat.).

ENTRUST (v. t.): nikzipati (kzip, c. 6.), should e. all work to him: tasmin sarvakAryARi nikzipet, M. vii. 59; is the secret you were entrusted with kept: rakzyate BavatA rahasyanikzepaH, V. ii.; (2) nyasyati, vi-, (as, c. 4.) or nyAsIkaroti (with sim. cons.), e. ing wife to sons: sutavinyastapatnIkaH, Y.; (3) ni-daDAti or Datte (DA, c. 3.) (with sim cons.), K. b.;(4) niveSayati (c. of viS) (rare), all work was e. ed to you: tvayi niveSitasarvakAryaH, Mu. v.

ENTRY: I The act of entering: praveSaH, -nam, on (your) e.: praveSe, R. vi. 24: getting an e. with diifficultydifficulty: kaTamapi labDapraveSaH, Va.II A passage for entering: praveSaH: v. Entrance (III), passage.III That which is entered: expr. by verb: this is an erroneous e.: *idamBramAnniveSitam; to make an e. of: v. Enter (II).
ENTRY , s. (Passage for entrance) dvAraM, dvAravartma n. (n), gamanAga- -manapaTaH. — (Ingress) praveSaH -SanaM. — (Committing to writing) aBiliKanaM, leKyAropaRaM, pustakAropaRaM, samAropaRaM.
Entwine, v. t. graMT 9 P, ud-graMT, gu(guM)P 6 P, virac 10; See Encircle also.
ENTWINE (v.): pari-vezwayati (vezw, c. 10.) (= to encircle, surround: q. v.).
Enucleate, v. t. vi-pari-SuD c., spazwIkf 8 U.
To ENUCLEATE , v. a. spazwIkf, vyaktIkf, viSuD in caus. (-SoDayati -yituM), pariSuD.

Enumerate, v. t. pari-kFt 10; pari-, saMKyA 2 P, kaT 10; pari-vi-gaR 10, yaTAkramaM KyA or nirdiS 6 P. [Enumerat]ion, s. pari-, saMKyAnaM, ga-RanaM-nA, parikIrtanaM, AKyAnaM, kaTanaM, ekE-kaSaH nirdeSaH.
ENUMERATE: I To count: saMKyAti (KyA, c. 2.).II To recount, mention: q. v. AKyAti (KyA, c. 2.), e. the kings of England: *iMlaRqe- SvarARAM nAmAni kaTaya.

To ENUMERATE , v. a. saMKyA (c. 2. -KyAti -tuM), sampariKyA, parisaMKyA, pramaMKyA; parigaR (c. 10. -gaRayati -yituM), vigaR, pragaR, gaR; anupUrvvaSas or ekEkaSas or yaTAkramaM or pfTak pfTak KyA, uddiS (c. 6. -diSati -dezwuM), samuddiS nirdiS.
ENUMERATED , p. p. parisaMKyAtaH -tA -taM, parigaRitaH -tA -taM, uddizwaH -zwA -zwaM, samuddizwaH -zwA -zwaM, ekEkaSaH or pratyekaM kaTitaH -tA -taM or nirdizwaH -zwA -zwaM, anukrAntaH -ntA -ntaM.
ENUMERATION: AKyAnam. v. Mention, recital.
ENUMERATION , s. parisaMKyA -KyAnaM, saMKyA, gaRanaM -nA, parigaRanA, samuddeSaH, ekEkaSo nirdeSaH.

Enunciate, v. t. lakzaRaM-svarUpaM-kaT or varR 10; uccar c., udIr c., udAhf 1 P, kFt 10, Guz 10, nivid c., vijYA c. (jYApayati). [Enunciat]ion, s. uccAraRaM, udIraRaM, udAharaRaM, parisaM-KyAnaM, prakIrtanaM, vijYApanaM; svarUpavarRanaM-nA. [Enunciat]ive, a. KyApaka, uccAraka.
ENUNCIATE: I To predicate: lakzaRaM or rUpaM kaTayati (kaT, c. 10.).II To pronounce: q. v.: uccArayati (c. of car).
To ENUNCIATE , v. a. uccar in caus. (-cArayati -yituM), udIr (c. 10. -Irayati -yituM), samudIr, udAhf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM), praKyA (c. 2. -KyAti -tuM), kFt (c. 10. kIrttayati -yituM), prakFt.
ENUNCIATED , p. p. uccAritaH -tA -taM, udIritaH -tA -taM, udAhftaH -tA -taM.
ENUNCIATION: I Predication: lakzaRa- or rUpa- kaTanam.II Mode of utterance: uccAraRam.III A declaration: uktiH.
ENUNCIATION , s. uccAraRaM, udIraRaM, udAharaRaM, vyAhAraH -haraRaM, samudAharaRaM, KyApanaM, vijYApanaM, prakIrttanaM, prakASanaM, GozaRA.
ENUNCIATIVE , a. uccArakaH -kA -kaM, KyApakaH -kA -kaM, AvedakaH -kA -kaM.

Envelop, v. t. avaguMW 10, A-pari-vezw 1 A or c., A-pari-vf 5 U or c., A-pari-saM-Cad 10, piDA 3 U. 2 koSe niDA or niviS c. s. koSaH zaH, AvezwanaM, piDAnaM, puwaH, AcCA-danaM, avaguMWanaM. 2 prAvAraH, pracCadapawaH.

ENVELOP (v.): (1) guRWayati, ava-, (guRW, c. 10.) (= to veil), e. ed in nocturnal darkness: rajanI- timirAvaguRWitaH (tA, taM), Ku.;(2) pari-vfRoti or vArayati (vf, c. 5. and 10.) (= to enclose), e. ing the whole Lankā: laNkAM samastAM parivArya, Ram.: v. Also to encircle, conceal.
ENVELOP (subs.): *patravezwanam.

To ENVELOP , v. a. AvezW (c. 1. -vezwate -zwituM), parivezw, saMvezw, ACad (c. 10. -CAdayati -yituM), pariCad, samACad, praCad, pratiCad, saMCad; [Page233-b+ 51] parivf (c. 5. -vfRoti -varituM -rItuM), Avf; piDA (c. 3. -daDAti -DAtuM), koSena parivezw.
ENVELOPE , s. koSaH, kozaH, AvezwanaM, parivezwanaM, vezwanaM, pracCadapawaH, prAvAraH, prAvaraRaM, vAsanaM, piDAnaM, puwaH, AcCAdanaM, nicolaH, avaguRWanaM.
ENVELOPED , p. p. vezwitaH -tA -taM, AvezwitaH -tA -taM, parivezwitaH -tA -taM, koSasTaH -sTA -sTaM, vAsanasTaH -sTA -sTaM, parItaH -tA -taM, avaguRWitaH -tA -taM.
Envenom, v. t. vizeRa dih 2 U or aMj 7 P or lip 6 P; saviza a. kf 8 U. [Envenom]ed, a. saviza, vizadigDa, vizAkta.
ENVENOM (v.): I Lit.: vizeRa limpati (lip, c. 6.) or degDi (dih, c. 2.) or anakti (Yj, c. 2.). II Fig.: e. ed glance: vizeRa digDaH kawAkzaH, Ma.; “e. ed tongue of calumny”: vizAktA piSunajihvA.
To ENVENOM , v. a. vizeRa lip (c. 6. limpati, leptuM) or dih (c. 2. degDi -gDuM) or aYj (c. 7. anakti, aMktuM) or saMsfj (c. 6. -sfjati -srazwuM), savizaM -zAM -zaM kf.
ENVENOMED , p. p. vizAktaH -ktA -ktaM, vizaliptaH -ptA -ptaM, vizapradigDaH -gDA -gDaM, savizaH -zA -zaM, garalI -linI -li(n); ‘envenomed shaft,’ digDaH.
ENVIABLE: spfhaRIyaH (yA, yaM), of e. prowess: spfhaRIyavIryaH, Ku. iii. 20.
ENVIABLE , a. IrzpaRIyaH -yA -yaM, IrzpotpAdakaH -kA -kaM, loByaH -ByA -ByaM, spfhaRIyaH -yA -yaM, prArTanIyaH -yA -yaM, AkAMkzaRIyaH -yA -yaM.
ENVIED , p. p. IrzitaH -tA -taM, IrzpitaH -tA -taM, aBilazitaH -tA -taM, sparDitaH -tA -taM.
ENVIER: (1) Irzyin (m.);(2) asUyakaH:(3) matsarin (m.).
ENVIER , s. IrzyI m. (n), asUyakaH, aByasUyakaH, parakalyARAsahanaH.

ENVIOUS: (1) Irzyin (f. RI), e., hateful, discon- tented: IrzyI GfRyasantuzwaH, H.;(2) matsarin (f. RI), e. of others' rise: paravfdDimatsarin (f. RI), Si.; sAByasUyaH (yA, yaM);(4) IrzyAlu (mfn.);(5) asUyAparItaH (tA, taM); etc.

ENVIOUS , a. IrzyI -rzyiRI -rzyi (n), IrzyAluH -luH -lu, IrzyakaH -kA -kaM, serzyaH -rzyA -rzyaM, matsaraH -rA -raM -rI -riRI -ri (n), samatsaraH -rA -raM, paraDanamatsaraH -rA -raM, paraDanABilAzukaH -kA -kaM, paraguRamatsaraH -rA -raM, parotkarzAsahanaH -nA -naM, parapraSaMsAsahizRuH -zRuH -zRu, sparDI -rDinI -rDi (n), sAByasUyaH -yA -yaM, kfterzyaH -rzyA -rzyaM, saYjAterzyaH -rzyA -rzyaM, kuhanaH -nA -naM, bIBatsuH -tsuH -tsu, spfhayAluH -luH -lu, aBilAzI -ziRI -zi (n), paraSuBAmarzaRaH -RA -RaM.
ENVIOUSLY: (1) serzyam;(2) sAByasUyam;(3) samatsaram.
ENVIOUSLY , adv. serzyaM, sAsUyaM, samatsaraM, samAtsaryyaM, sAByasUyaM.
Environ, v. t. parivezw 1 A or c., parikzip 6 P; See Encircle. (‘E(nviron)s’)s. parisaraH, upAMtaH, aByAsaH, upapuraM, nagaropAMtaH-taM.
ENVIRON (v.): parivfRoti (vf, c. 5.): v. En- -compass.
To ENVIRON , v. a. parivezw (c. 1. -vezwate -zwituM), parivf (c. 5. -vfRoti -varituM -rItuM), Avf, parizWA (c. 1. -tizWati -zWAtuM). See ENCOMPASS.
ENVIRONED , p. p. parivezwitaH -tA -taM, parivftaH -tA -taM, AvftaH -tA -taM, parigataH -tA -taM, parItaH -tA -taM, valayitaH -tA -taM, vyAptaH -ptA -ptaM.
ENVIRONS: parisarAH or parisaravizayAH (m. pl.): v. Suburbs.
ENVIRONS , s. (Of a town) nagaropAntaM, upanagaraM, upapuraM, parisaraH.
Envoy, s. dUtaH, saMdeSa-vArtA-haraH, nisfzwArTaH; rAjapratiniDiH.
ENVOY: dUtaH: v. Ambassador.
ENVOY , s. dUtaH, rAjadUtaH, santrI m. (n), sandeSaharaH, vArttAharaH, nisfzwArTaH, kAryyaNkaraH, rAjacAraH, rAjapratiniDiH m.

Envy, v. t. asUyati (D.), Irzy 1 P (with dat.); parotkarzaM na sah 1 A or mfz 4 P, 10, paradravyaM aBilaz, 1, 4 P or luB 4 P; sparD 1 A; ‘I e(nvy) you your prosperity’ tvadutkarzAsahizRurahaM. 2 (In a good sense) spfh 10 (with dat.). s. asUyA, aByasU-yA, IrzyA, mAtsaryaM, matsaraH, akzAMti f., a-sahizRutA; amarzaRaM; paraDanABilAzaH. [Envi]able, a. spfhaRIya, AkAMkzaRIya. 2 IrzyaRIya, loBya. [Envi]er, s. asUyakaH, matsarin m., Irzyin m. [Envi]ous, a. Irzyin, serzya, samatsara, parotkarzA-sahana, asUyaka, matsarin, sAByasUya (with loc.); asahizRu in comp.; ‘e(nvious) of otherʼs happiness’ parasuKAsahizRu; oft. ex. by puroBAga in comp.; ‘e(nvious) of each otherʼs fame’ (prAyaH samAnavidyAH) parasparayaSaH-puroBAgAH (M. 1). [Envi]ously, adv. serzyaM, sAByasUyaM, samatsaraM, sAsUyaM.

ENVY (subs.): (1) IrzyA: v. Jealousy;(2) aBi-asUyA, who has created yours e.: kenAByasUyA te janitA, Ku.;(3) mAtsaryam, whose minds are vitiated with the feeling of e.: mAtsaryarAgopahatAtman (mfn.), Ki.

ENVY (v.): I In bad sense:(1) asUyati, aBi-, (nomi.) (with dat.);(2) Irzyati, (Irzya, c. 1.) (rare: with dat.);(3) better by subs.II In good sense; spfhayati, -te (spfh, c. 10.) (with dat.), I e. the king Daśaratha: spfhayAmi rAjYe daSaraTAya, Vi.

To ENVY , v. a. Irzy (c. 1. Irzyati -rzyituM), Irkzy (c. 1. Ikzryati -rkzyituM), spfh (c. 10. spfhayati -yituM), sparD (c. 1. sparDate -rDituM), asUya (nom. asUyati -te -yituM), aByasUya, paradravyam aBilaz (c. 1. -lazati, c. 4. -lazpati -zituM), parotkarzaM na sah (c. 1. sahate, soQuM) or na mfz (c. 4. mfzyati, marzituM), pnAtsaryyaM kf.

ENVY , s. IrzyA, asUyA, mAtsaryyaM, matsaraH -ratA, sparDA, sparDatA, akzAntiH f., amarzaH, parimarzaH, rAgaH, dvezaH, IrzA, spfhA, paraDanABilApaH, parotkarzA- -sahizRutA, anyaguRAsahizRutA, anyaSuBadvezaH, parapraSaMsAyA asahizRutA.
EOLUS , s. (God of the winds) pavanadevatA, vAyudevatA.
EPACT: annual e.: sUryacandravatsarAntaram; monthly e.: arkacandramAsAntaram.
EPACT , s. kAlagaRakaBAzAyAM sOravatsarAvasAne amAvasyAH praBfti tiTisaM- KyAsUcakaH SabdaH or Sabdo yena cAndravatsarAt sOravatsarADikyaM sUcyate.
Epaulet, s. skaMDABaraRaM, aMsAlaMkAraH.
EPAULET: skanDABaraRam, and sim. comp. s. (?).
EPAULET , s. skanDABaraRaM, sEnikajanEH skanDadeSe BftaH padasUcako'laNkAraH, aMSAlaNkAraH, aMSABaraRaM.
Ephemeral, a. kzaRaBaMgura, kzaRaviDvaMsin, kza-Rika (kI f.). 2 EkAhika (kI f.).
EPHEMERAL: I Diurnal: q. v.II Short- -lived: kzaRaBaNguraH (rA, raM): v. Transient.
EPHEMERAL , a. EkAhikaH -kI -kaM, kzaRaviDvaMsI -sinI -si (n), utpannavinASI -SinI -Si (n), kzaRaBaNguraH -rA -raM, ekAhamAtrasTAyI -yinI -yi (n).

sanskrit.slp1: pustakaM yasmin nakzatrARAM gatiBAvAdi pratidinam Aropyate
sanskrit.word: पुस्तकं यस्मिन् नक्षत्राणां गतिभावादि प्रतिदिनम् आरोप्यते
sanskrit.iast: pustakaṃ yasmin nakṣatrāṇāṃ gatibhāvādi pratidinam āropyate

details.body: EPHEMERIS , s. AhnikavyavahArapustakaM, dEvasikavfttAntapustakaM. — (In astro- nomy) pustakaM yasmin nakzatrARAM gatiBAvAdi pratidinam Aropyate.
EPHOD: parikaraH (?) v. Girdle.
EPHOR: *paridarSakaH. E. -alty: *paridarSakatvam.
Epic, s. vIracaritavarRanaM, mahAkAvyaM, vIra-puruzetihAsaH.
EPIC: Ph.: e. poem: mahAkAvyam; e. poet: mahAkAvya- leKakaH; etc.
EPIC , a. EtihAsikaH -kI -kaM, vIracaritrakaTakaH -kA -kaM, kATikaH -kI -kaM, SUravfttAntavizayaH -yA -yaM, mahAkAvyasambanDI -nDinI -nDi (n).
EPIC , s. (Poem) sahAkAvyaM, itihAsaH, vIracaritravizayaM kAvyaM.
Epicene, a. strIpulliMga, sADAraRaliMga.
EPICENE: strIpuMliNgaH (NgA, NgaM)
EPICENE , a. sAmAnyaliNgaH -NgA -NgaM, sADAraRaliNgaH -NgA -NgaM.
Epicure, Epicurean, a. udaraparAyaRa; Bo-janacaMcu, udaraMBari, lolupa; vizayAsakta, iM-driyasuKanirata, vizayin. Epicurism, s. vizayasevA, vizayAsakti f., iMdriyasuKAnurAgaH.
EPICURE: BojanacaYcuH, Vet.: vizayAsaktacetas (mfn.) (= sensualist: q. v.).

EPICURE , a. mizwAnnavyaYjanAdizu prasaktaH, sarvvAnnarasajYaH, svAdvannABilAzI m. (n), udaraparAyaRaH, kukzimBariH m., lolupaH, atiloBI m. (n), rasikaH, vEzayikaH, vizayAsaktaH, vizayasevI m. (n), pAtresamitaH.
EPICUREAN , a. vizayI -yiRI -yi (n), SArIrikasuKasevI -vinI -vi (n), vEzayikaH -kI -kaM, BogaparAyaRaH -RA -RaM.
EPICURIAN: I Lit.: *epikOrIyaH (yA, yaM).II Luxurious: viSizwaH (zwA, zwaM).III Given to indulgence:(1) indriyasuKanirataH (tA, taM); (2) vizayAsaktaH (ktA, ktaM).
EPICURISM , s. vizayopasevA, vizayAsaktiH f., SArIrikasuKAnurAgaH.
Epicycle, s. prAkcakraM, pariDiH.
EPICYCLE , s. (In astronomy) prAk cakraM, pariDiH m.
Epidemic, [Epidemic]al, a. vyApaka, sarvatraga, bahujana-sADAraRa (RI f.); saMcArin; ‘e(pidemic) disease’ mAraH-rI, mahAmArI. s. janapadodDvaMsaH.
EPIDEMIC: I Adj.: vyApaka (f. pikA).II Subs.: vyApakavyADiH; mAriH (= pestilence).

EPIDEMIC , EPIDEMICAL, a. deSasADAraRaH -RA -RI -RaM, sarvvatragaH -gA -gaM, bahujanasAmAnyaH -nyA -nyaM; ‘disease,’ mArI, mAraH -riH f., mahAmArI, marakaH, mArakaH, AtaYcanaM, sannipAtakaH, upasargaH.
Epidermis, s. bAhyatvac f., bAhyacarman n.
EPIDERMIS , s. vAhyatvak f. (c), vahistvak, vAhyacarmma n., (n), avaBAsinI.
Epiglottis, s. upa-prati-ali-jihvA, GaMwikA.
EPIGLOTTIS: upajihvA; pratijihvA, alijihvA.
EPIGLOTTIS , s. upajihvA, alijihvA, pratijihvA, GaRwikA, SuRqikA.
Epigram, s. kzudrakavitA, laGukAvya.
EPIGRAM: kzudrakavitA (?).
EPIGRAM , s. abahuSlokaparimARaM rasikakAvyaM, sarasaM laGukAvyaM.
EPIGRAMMATIC, -AL: I Lit.: expr. by comp. II Concise, pointed: q. v.; laGu (mfn.).
EPIGRAMMATICAL , a. pUrvvoktalaGukavitAyogyaH -gyA -gyaM, rasikakavitAsa- -mbanDI -nDinI -nDi (n). — (Pointed) rasikaH -kA -kaM, rasavAn -vatI -vat (t), sarasaH -sA -saM.
EPIGRAMMATIST: kzudrakavitAleKakaH (?).
EPIGRAMMATIST , s. pUrvvoktarasikakavitAkarttA m. (rttf), laDukAvyaracakaH.
Epigraph, s. pAzARa-SilA-leKaH.
Epilepsy, s. apasmAraH, BrAmaraM. Epileptic, a. apasmArin, BrAmarin; ‘an e(pileptic) fit’ apasmArAkramaH.
EPILEPSY: (1) apasmAraH;(2) BrAmaram.
EPILEPSY , s. apasmAraH, grahAmayaH, BrAmaraM, BUtavikriyA, pratAnaH, mUrcCAvAyuH m.
EPILEPTIC: (1) apasmArin (f. RI), Si.;(2) BrAmarin (f. RI).
EPILEPTIC , a. apasmArI -riRI -ri (n), BrAmarI -riRI -ri (n), vAtagrastaH -stA -staM, vAyugrastaH -stA -staM, grahAmayapIqitaH -tA -taM, AkfzwaH -zwA -zwaM.
Epilogue, s. upasaMhAraH.
EPILOGUE: upasaMhAraH.
EPILOGUE , s. antavAkyaM, SezavAkyaM, antyavacanaM, samApakavAkyaM, samApanavacanaM.
EPINICION , s. jayagItaM, jayaSabdaH.
EPIPHANY: I Lit.: AvirBAvaH: v. Appearance. II A festival: *AvirBAvaparvan (n.).
EPIPHANY , s. KrIzwaprakASanaM, KrIzwaprakASanamuddiSya KrIzwajanmaparvvaRaH paraM dvAdaSadine sevito mahotsavaH, KrIzwaprakASanaparvva n. (n).
Episcopacy, s. DarmADyakzatA, DarmADyakzADikAraH.
EPISCOPACY , s. DarmmADyakzatA -tvaM, DarmmADyakzADipatyaM, DarmmADyakzADikAraH, DarmmAGyakzakarttfkA KrIzwIyasamAjanItiH f.
EPISCOPAL: expr. by comp., e. jurisdiction: *praDAnAcAryADikAraH; e. church: AcAryaDarma- mandiram.
EPISCOPAL , EPISCOPALIAN, a. DarmmADyakzasambanDI -nDinI -nDi (n), DarmmA- -DyakzaSAsitaH -tA -taM, DarmmADyakzapAlitaH -tA -taM.
EPISCOPALLY: *praDAnAcAryEH (ins. pl.).
EPISCOPATE: I A bishopric: q. v.II The body of bishops: *praDAnAcAryavargaH.
EPISCOPATE , s. DarmmADyakzADikAraH, DarmmADyakzADipatyaM, DarmmADyakzapadaM.
Episode, s. upAKyAnaM, upakaTA, prAsaMgikavAkyaM, AKyAnaM, kaTA. [Episod]ic, [Episod]ical, a. prAsaMgi-ka (kI f.), aprastuta, aprakfta.
EPISODE: upAKyAnam; upakaTA.
EPISODE , s. upAKyAnaM, upakaTA, prasaNgavAkyaM, prAsaNgikavAkyaM, patAkA, mUlavizayavahirgatA kaTA.
EPISODIC , EPISODICAL, a. prAsaNgikaH -kI -kaM, mUlavizayAnanvitaH -tA -taM, prastutavizayavahirgataH -tA -taM, ananvitaH -tA -taM, aprastutaH -tA -taM.
Epispastic, a. sPowajanaka.
EPISPASTIC . a. tvaksPowotpAdakaH -kA -kaM, sPowakArI -riRI -ri (n).
Epistle, s. patraM, leKaH, leKyaM; ‘epistolary correspondence’ patreRa saMvAdaH.
EPISTLE: patram: v. Letter.
EPISTLE , s. patraM, leKaH, leKyaM, patrikA, patrI, saMvAdapatraM, sandeSapatraM, lipiH f.
EPISTOLARY: expr. by patram, e. style: *patrarItiH, e. correspondence: *patrasaMvAdaH.
EPISTOLARY , a. patrI -triRI -tri (n), patrIyaH -yA -yaM, leKyakaH -kA -kaM.
Epitaph, s. mftyuleKaH, cEtyopalipi f., smaraRamaMqanaM.
EPITAPH: *smaraRamaRqanam: v. Inscription.
EPITAPH , s. cEtyasya upariliKitaM mftajanamuddiSya stutivAkyaM, cEtyopari liKitA tatrEva niKAtajanamuddiSya guRastutiH, cEtyalipiH f., cEtyoparisTA lipiH.
Epithalamium, s. vivAhagItaM.
EPITHALAMIUM: (1) maNgalagItam;(2) vivAhagItam.
EPITHALAMIUM , s. vEvAhikagItaM, OdvAhikagItaM, vivAhasamaye mANgalikagItaM.
Epithem, s. pralepaH, upa-nAhaH-dehaH.
EPITHEM , s. utkArikA, upadehaH, upanAhaH, pralepaH, lepaH.
Epithet, s. viSezaRaM, upADiH.
EPITHET: viSezaRam, V.
EPITHET , s. viSezaRaM -zakaH -kaM, saMjYAvizayaH, sambudDiH f., upADiH m., guRAguRavAcakaH SabdaH.
Epitome, s. saMkzepaH, sAraH, saMgrahaH, samAhAraH, samasanaM. [Epitom]ize, v. t. saMkzip 6 P, samas 4 U, saMgrah 9 U, saMhf 1 P. [Epitom]izer, [Epitom]ist, s. saM-kzeptf m., saMgrahakartf m.
EPITOME: (1) sArasaMgrahaH;(2) saMkzepaH (=abrid- -ment).
EPITOME , s. saMkzepaH -paRaM, saNgrahaH, sArasaNgrahaH, sAraH, saMhitA, pratyAhAraH, samAhAraH, samAhftiH f., samasanaM.
EPITOMIST: sArasaMgrahakaraH; saMkzeptf (m.) (=abrid- -ger).
EPITOMIZE: (1) sArasaMgrahaM karoti;(2) saMkzipati (kzip, c. 6.) (= to abridge);(3) samasyati (as, c. 4.) (= 2.).
To EPITOMIZE , v. a. saMkzip (c. 6. -kzipati -kzeptuM), saMhf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM), upasaMhf.
EPITOMIZED , p. p. saMkziptaH -ptA -ptaM, sAMkzepikaH -kI -kaM, samastaH -stA -staM, sAmAsikaH -kI -kaM, saMhftaH -tA -taM, upasaMhftaH -tA -taM, cumbakaH -kA -kaM.
EPITOMIZER , EPITOMIST, s. saMkzeptA m. (ptf), saNgrahakarttA m. (rttf), sAraleKakaH.
Epoch, s. kAlaH, yugaM, avaDiH, nirRItakAlaH. 2 viSizwakAlaH. 3 SAkaH, SakaH.
EPOCH: (1) kAlaH (= time);(2) yugam (=age).

EPOCH , EPOCHA, s. (A fixed era from which computation of years begin) DruvaH, SAkaH, SakaH, saMvat indec. The era of Śālivāhana is called SAkaH, that of Vikramāditya, saMvat. — (Any period or fixed time) kAlaH, kAlAvaDiH m., avaDiH m., nirRItakAlaH.
Epode, s. upagItaM-gAnaM.
EPODE: kAvyaviSezaH.
EPODE , s. upagItaM, upagAnaM, aDigItaM, aparagItaM, gItAnubanDaH.
EPOPEE , s. mahAkAvyaM, vIracaritravizayaM kAvyaM.
EPULATION , s. utsavakaraRaM, utsavaH, mizwAnnaBojanaM.
Eq ACIOUz, a. BakzakaH -kA -kaM, KAdakaH -kA -kaM, BojI -jinI -ji (n), admaraH -rA -raM, GasmaraH -rI -raM, praGasaH -sA -saM, bahuBuka. m. (j), bahvASI -SinI -Si (n), BojanalubDaH -bDA -bDaM.
EQUABILITY: samatA: v. Evenness, equanimity.
Equable, a. samAna, nirvikAra, samacitta-vftti-BAva.
EQUABLE: samaH (mA, maM), e. -tempered: samavfttiH, Ki.: v. Even, uniform.
EQUABLE , a. samAnaH -nA -naM, nirvikAraH -rA -raM. — (In motion) samAna- -gatiH -tiH -ti. — (In temper) samaBAvaH -vI -vaM, samavfttiH -ttiH -tti, samacittaH -ttA -ttaM.
EQUABLY: samam: v. Evenly, uniformly.

Equal, a. sama, samAna, tulya, sadfSa (SI f.), pratima-saMkASa- in comp.; (with instr. or gen. of person); See Like; ‘to whom gold and a clod of earth are e(qual)’ sama-lozWakAMcanaH; the point of equality being in the instr. or loc.; samudreRa samo gAMBIrye-ryeRa; ‘to consider e(qual)’ tulayA Df 1 P. 2 anavara. 3 samavftti-citta, nirvikAra. 4 paryApta, alaM with inf. or dat.; kxp 1 A (with dat.); ‘he is e(qual) to the task’ tatkAryaM sADayitumalaM saH; rakzaRAya kalpate, &c. s. samAnapadasTaH, tulyapadaBAj m. 2 savayaskaH, savayasyaH, tulyavayas; oft. by (a.). v. t. tul 10 (tulayati), (prAsA-dAstvAM tulayitumalaM Me. 65) samI-tulyI-kf 8 U; oft. ex. by (a.); ‘none can e(qual) me in bravery’ na kopi SOryeRa mama samAnaH. [Equal]ity, s. sAmyaM, samAnatA, tulyatA, sAdfSyaM, &c. [Equal]ize, v. t. samIkf 8 U, tul 10. [Equal]ly, adv. samaM, sadfSaM, samAnaM, tulyaM.

EQUAL (adj.): I A like:(1) samaH (mA, maM), I do not see any one greater than or e. to Rāma: paSyAmi rAmAdaDikaM samaM vA nAnyam, B.; e. share: samaBAgaH, Da.;(2) samAnaH (nA, naM), e. in caste and number: samAnA jAtisaMKyayA, Da.; to (men) of e. valour, lineage, and manliness: samAnavIryAnvaya- pOruzezu, Ki.;(3) tulyaH (lyA, lyaM) (= match- -ing, like), of e. strength: tulyaSkti (mfn.), M. n.;(4) sadfSaH (SI, SaM) (= tulya), with those, who are not his e. s: anAtmasadfSezu, Mu.II Adequate:(1) samaH (mA, maM);(2) paryAptaH (ptA, ptaM) (= enough: q. v.).III Equitable: samaH (mA, maM).IV Indifferent: samaH (mA, maM) or samAnaH (nA, naM).
EQUAL (subs.): (1) expr. by adj.: samaH (mA, maM) or samAnaH (nA, naM), with e. s: samEH, H.; two e. s: samAnO, B.;(2) samAnajanaH, before e. s: samAna- janasamakzam, M. n.
EQUAL (v. t.): I To be e. to: expr. by adj., but does not e. me in penances: na tu tapasA me samaH, Vi.II To make e. to:(1) expr. by adj.; (2) samIkaroti or samAnIkaroti.

EQUAL , a. samaH -mA -maM, samAnaH -nA -naM, tulyaH -lyA -lyaM, samIyaH -yA -yaM, sadfSaH -SI -SaM, IdfSaH -SI -SaM. — (Not inferior) anavaraH -rA -raM, anavamaH -mA -maM. — (Even, uniform) samAnaH -nA -naM, samasTaH -sTA -sTaM, nirvikAraH -rA -raM, aYjasaH -sA -saM; ‘of equal extent or size,’ sammitaH -tA -taM, samamAtraH -trA -traM, tulyaparimARaH -RA -RaM; ‘equal to all,’ sarvvasamaH -mA -maM; ‘of equal strength,’ tulyabalaH -lA -laM; ‘equal in glory,’ samAnatejAH -jAH -jaH (s); ‘this is equal to a sixteenth part of that,’ etat tasya zoqaSAMSena samaM.
EQUAL , s. (Of the same age) samAnavayaskaH, samavayaskaH, savayAH m. (s), tulyavayAH m. (s), samAnajanmA m. (n), vayasyaH. — (Of the same rank) samAnapadasTaH, tulyapadasTaH.
To EQUAL , v. a. samIkf, samAnIkf, tulpIkf, samAna (nom. samAnayati -yituM), samAnaM -nAM -naM kf, tulyaM -lyAM -lyaM kf.
EQUALITY: I Lit.:(1) sAByam, bearing e. with the thunder of Jupiter: aSaninA maGonaH sAmyaM gataH, Ki.;(2) samAnatA;(3) tulyatA.II Evenness: tulyatA.III Uniformity: samatA.
EQUALITY , s. samatA, sAmyaM, samAnatA, tulyatA -tvaM, sAmAnyaM, sAmyatA, pratiyogitA. — (In rank) samAnapadaM, tulyapadaM. — (In tribe) savarRatA.
EQUALIZATION: (1) samIkaraRam;(2) samAnIkaraRam.
EQUALIZATION , s. samIkaraRaM, samAnIkaraRaM, tulpatvaM, samAnatA.
EQUALIZE: (1) samIkaroti;(2) samAnIkaroti; (3) by adj. v. Equal.
To EQUALIZE , v. a. samIkf, samAnIkf, tul (c. 10. tulayati -yituM). See To EQUAL.
EQUALIZED , p. p. samIkftaH -tA -taM, samAnIkftaH -tA -taM, tulitaH -tA -taM.
EQUALLY: (1) samaM or samAnam, treats his servants e.: samaM Bftyezu vartate, P.;(2) tulyam;(3) sadfSam; (4) by adj., the battle was e. matched: tulya- pratidvandvi baBUva yudDam, R.
EQUALLY , adv. samaM, samAnaM, samAnatas, tulyavat, sAmyatas, sAmAnyena.
EQUANIMITY: (1) samatA, by e.: samatayA, R. ix. 6.;(2) samavfttitA;(3) samaBAvaH;(4) samacittatA.
EQUANIMITY , s. samacittatvaM, samabudDitA, samaBAvaH, samAnavfttiH f., sarvvasamatA, sattvasampannatA, sattvaM, sampadApador harzavizAdarAhityaM.
Equanimous, a. samacitta-BAva-vftti, nirvi-kAra. Equanimity, s. samavfttitA-cittatA, samaBAvaH, samAnavftti f.

EQUANIMOUS , a. samacittaH -ttA -ttaM, samabudDiH -dDiH -dDi, samaBAvaH -vI -vaM, samavfttiH -ttiH -tti, sattvasampannaH -nnA -nnaM, satyasampannaH -nnA -nnaM, sampadA- -pador harzavizAdarahitaH -tA -taM, nirvikAraH -rA -raM.
Equate, v. t. samIkf 8 U. [Equa]tion, s. samIkaraRaM, sAmyaM.
EQUATION: samIkaraRam, quadratic e.: vargasamIkaraRam, Vij.
EQUATION , s. (In algebra) samIkriyA, samIkaraRaM, sAmyaM, PalaM; ‘of unknown quantity,’ avyaktasAmyaM; ‘unlimited equation,’ ekasamIkaraRaM.
Equator, s. BUkakzA, pariDiH, nirakzaH; ‘celestial e(quator)’ vyomakakzA. [Equator]ial, a. nirakza in comp.; ‘e(quatorial) region’ nirakzadeSaH.
EQUATOR: I Terrestrial:(1) BUpariDiH;(2) BUkakzA.II Celestial:(1) vyomakakzA and sim. comp.s.;(2) AkASapariDiH, Gan.
EQUATOR , s. nirakzaH, BUcakraM, BUpariDiH m., BUgolareKA; ‘equatorial region,’ nirakzadeSaH; ‘celestial equator,’ nAqimaRqalaM, nAqImaRqalaM. See EQUINOCTIAL LINE.
EQUATOR , s. (Terrestrial) vizuvavfttaM, vizuvareKA, vizuvacakraM, vizuvamaRqalaM, vizuvadvfttaM, BUmaDyareKA; ‘radius of equator,’ BUkaraRaH. — (Celes- tial) nAqIvfttaM.
EQUATORIAL: Ph.: e. region: nirakzadeSaH, Go.
EQUATORIAL , a. nirakzasambanDI -nDinI -nDi (n), BUcakrasambanDI, &c.
EQUERRY, EQUERY: I A stable:(1) mandurA; (2) vAjiSAlA;(3) aSvaSAlA.II An officer: mandurApAlaH, K.
Equery, s. maMdurA, aSva-vAji-SAlA. 2 aSvapAlaH.
EQUERY , EQUERRY, s. rAjASvapAlaH, rAjASvaSAlArakzaRe niyukto janaH. — (Stable for horses) aSvaSAlA, vAjiSAlA.
Equestrian, a. aSvIya, ASvika (kI f.). s. ASvikaH, aSvArohaH.
EQUESTRIAN (subs.): aSvavAraH: v. Horseman.
EQUESTRIAN (adj.): I Pertaining to horse: (1) aSvIyaH (yA, yaM);(2) ASva (f. SvA);(3) ASvikaH (kI, kaM).II Pertaining to horse- -men: expr. by tat. comp.
EQUESTRIAN , a. ASvaH -SvI -SvaM, ASvikaH -kI -kaM, aSvIyaH -yA -yaM, turagI -giRI -gi (n); ‘person on horseback,’ aSvArUQaH, aSvA- -rohI m. (n).
Equiangular, a. samakoRa, samAnAstra.
EQUIANGULAR: (1) samakoRaH (RA, RaM);(2) samAnAsra (f. srA); etc.
EQUIANGULAR , a. samakoRaH -RA -RaM, samAnAsraH -srA -sraM, tulyakoRaH -RA -RaM.
Equidistant, a. samAnAMtara.
EQUIDISTANT: (1) samadUraH (rA, raM);(2) samAnAntaraH (rA, raM); etc.
EQUIDISTANT , a. samAntaraH -rA -raM, tulyAntaraH -rA -raM, samAntarasTaH -sTA -sTaM.
Equilateral, a. samaBuja.
EQUILATERAL: samaBujaH (jA, jaM). E. triangle: samatriBujaH; e. pentagon: samapaYcaBujaH; and so on.
EQUILATERAL , a. samaBujaH -jA -jaM, samAnabAhuH -huH -hu, samapArSvaH -rSvA- -rSvaM; ‘an equilateral triangle,’ samatriBujaH.
Equilibrium, s. tulyatA, samatA, sAmyaM. 2 tulyaBAratA, samatolanaM; samAnaBaratvaM; ‘to be in e(quilibrium)’ tulya a. BU, tulayA Df pass. sa-mAnaBAra a. BU.
EQUILIBRIUM: samaDftiH (?); V. s. To be in e.: (1) samaDftaH (tA, taM);(2) tulADftaH (tA, taM) (?).
EQUILIBRIUM , s. tulyatA, BAratulyatA, samatolatvaM, tulyabalatvaM, parimARa- -tulyatA, samatA, sAmyaM.
EQUILIBRIUM , s. tulAsAmyaM, tulAsamatA, samAnagurutvaM.
Equine, a. aSvIya, aSvasaMbaMDin.
EQUINOCTIAL: vizuvIyaH (yA, yaM). The e. line: (1) vizuvareKA;(2) vizuvacakram;(3) vizuvadvfttam, Su. The e. sun: vizuvasTo divAkaraH, Su. E. point: ayanam.

EQUINOCTIAL , a. vizuvIyaH -yA -yaM, vizuvasambanDI -nDinI -nDi (n); ‘equinoctial line,’ vizuvacakraM, vizumaRqalaM, vizuvadvfttaM, vizuvareKA, BUcakraM, BUpariDiH m., nAqImaRqalaM; ‘equinoctial point,’ ayanaM.
EQUINOCTIAL , (Point) golasanDiH m., vizuvaM, krAntipAtaH.

Equinox, s. vizuvaM, vizuvat n.; ‘the vernal e(quinox)’ mahAvizuvaM, haripadaM; ‘the autumnal e(quinox)’ vizupadaM, jalavizuvaM. Equinoctial, a. vizuvIya; ‘e(quinoctial) line’ vizuvadvfttaM, vizumaMqalaM; ‘e(quinoctial) point’ ayanaM.
EQUINOX: (1) vizuvam;(2) vizuvat (n.). Vernal e.: mahAvizuvam, Autumnal e.: jalavizuvam.
EQUINOX , s. vizuvaM, vizuvat n., vizvak n., vizupaM; ‘the vernal equinox,’ mahAvizuvaM, haripadaM; ‘autumnal,’ vizupaM; ‘day of the equinox,’ vizuvadinaM.
EQUINUMERANT , a. samasaMKyaH -KyA -KyaM, samAnasaMKyaH -KyA -KyaM.

Equip, v. t. sajjIkf 8 U, sarvopakaraRAni pra-upa-kxp c. or upapad c. or samAhf 1 P, upa-karaREH samAyuj 7 U, 10; ‘e(quip) with arms’ sannah c.; ‘e(quip) with clothes’ vastrEH saMvye 1 P or BUz 10. [Equip]age, s. upakaraRaM, sADanaM, saMBAraH, sAmagrI, upaskaraH. 2 paribarhaH, pari-vAraH. 3 sajjA, paricCadaH, sannAhaH, sajjanA, kalpanA, AkalpaH. 4 vAhanaM, vimAnaM, pravahaRaM. [Equip]ment, s. sajjA, saMBAraH, sajjIkaraRaM, sADanaM.
EQUIP (v.): (1) sajjIkaroti, well e. ped: susajjitaH (tA, taM);(2) A-kalpayati, upa-, (klwp, c. 10.): v. Also to adorn, accoutre.

To EQUIP , v. a. sajjIkf, sajj (c. 1. sajjati -jjituM), sasajjaM -jjAM -jjaM kf, sarvvopakaraREH or sopakAradravyEH samAyuj in caus. (-yojayati -yituM) or yuj, sarvvasopakAradravyARi upakxp (c. 10. -kalpayati -yituM) or samprakxp or upasTA in caus. (-sTApayati -yituM), or upapad in caus. (-pAdayati -yituM) or samBf (c. 1. -Barati -BarttuM) or upaskf or puraskf or sidDIkf or prastutIkf, dravyasamBAraM kf, upakaraRasamBAraM kf. — (With arms) astrEH or SastrEH sajjIkf, sannah (c. 4. -nahyati -nadDuM), saMvarmma (nom. -varmmayati -yituM). — (Fit out a ship) nAvaM samudrayAnArTaM or yudDArTaM sajjIkf. — (With clothes) vastrEr vezw (c. 1. vezwate -zwituM) or BUz (c. 10. BUzayati -yituM) or alaNkf.
EQUIPAGE: I Lit.:(1) sajjA;(2) AkalpaH. Ph.: personal e.: SarIropakaraRAni, K.II Re- -tinue: q. v.: parivarhaH.

EQUIPAGE , s. (Implements, materials) upakaraRaM, sADanaM, sAmagryaM -grI, samBAraH, upaskaraH. — (Paraphernalia) sajjA, paricCadaH, sannAhaH, alaNkriyA. — (Of war) yudDasajjA, yudDopakaraRaM, vAhinI. — (Retinue) parivarhaH, varhaH, tantraM. — (Vehicle) vAhanaM, vimAnaM.
EQUIPMENT: I The act:(1) sajjIkaraRam;(2) Akalpanam, upa-,.II Equipage: q. v.: sajjA.
EQUIPMENT , s. (Act of equipping) sajjIkaraRaM, sajjanaM -nA, sajjakarmma n. (n), sajjA, sADanaM, samBAraH, samBftiH f., AyojanaM, upAkarmma n. (n), puraskAraH, puraskaraRaM. See EQUIPAGE.
Equipoise, v. i. samIkf 8 U, tulayA Df 1 P. s. Equilibrium, q. v.
EQUIPOISE: samaDftiH: v. Equilibrium.
EQUIPOISE , s. tulyatA, BAratulyatA, tulyaBAratvaM, samatolatvaM, tulyabalatvaM, samatA, sAmyaM, tulyaparimARaM, parimARatulyatA.
To EQUIPOISE , v. a. samIkf, tulyIkf, tulyabalIkf, samatolIkf.
EQUIPOISED , p. p. tulitaH -tA -taM, samIkftaH -tA -taM, samatolaH -lA -laM.
EQUIPOLLENCE , s. tulyabalatvaM, balasamatA, tulyaSaktitvaM, SaktisAmyaM.
Equipollent, a. tulyabala-Sakti-sAmarTya.
EQUIPOLLENT , a. tulyabalaH -lA -laM, tulyaSaktiH -ktiH -kti, tulyOjAH -jAH -jaH (s).
EQUIPONDERANCE , s. tulyatA, BAratulyatA, samatolatvaM, tulyabalatvaM.
Equiponderant, a. samaBAra-tola, tulya-parimARa.
EQUIPONDERANT , a. samatolaH -lA -laM, tulyabalaH -lA -laM, tulyaparimARaH -RA -RaM.

EQUIPPED , p. p. sajjIkftaH -tA -taM, sajjitaH -tA -taM, sajjaH -jjA -jjaM, sopakAradravyayuktaH -ktA -ktaM, saMyuktaH -ktA -ktaM, samAyuktaH -ktA -ktaM, samanvitaH -tA -taM, sopakAraH -rI -raM, sannadDaH -dDA -dDaM, pinadDaH -dDA -dDaM, saMhitaH -tA -taM.
EQUITABLE: I Of men: nyAyaparAyaRa (f. RA). II Of acts: nyAyasaMgataH (tA, taM): v. Just.

EQUITABLE , a. samadarSI -rSinI -rSi (n), DarmmakArI -riRI -ri (n), nyAyakArI &c., nyAyI -yinI -yi (n), DArmmikaH -kI -kaM, nyAyavarttI -rttinI -rtti (n), yaTAnyAyaH -yA -yaM, apakzapAtI -tinI -ti (n), vipakzapAtaH -tA -taM, pakzapAtarahitaH -tA -taM, sarvvasamaH -mA -maM, uBayasA- DAraRaH -RA -RI -RaM, nirupekzI -kziRI -kzi (n).
EQUITABLENESS , s. sAmyaM, samatA, sarvvasamatA, apakzapAtaH, nyAyatA.
EQUITABLY: nyAyena or nyAyataH: v. Justly, fairly.
EQUITABLY , adv. nyAyatas, yaTAnyAyaM, nyAyavat, pakzapAtaM, vinA, sAmyena.

Equity, s. nyAyaH, DarmaH, apakzapAtaH, nyAyyatA, sarvasamatA. [Equit]able, a. nyAyaparAyaRa-vartin, apakzapAtin, samadarSin, sarvasama-nyAyin. 2 nyAyya, yaTAnyAya, pakzapAtarahita, sarvasADAraRa. [Equit]ableness, s. nyAyyatA; apakza-pAtaH. [Equit]ably, adv. nyAyataH, yaTAnyAyaM, pakzapAtaM vinA.
EQUITY: nyAyaH: e. governs in the conflict of two codes of law: smftyorviroDe nyAyo balavAn, Y.: v. Justice.

EQUITY , s. nyAyaH, DarmmaH, nyAyatA, apakzapAtaH, sAmyaM, samatA, uBayasAmAnyaM, sarvvasamatA, yuktiH f., yATArTyaM, vicAraH. — (Qualification of the severity of law) daRqanEzWuryyaSamanaM, DarmmanEzWuryyaSamanaM; ‘court of equity,’ daRqanEzWuryyaSamakA mahAvicAraRasaBA.
Equivalent, a. sama, tulya; See Equal. 2 tulyArTaka, samArTa, tulyabalaSakti; tulya-sama-mUlya, samArGa. s. tulyadravyaM-vastu n., tulyamUlyaM vastu, pratiPalaM. 2 tulyArTaH SabdaH, paryAyaH.
EQUIVALENT (adj.): (1) tulyaH (lyA, lyaM) v. Equal;(2) tulyArTakaH (kA, kaM) (in meaning); (3) tulyabalaH (lA, laM) (in force);(4) tulyamUlyaM (lyA, lyaM) (in value).
EQUIVALENT (subs.): I An e. thing: expr. by adj.II In chemistry: *tulyam.

EQUIVALENT , a. samamUlyaH -lyA -lyaM, tulyamUlyaH -lyA -lyaM, samAnamUlyaH -lyA -lyaM, tulyabalaH -lA -laM, tulyArGaH -rGA -rGaM, samArGaH -rGA -rGaM, samAnabalaH -lA -laM, samaSaktiH -ktiH -kti, tulyaSaktiH -ktiH -kti, tulyaH -lyA -lyaM, samaH -mA -maM, samAnaH -nA -naM.
EQUIVALENT , s. samAnamUlyakaM dravyaM, tulyadravyaM, tulyavastu n., pratikriyA, pratIkAraH, pratikftiH f., pratyupakAraH, nistAraH, pratiPalaM, parivarttaH, tulyatvaM, sAmyaM, samAnatvaM.

Equivocal, a. dvyarTa, saMdigDArTa, vakra, aspa-zwArTa, avyakta. [Equivocal]ly, adv. vakroktyA, BaMgyA, aspazwaM, saMdigDArTena, avyaktaM. [Equivocal]ness, s. saMdigDArTaH, dvyarTatA, arTasaMdehaH, vakratA, aspazwatA.
EQUIVOCAL: vakraH (krA, kraM): v. Ambiguous.
EQUIVOCAL , a. sandigDArTaH -rTA -rTaM, aspazwArTaH -rTA -rTaM, dvyarTaH -rTA -rTaM, vakraH -krA -kraM, vakrArTaH -rTA -rTaM, aspazwaH -zwA -zwaM, vikalArTakaH -kA -kaM.
EQUIVOCALLY: vakram: v. Ambiguously.
EQUIVOCALLY , adv. sandigDArTatas, dvyarTatas, vakroktyA, aspazwaM, avyaktaM.
EQUIVOCALNESS , s. sandigDArTaH, dvyarTaH, arTasandehaH arTasandigDatA, arTava- krimA m. (n), aspazwatA, sandigDatA, vakratA.
Equivocate, v. i. vakraM-aspazwArTaM-vad 1 P, vAkyaBedaM kf 8 U. [Equivocat]ion, s. vakravacanaM, vakrokti f., vAkyaBedaH, vAkCalaM, apa-vyapa-deSaH.
EQUIVOCATE (v.): (1) vakroktiM karoti;(2) BaNgiM karoti.
To EQUIVOCATE , v. n. vakraM or savakrArTaM or arTavakratayA or dvyarTato vada (c. 1. vadati -dituM), vakroktiM kf, aspazwaM vada.
EQUIVOCATING , a. vakroktimAn -matI -mat (t), vAkCalAnvitaH -tA -taM.
EQUIVOCATION: (1) vakroktiH:(2) sPuwaBinnArTaM vacaH, Si.
EQUIVOCATION , s. vakroktiH f., vakravAkyaM, vakraBaRitaM, vakravacanaM, vAkyavakratA, vAkCalaM, vakratA, vakrimA m. (n), arTavEkalyaM, apadeSaH, vyapadeSaH.
EQUIVOCATOR , s. dvyarTavaktA m. (ktf), dvyarTavAdI m. (n), vakravAkyavAdI m.
Equivoque, s. kUwokti-arTApatti f., vakra-BaRitaM.
EQUIVOQUE , s. vakroktiH f., kUwoktiH f., kEtavavAdaH, lAlikA, arTApattiH f.
Era, s. kAlaH, SAkaH, DruvaH kAlaH. 2 viSizwa-kAlaH.
ERA: (1) kAlaH: v. Time;(2) SakaH or SAkaH (sp. of. Śālivāhana);(3) saMvat (of Vikra- -māditya).
ERA , s. kAlaH, DruvaH, SAkaH, SakaH, saMvat indec. The era of Śālivāhana is called SAkaH, that of Vikramāditya, saMvat.
Eradiate, v. i. kiraRAn kzip-muc 6 P, parisPur 6 P.
To ERADIATE , v. a. sPur (c. 6. sPurati -rituM), raSmIn or kiraRAn pat in caus. (pAtayati -yituM) or muc (c. 6. muYcati, moktuM) or nikzip (c. 6. -kzipati -kzeptuM).
ERADICABLE , a. unmUlyaH -lyA -lyaM, unmUlanIyaH -yA -yaM, utpAwanIyaH -yA -yaM, mUlyaH -lyA -lyaM.

Eradicate, v. t. ut-nir-mUl 10; ucCid 7 P, utsad c., utpaw 10, vi-DvaMs c., AmUlaM udDf 1 P or utKan 1 P, vyapa-ruh c. (ropayati). [Eradicat]ion, s. unmUlanaM, ucCedaH, utpAwanaM, vyaparopaRaM. [Eradicat]or, s. unmUlayitf m., ucCedin m.

ERADICATE: (1) unmUlayati, sam-, (mUl, c. 10.), an enemy can be easily e. d: ripurunmUlayituM sukaraH, Ki. ii. 50;(2) udDarati (hf, c. 1.), I will e. the enemy today: SatrumadyodDarizyAmi, Ram.;(3) ucCinatti (Cid, c. 7.).

To ERADICATE , v. a. unmUl (c. 10. -mUlayati -yituM), samunmUl, utpaw (c. 10. -pAwayati -yituM), mUlAt or AmUlaM or samUlam udDf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM) or samudDf or ucCid (c. 7. -Cinatti -CettuM) or utKan (c. 1. -Kanati -nituM), vyaparuh in caus. (-ropayati -yituM), udvfh (c. 6. -vfhati -varhituM).
ERADICATED , p. p. unmUlitaH -tA -taM, utpAwitaH -tA -taM, ucCinnaH -nnA -nnaM, udDftaH -tA -taM, utKAtaH -tA -taM, vyaparopitaH -tA -taM, AvarhitaH -tA -taM, udvarhitaH -tA -taM.
ERADICATION: (1) unmUlanam;(2) udDaraRam or udDAraH; (3) ucCedaH, e. of birth: ucCedo janmanaH, Ki.
ERADICATION , s. utpAwanaM, ucCedaH, udDaraRaM, unmUlanaM, samUlotpAwanaM, samUlodDaraRaM, mUlAdudDaraRaM, vyaparopaRaM, samUlaGAtaM, nizkozaRaM, vinASaH.
ERADICATIVE , a. ucCedI -dinI -di (n), utpAwanakArI -riRI -ri (n).
ERADICATOR , s. udDarttA m. (rttf), unmUlayitA m. (tf), ucCedI m. (n).
Erase, v. t. vyA-apa-mfj 2 P, vilup c., vyAmfS 6 P. 2 ucCid 7 P, vinaS c., unmUl 10. [Eras]ure, vyAmarSaH, lopaH, ucCedaH, vinASaH.
ERASE: I To efface: q. v.: pra-mArzwi (mfj, c. 2.).II To destroy: q.v.: kazati (kaza, c. 1.), all-e. ing fate: sarvaMkazA BavitavyatA, Ma.

To ERASE , v. a. (Rub out) vyAmfj (c. 2. -mArzwi -rzwuM), apamfj, unmfj, vyAmfS (c. 6. -mfSati -mrazwuM), lup (c. 6. lumpati, loptuM), vilup (c. 10. -lopayati -yituM), lopaM kf. — (Destroy) ucCid (c. 7. -Cinatti -CettuM), udDf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM), vinaS in caus. (-nASayati -yituM).
ERASED , p. p. vyAmfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, luptaH -ptA -ptaM, ucCinnaH -nnA -nnaM.
ERASTIAN , s. KrIzwIyasamAjo rAjyarItisambadDo Bavati or rAjyarItyaDIno Bavati iti manyate yo janaH.
ERASURE: lopaH. (?): v. Obliteration.
ERASURE , s. vyAmarzaH, lopaH, vilopanaM, ucCedaH, vinASaH.
Ere, prep., adv. pUrvaM, prAk, (with abl.); ‘e(re) this’ ataH pUrvaM; ‘e(re) long’ acirAt-reRa; ‘e(re) now’ nAticiraM, nAticirAtprAk; ‘e(re) while’ kiMcitpUrvaM; See Before.
ERE: pUrvam, e. this: itaH pUrvam: v. Before.

ERE , adv. or prep. prAk, pUrvvaM, purA, agre; ‘ere he could come,’ tasya AgamanAt purvvaM or purA; ‘ere the time appointed,’ prAg vihitakAlAt; ‘ere twelve years are over,’ prAg dvAdaSasamAH; or, expressed by loc. absolute; as, ‘ere my child die,’ mama putre na mfte sati.
ERE LONG: (1) acireRa;(2) acirAt.

Erect, a. unnata, ucCrita, anata, UrDva, uttAna, ajihma; gen. ex. by ut in comp.; ‘with the neck e(rect)’ udgrIva, utkaMDara; ‘with the hair e(rect)’ pulakita, romAMcita. v. t. sTA c. (sTApayati), prati-saM-aDi°, aDiruh c. 2 nirmA 3 A, rac 10, virac, niKan 1 P, (nicaKAna jayastaMBAn R. iv. 36). 3 utTA c., unnI 1 P, ucCri c., unnam c. (unnamayati), udgam c., udyam 1 P, utkzip 6 P, udDf 1 P. [Erect]ion, s. pratizWApanaM, saMsTApanaM. 2 nirmARaM, viracanaM. 3 utTApanaM, utkzepaH, ucCrayaH, unnamanaM, unnati f., udgamanaM; ‘e(rection) of the hair’ pulakaH, pulakodgamaH, romo-dgamaH, romaharzaRaM, romAMcaH.
ERECT (adj.): I Of posture: perh. unnataH (tA, taM).II Raised, uplifted: q. v.: unnataH (tA, taM), with eyebrows e.: unnataBrU (n. Bru). Ph.: his hair became e. (from joy): pulakito baBUva.

ERECT (v.): I To set up, plant: q. v.: sTApayati (c. of sTA).II To build: q. v.: (1) nirmimIte (mA, c. 3.);(2) karoti (= to make).III To exalt: q. v.: unnamayati (c. of nam).IV To establish, found: q.v.: sTApayati.

To ERECT , v. a. (Set up) sTA in caus. (sTApayati -yituM), pratizWA, avasTA, saMsTA, aDizWA, aDiruh in caus. -ropayati -yituM), niruq, ruh. — (Raise, elevate) utTA (rt. sTA with ut), unnam in caus. (-namayati -yituM), ucCri (c. 1. -Crayati -yituM, rt. Sri), samucCri, procCri; utkzip (c. 6. -kzipati -kzeptuM), udyam (c. 1. -yacCati -yantuM), udDf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM), unnI (c. 1. -nayati -netuM), udvfh (c. 6. -vfhati -varhituM), uccIkf, UrdDvIkf, uccEH kf; ‘to erect the hair,’ pulaka (nom. pulakayati -yituM).

ERECT , a. unnataH -tA -taM, samunnataH -tA -taM, anataH -tA -taM, fjuH -juH -ju, ullambitaH -tA -taM, uttAnaH -nA -naM, ajihmaH -hmA -hmaM, uccaH -ccA -ccaM, ucCritaH -tA -taM. — (Having the head or countenance erect) unnataSirAH -rAH -raH (n), prakawaSIrzaH -rzA -rzaM, UrdDvamuKaH -KAM -KaM, utpakzmalaH -lA -laM; ‘having the hair erect,’ pulakitaH -tA -taM, romAYcitaH -tA -taM.

ERECTED , p. p. pratizWApitaH -tA -taM, pratizWitaH -tA -taM, aDizWitaH -tA -taM, utTApitaH -tA -taM, ucCritaH -tA -taM, unnamitaH -tA -taM, unnataH -tA -taM, udDftaH -tA -taM, udyataH -tA -taM, udvarhitaH -tA -taM, uccIkftaH -tA -taM, udgurRaH -rRA -rRaM, udvfttaH -ttA -ttaM, udvarttitaH -tA -taM.
ERECTION: I Planting:(1) sTApanam, saM-,(2) pratizWApanam.II Building: nirmARam.III Exal- -tation: q. v.

ERECTION , s. (Establishing) pratizWApanaM, saMsTApanaM, avasTApanaM. — (Raising) utTApanaM, ucCrayaH, ucCrAyaH, ucCritiH f., samucCrayaH, unnatiH f., unnamanaM, unnayaH -yanaM, unnAmaH, unnAyaH, utkzepaH, udyamaH, udvarttanaM; ‘of the hair of the body,’ pulakaH, pulakodgapnaH, udDarzaRaM, romaharzaRaM, romAYcaH -YcanaM, romodgamaH, romodBedaH, udDUzaRaM.
ERECTLY: prob. unnatakAyena or unnato (f. tA) BUtvA.
ERECTNESS: unnatatA, -tvam: v. Erect.
ERECTNESS , s. anatatA, unnatatA, uttAnatvaM, uccatA, fjutA.
ERELONG , adv. acireRa, acirAt, na cireRa, na cirAt, purA.
EREMITE: araRyavAsI, Vi.; (2) AraRyakaH, Vi.: v. Hermit.
EREMITE , s. araRyavAsI m. (n), vanavAsI m. vanasTAyI m. (n), vAnaprasTaH
ERENOW , adv. aDunA pUrvvaM, adya pUrvvaM, prAg ihasamayAt.
EREWHILE: kiYcitpUrvam: v. Sometime, before.
ERMINE: I An animal: nakulajAtIyajantuviSezaH. II Its fur: *UrmIRaloman (n.).III The dignity of judges: UrmIRalomaDarAH (m. pl.).
ERMINE , s. nakulajAtIyo himavaddeSajaH SuklalomA kzudrajantuH.
Erotic, a. kAmapriya, kAmin, kAmuka.
EROTIC , a. kAmI -minI -mi (n), SfNgArI -riRI -ri (n), kAmavizayaH -yA -yaM.

Err, v. i. viBram 1, 4 P, aparAD 4, 5 P, utpaTaM yA 2 P, unmArgeRa gam 1 P or pravft 1 A; sKal 1 P, pramad 4 P, satpaTAd BraMS 1 A, 4 P or cyu 1 A or vical 1 P, vyutkram 1 U, 4 P, vyaticar 1 P. [Err]ant, a. pariBramin, BramaRakArin. [Err]atic, a. BramaRa-SIla, jaMgama, cara. [Err]ing, a. BrAMta, unmArga-pravftta, satpadaBrazwa-cyuta, utpaTagAmin, pramA-din. Erroneous, a. BrAMtimUlaka, prA-mAdika (kI f.), BramAtmaka; miTyA-mfzA- in comp.; ‘e(rroneous) notion’ miTyAgrahaH. 2 anfta, asatya, aSudDa, ayaTArTa, ataTya, vitaTa. [Erroneous]ly, adv. miTyA, mfzA, ayaTArTaM, asatyaM, BrAMtyA, pramAdena, sapramAdaM. Error, s. BramaH, BrAMti f., mativiBramaH, mohaH, vyAmohaH, miTyAmati f. 2 dozaH, aparADaH, pramAdaH, sKalitaM, pApaM. 3 unmArgagamanaM, vyatikramaH, utpaTaH, mArgaBraMSaH; ‘in e(rror)’ BrAMta, pramatta, sadoza, aparAdDa.

ERR (v.): (1) Bramati, vi-, (Bram, c. 1.), that you may not e. again: mA BUyo viBrameriti, Mah.; (2) paTaH or mArgAt cyavate (cyu, c. 1.) or BraSyati, -te (BraMS, c. 4.) (= to wander from the right way), Ki.;(3) utpaTena or unmArgeRa gacCati (gam, c. 1.) or DAvati (DAv, c. 1.) (in moral sense), U.

To ERR , v. n. Bram (c. 4. BrAmyati, BramituM), viBram, pariBram, BrAntiM kf, aparAD (c. 4. -rADyati, c. 5. -rADnoti -rAdDuM), aparADaM kf, dozaM kf, pramad (c. 4. -mAdyati -madituM), satpaTAt or yaTocitAd BraMS (c. 4.
