EVENTFUL , a. guruzawanAviSizwaH -zwA -zwaM, gurusaNgataviSizwaH -zwA -zwaM, bahuvfttaviSizwaH -zwA -zwaM, bahusamunnayavAn -vatI -vat(t), bahuGawanAmayaH -yI -yaM.
To EVENTILATE , v. a. vIj (c. 10. vIjayati -yituM), viDU (c. 5. -DUnoti, c. 6. -Duvati -DavituM), nizpAvaM kf.
EVENTUAL: antimaH (mA, maM): v. Final, ulti- -mate.
EVENTUAL , a. (Consequential) anuvarttI -rttinI -rtti (n), AnuzaNgikaH -kI -kaM, anusArI -riRI -ri (n), anuBUtaH -tA -taM, paraH -rA -raM. — (Ultimate) antimaH -mA -maM, antyaH -ntyA -ntyaM.
EVENTUALLY: avaSeze: v. Finally, ultimately.
EVENTUALLY , adv. antatas, ante, Seze, Sezatas, paratas, prayogatas.

Ever, adv. kadA-cana-cit, kadApi; karhicit, jAtu; ‘not e(ver)’ na kadAcana, na jAtu, &c. 2 nityaM, aharniSaM; sadA, sarvadA; ‘for e(ver)’ SaSvat, niraMtaraM; ajasraM, SASvatIH samAH; oft. by ekAMta, atyaMta in comp.; ‘disappeared for e(ver)’ atyaMtaviluptadarSana; ‘lost for e(ver)’ ekAMtanazwa, ‘gone for e(ver)’ asannivfttyE gata, atyaMtagata; ‘e(ver) more’ punaH, itaH paraM; ‘e(ver) and anon’ vAraMvAraM, kAle kAle, muhurmuhuH, muhuH; ‘e(ver) since’ yataH praBfti; ‘e(ver) so little’ manAk-Izat-kiyat-kiMcit-api. With adj. ex. by nitya, sadA, &c. in comp.; ‘e(ver) blooming’ nityapuzpa; ‘e(ver) green’ satataharita, amlAnaparRa; ‘e(ver) lasting’ nityasTAyin, nitya, akzayya, amara; See Eternal; ‘e(ver) moving’ sadA-nitya-gati.

EVER: I At any time: kadAcit or kadApi, if these e. deserve union: kadAcidete yadi yogamarhataH, Ku.; “nobody e. yet hated his own flesh”: *adyApi na ko'pi svamAMsaM didveza. Ph.: e. and anon: yadA tadA. II Always: q. v.:(1) satatam, e. think of the truth: tattvaM cintaya satatam, J.;(2) nityam, D.: Ph.: gone for e.: apunarAgamanAya gataH; lost for e.: ekAntanazwaH (zwA, zwaM) E. so (= in whatever degree): v. However.

EVER , adv. (At any time) kadAcit, kadApi, kadAcana, karhicit, jAtu. — (Always, at all times) sadA, sarvvadA, satataM, nityadA, anukzaRaM, pratikzaRaM; ‘for ever,’ nityaM, sarvvakAlaM, anantakAlaM, SASvatIH samAH, ajasraM, SaSvat, nirantaraM, sanA; ‘ever and anon,’ vAraM vAraM, kAle kAle, anukAlaM; ‘ever since,’ yataH praBfti; ‘ever so little,’ manAk, Izat, kiYcit, kiyat. — (As a word of enforce- -ment) eva; ‘ever young,’ nityayOvanaH -nA -naM; ‘ever happy,’ sadAnandaH -ndA -ndaM.
EVER-RESTLESS , a. nityagatiH -tiH -ti, sadAgatiH -tiH -ti, satatagatiH -tiH -ti.
EVERBLOOMING: nityapuzpaH (zpA, zpaM), and sim. comps., where trees are e.: yatra pAdapA nityapuzpAH, Me.
EVERGREEN: (1) satataharitaH (tA, taM); (?); (2) nityaparRa (f. rRA) (?).
EVERGREEN , a. aSIrRapatraH -trA -traM, amlAnaparRaH -rRA -rRaM, aSuzkaparRaH -rRA -rRaM.
EVERGREEN , a. sadAharitaparRaH -rRA -rRaM, sadArdraparRakaH -kA -kaM.
EVERLASTING: nityasTAyin (f. nI): v. Eternal.
EVERLASTING , a. anantaH -ntA -ntaM, anantakAlasTAyI -yinI -yi (n), nityasTAyI &c., SASvataH -tI -taM, akzayaH -yA -yaM, anASyaH -SyA -SyaM, ajaraH -rA -raM. See ETERNAL.
EVERLASTINGLY , adv. SASvataM, anantakAlaM, SASvatIH samAH, nityaM, ajasraM.
EVERLIVING , a. nityajIvI -vinI -vi (n), anantakAlajIvI &c. See ETERNAL.
EVERMORE: I For e.: satatam.II At all times: sadA.
EVERMORE , s. anantakAlaM, sarvvakAlaM, SASvatIH samAH, SASvataM, SaSvat, tityaM, nityakAlaM, satataM, ajasraM, sanA. See ETERNALLY.
EVERSION , s. paryyAsaH, parAkzepaH, parivarttanaM, nASaH, vinASaH.
Evert, v. t. viparyas 4 U, vinaS c.
To EVERT , v. a. paryas (c. 4. -asyati -asituM), parAkzip (c. 6. -kzipati -kzeptuM), aDaH kf.

Every, a. Ex. by prati-anu- in comp.; ‘e(very) day’ pratidivasaM; prativarzaM, anudinaM, &c., oft. by repeating the word; ‘in e(very) place’ sTAne sTAne; divase divase ‘e(very) day’ &c.; ‘at e(very) discussion’ vAde vAde. 2 sarva, viSva, sakala; See Each; ‘knowing e(very) thing’ sarvajYaH; ‘suffering e(very) thing’ savaMsahA (pfTvI); ‘e(very) one’, ‘e(very) body’ sarvaH, sarvajanaH, pratyekaH, ekEkaH; ekEkaSaH, pfTak pfTak; ‘e(very)-day’, (a.) prAtyahika (kI f.); ‘e(very) thing’ sarvaM; ‘e(very) other’ ekEkaM parityajya anya-apara; ‘in e(very) way’ sarvaTA; ‘e(very) where’ vizvak, sarvataH, sarvatra, yatra tatra; ‘e(very) time’ yadA yadA; ‘on e(very) side’ sarvataH, viSvataH, samaMtataH.

EVERY: (1) by doubling the word, at e. place: sTAne sTAne, J.; in e. house: gfhe gfhe, Ku.; e. six months: zaRmAse zaRmAse, P. iii. 6.;(2) by comp. with prati, in e. direction: pratidiSam, Ki.; e. day: pratyaham, H.;(3) by comp. with anu (of rapid succession), e. moment, e. now and then: anukzaRam;(4) sarvaH (rvA, rvaM) (when e.= all); e. poem: sarvaM kAvyam, Mal.

EVERY , a. sarvvaH -rvvA -rvvaM, viSvaH -SvA -SvaM, sakalaH -lA -laM, sarvvakaH -kA -kaM; ‘every art,’ sarvvakarmma n. (n); ‘knowing every thing,’ sarvvajYaH; ‘every road,’ sarvvapaTaH; ‘the maker of every thing,’ sarvvaBUtakft, sarvvakarttA m. (rttf), viSvaNkaraH; ‘enduring every thing,’ sarvvaMsahaH, viSvasahaH; ‘every one,’ sarvvajanAH m. pl., viSvajanaM; ‘dear to every one,’ sarvvapriyaH; ‘sustaining every thing,’ viSvamBaraH. ‘Every,’ may often be expressed by prati or anu prefixed; as, ‘every day,’ pratidinaM, pratidivasaM, anudinaM, anvahaM, pratyahaM; ‘every night,’ pratirAtraM; ‘every month,’ pratimAsaM; ‘every moment,’ anukzaRaM; ‘to every one,’ pratyekaM. Or by doubling the word; as, ‘every day,’ dine dine, divase divase, aharahaH; ‘in every house,’ gfhe gfhe; ‘every one,’ ekEkaH -kA -kaM, ekEkaSam, pfTak pfTak; ‘every man,’ ekEkajanaH, pratijanaM; ‘in every direction,’ pratidiSaM, sarvvadikzu, sarvvapaTInaH -nA -naM; ‘on every side,’ sarvvatas, samantatas, samantAt, viSvatas, paritas.
EVERY-TIME: yadA yadA: v. Whenever.
EVERY-WAY, IN: (1) sarvaTA;(2) sarvaprakAreRa.

EVERYBODY, EVERYONE: (1) sarvaH, e. is after his own interest: sarvaH svArTe samIhate, Si. ii. 65.; (2) sarvaMjanaH, sakalo janaH, etc., e. will say: sarvo jano vadizyati, P.; e. hates the minister: sakalo jano'mAtyaM jugupsate, Ma. ii. Ph.: delighted e. one of the citizens: pOrAn pratyekaM hlAdayAYcakre, R.; looking at e. one: pratyekamavalokya, Ana.
EVERYDAY (adj.): (1) prAtyahikaH (kI, kaM), e. hunger: prAtyahikakzut, S. d.;(2) nityaH (tyA, tyaM) (= regular), e. present: nityadakziRA, Mal.: v. Daily.
EVERYTHING: sarvam, everybody does not know e. na sarvaH sarvaM jAnAti, Mu.
EVERYWHERE: (1) sarvatra;(2) sarvataH, you go e.: tvaM sarvatogAmi, Ku.
EVERYWHERE , adv. sarvvatra, sarvvatas, viSvatas, viSvak, sarvvake, pratidiSaM; ‘going everywhere,’ sarvvatragaH -gA -gaM, sarvvagaH -gA -gaM, viSvavyApI pinI -pi (n).
Evict, v. t. niHsf c., nirAkf 8 U, bahizkf, aDikArAt svatvAt-BraMS c. or cyu c.
EVICT: niHsArayati (c. of sf) (?).
To EVICT , v. a. nirSayapAdAnantaraM or vyavahAradarSanAnantaram aDikArAd BraMSa (c. 10. BraMSayati -yituM) or nirAkf or vahizkf or aDikAraM or svatvaM hf (c. 1. harati, harttuM).
EVICTED , p. p. vyavahArasaBAsakASAd AjYayA hftADikAraH -rA -raM, sADitaH -tA -taM.
EVICTION: niHsAraRam (?).
EVICTION , s. vyavahAramaRqapasakASAd AjYAnusAreRa aDikArAnnirAkaraRaM or vahizkaraRaM or svatvaharaRaM, sADanaM.

Evidence, s. sAkzyaM, pramARaM, prAmARyaM, nidarSa-naM; ‘written e(vidence)’ leKapramARaM, sADanapatraM; ‘ocular e(vidence)’ pratyakzapramARaM, cAkzuzajYAnaM. v. t. pramARIkf 8 U, pramARena sAD c. or vi-BU c. or upa-pad c.

EVIDENCE (subs.): (1) sAkzyam (of witnesses), to give e.: sAkzyaM dadAti, Y.; e. may be direct and also hearsay: samakzadarSanAt sAkzyaM SravaRAccEva siDyati, M.;(2) pramARam (= any proof), does not estab- [Page251] lish his claim by e.: uktaM pramARena na pratipAdayati, K. b.; document (=written) possession (= real) and witnesses (=oral) are e.: pramARaM liKitaM BuktiH sAkziRaSca, Y.
EVIDENCE (v.): pramARayati (nomi.): v. To evince, prove.

EVIDENCE , s. (Testimony) sAkzyaM, sAkzitA, pramARaM, sADanaM, prAmARyaM, pramAtA m. (tf), kriyAnirdeSaH, sADananirdeSaH; ‘written evidence,’ leKapramARaM, liKitaM, sADanapatraM; ‘ocular evidence,’ pratyakzapramARaM, sAkzAtpramARaM, cAkzuzajYAnaM; ‘false evidence,’ kOwasAkzyaM, kUwasAkzyaM; ‘want of evidence,’ sAkzyaBAvaH, pramARABAvaH. — (Witness) sAkzI m. (n), pramAtA m. (tf); ‘having evidence,’ sAkzimAn -matI -mat(t).

To EVIDENCE , v. a. pramARa (nom. pramARayati -yituM), pramARikf, sAkziRA or sAkzyeRa or pramARena sAD (c. 10. sADayati -yituM) or BU in caus. (BAvayati -yituM) or nirdiS (c. 6. -diSati -dezwuM) or upapad in caus. (-pAdayati -yituM).

EVIDENCE , s. pramARaM; ‘of sense,’ pratyakzapramARaM; ‘of inference,’ anu- mAnapramARaM; ‘of analogy,’ upamAnapramARaM; ‘of ordeal,’ divyapramARaM; ‘of profession,’ BogapramARaM; ‘documentary evidence,’ leKa- pramARaM; ‘ocular,’ dfkpratyayaH.
EVIDENCED , p. p. sAkziBAvitaH -tA -taM, sAkzilakzaRaH -RA -RaM, spazwIkftaH -tA -taM.

Evident, a. spazwa, suspazwa, sPuwa, parisPuwa, vyakta, viSada, prakASa, pratyakza, prakawa; ‘make e(vident)’ pra-kAS c., Avizkf 8 U, spazwIkf, vi-vf 5 U, viSadIkf; ‘to be e(vident)’ spazwIBU 1 P, &c. [Evident]ly, adv. spazwaM, sPuwaM, vyaktaM, pratya-kzaM, nAma, oft. with eva.

EVIDENT: (1) spazwaH (zwA, zwaM), vi-, although e. the lustre of his body was not e.: spazwo'pyavispazwavapuH- prakASaH, Ki.;(2) vyaktaH (ktA, ktaM), aBi-, very e. from the long wet footsteps: suvyaktamArdrapadapaMktiBirA- yatABiH, R.;(3) sPuwaH (wA, waM), pari-, to become e. sPuwIBavati, Si.
EVIDENT, TO BE: (1) prakASate (kAS, c. 1.), M. n.; (2) vikaSa(sa)ti (kaS or kas, c. 1.), your untruth- fulness is e. from your act: tava karmaREva vikaSatya- satyatA, Si. xv. 16.
EVIDENT, TO MAKE: (1) prakASayati (c of kAS), who have made your intellect and character e.: prakASitatvanmatiSIlasArAH, Ki.;(2) vikASa(sa)yati (c. of kaS or kas).

EVIDENT , a. spazwaH -zwA -zwaM, suspazwaH -zwA -zwaM, vyaktaH -ktA -ktaM or pravyaktaH or aBivyaktaH, pratyakzaH -kzA -kzaM, prakASaH -SA -SaM, suprakASaH -SA -SaM, samakzaH -kzI -kzaM, sPuwaH -wA -waM, ulvaRaH -RA -RaM; ‘to make evident,’ spazwIkf, vyaktIkf, prakAS (c. 10. -kASayati -yituM), prakawIkf, pratyakzIkf, Avizkf, prAduzkf; ‘to be evident,’ spazwIBU, AvirBU, prAdurBU, prAduras, prakAS (c. 1. -kASate -SituM); ‘made evident,’ spazwIkftaH -tA -taM, prAduzkftaH -tA -taM, prakASitaH -tA -taM, pratyakzaBUtaH -tA -taM.
EVIDENTLY: (1) vyaktam, e. I have been deceived: vyaktamasmi vipralabDA, D.;(2) spazwam, vi-,;(3) (3) sPuwam, pari-.
EVIDENTLY , adv. vyaktaM, suvyaktaM, spazwaM, spazwarUpeRa, pratyakzatas, pratyakzeRa, sAkzAt, prakASaM, sPuwaM, prAdus, samakzaM, nAma.

Evil, a. duzwa, pApa, Kala, kutsita, asADu, niMdya, aDama, pApin, asat, garhya, garhita, vAcya; gen. ex. by dur, ku, apa, asat, pApa in comp.; ‘e(vil) intentioned’ pApASaya, durbudDi; ‘e(vil) passions’ durvikArAH; ‘e(vil) eye’ kudfzwi f., pApadfzwi f.; ‘e(vil) course’ kupaTaH-mArgaH, asatpaTaH; ‘e(vil)-conducted’ durAcAra, apa-karman, durvftta; ‘e(vil) doer’ durvfttaH, kukarman m.; pApakarman m., duzkftin m., pApakft m.; ‘e(vil) minded’ durAtman, pApamati-budDi, duzwamati, kumati, durmati, durbudDi, pApASaya; ‘good or e(vil) acts’ SuBASuBakarmARi; ‘e(vil) speaking’ durAlApaH, piSunavAkyaM; ‘e(vil)-tongued’ durmuKa, muKara, abadDamuKa, kadvada. s. anizwaM, ahitaM, aSuBaM, apAyaH, aBadraM, arizwaM, duHKaM. 2 durgati f., duravasTA, vyasanaM, A-vi-pad f., kazwaM, atyAhitaM. 3 apakAraH, apAyaH, hiMsA, kzataM-ti f. 4 pApaM, pApAcaritaM, duzkarman n., kukftyaM, aDarmaH, duzwakftyaM, dOrAtmyaM, dozaH, durAcA-raH, duzkfti f.; ‘Oh! An e(vil) has befallen!’ abrahmaRyaM, atyAhitaM, hA Dik, kazwaM.

EVIL (adj,): I Having bad qualities:(1) duzwaH (zwA, zwaM), quieting the e. ones: duzwapraSAntiH, Vi.; e. sleep: duzwanidrA, K.(2) by dur prefixed, e. doings: duzkarmARi (n. pl.); e. speaking: durvAkyam. II Not good: by ku- pref, at an e. moment: kukzaRe; e. course: kumArgaH; e. eye: kudfzwiH.
EVIL (subs.): I Mischief, calamity: q. v.: anizwam.II Wickedness: q. v.: duzwatA.

EVIL , a. duzwaH -zwA -zwaM, pApaH -pA -paM, pApI -pinI -pi (n), KalaH -lA -laM, aBadraH -drA -draM, asADuH -DuH -Du, asan -satI -sat (t), nirguRaH -RA -RaM, SaWaH -WA -WaM, mandaH -ndA -ndaM, aDamaH -mA -maM, kutsitaH -tA -taM, kadaryyaH -ryyA -ryyaM, aDArmmikaH -kI -kaM. ‘Evil,’ is often expressed by dur or ku, or apa prefixed; as, ‘an evil man,’ durjjanaH; ‘evil thought,’ kucintA, apaDyAnaM; ‘evil conduct,’ durRayaH; ‘evil deed,’ kukarmma n. (n), duzkarmma n., pApakarmma n., asatkarmma n., duzkftaM; ‘evil course,’ kumArgaH, unmArgaH, vimArgaH; ‘evil destiny,’ durBAgyaM, durdEvaM.

EVIL , s. (Wickedness) pApaM, duzwatA, dozaH, vyasanaM -nitA, SAWyaM, dOzWavaM, asADutA, aDarmmaH, vyaBicAraH, dOrAtmyaM, dOrjanyaM, kusftiH f., nikAraH. — (Injury) apakAraH, apakftaM, apAyaH, drohaH, hiMsA, kzatiH f. — (Misfortune, distress) apAyaH, aSuBaM, durgatiH f., dOrgatyaM, akuSalaM, aBadraM, arizwaM, anizwaM, ahitaM, duHKaM, duravasTA, durdaSA, vyasanaM, utpAtaH, Apad f., vipad f., vipattiH f., anizwapAtaH, anayaH, kleSaH, kazwaM.

EVIL , adv. duzWu; expressed by dur, vi, duzwa, pApa &c., prefixed; ‘evil-intentioned,’ duzwabudDiH -dDiH -dDi, durASayaH -yA -yaM, pApASayaH -yA -yaM; ‘evil-affected,’ viraktaH -ktA -ktaM, ahitaH -tA -taM; ‘evil- -natured,’ duzprakftiH -tiH -ti; ‘evil-fated,’ dEvopahataH -tA -taM, upahatakaH -kA -kaM, durdEvagrastaH -stA -staM; ‘evil-favoured,’ kurUpaH -pI -paM.

EVIL-DOER , s. pApakArI m. (n), pApakarttA m. (rttf), pApakaraH, pApakft m., pApakarmmA m. (n), asatkarmmA, kukarmmA, duzkftI m. (n), kukarmmakArI m., mandacaritraH, mandakArI m., durvfttaH, duzwacArI m. aDarmmacArI m. (n), vyasanI m. (n).
EVIL-EYE , s. kudfzwiH f., adfzwiH f., durIzaRA, krUradfzwiH f.; ‘evil-eyed,’ krUradfk m. f. n. (S), asahfk m. f. n. pAzadfzwiH -zwiH -zwi.
EVIL-MINDED: (1) kumati (mfn.);(2) durAcAraH (rA, raM);(3) duzprakfti (mfn.): v. Wicked.

EVIL-MINDED , a. pApamatiH -tiH -ti, pApabudDiH -dDiH -dDi, pApacetanaH -nA -naM duzwacittaH -ttA -ttaM, duzwabudDiH -dDiH -dDi, duzwamatiH -tiH -ti, durAtmA [Page241-a+ 51] -tmA -tma (n), aDarmmAtmA &c., pApAtmA &c., pApasvaBAvaH -vA -vaM, duzwAntaHkaraRaH -RA -RaM, durhfdayaH -yA -yaM.
EVIL-SPEAKING , s. durAlApaH, apavAdaH, vAgdozaH, piSunavAkyaM, mOKaryyaM.
Evince, v. t. nirdiS 6 P, prakAS c., sUc 10, dfS c., spazwI-vyaktI-prakawI-kf 8 U, vyaMj 7 P or c., dyut c. [Evinc]ibly, adv. spazwaM, asaMSayaM, vyaktaM. [Evinc]ive, a. darSaka, sUcaka, dyotaka.
EVINCE: darSayati (c. of dfS): v. To show, manifest.
To EVINCE , v. a. spazwIkf, vyaktIkf, prakAS (c. 10. -kASayati -yituM), sUc (c. 10. sUcayati -yituM), nirdiS (c. 6. -diSati -dezwuM), pradiS, dfS in caus. (darSayati -yituM), pramARIkf.
EVINCIBLE , a. sUcyaH -cyA -cyaM, sADyaH -DyA -DyaM, nirddeSanIyaH -yA -yaM.
EVINCIBLY , adv. spazwaM, suspazwaM, suvyaktaM, asaMSayaM, atra na sandehaH.
Eviscerate, a. niraMtrIkf 8 U.
EVISCERATE: antrARi apanayati (nI, c. 1.) or apohati (Uh, c. 1.) (with gen.).
To EVISCERATE , v. a. nirantrIkf, nirantra (nom. nirantrayati -yituM), nAqIr vahizkf.
Evitable, a. parihArya, heya, varjanIya, anAvaSyaka (kI f.), pariharaRIya.
EVITABLE , a. pariharaRIyaH -yA -yaM, heyaH -yA -yaM, varjjanIyaH -yA -yaM.
EVOCATION , s. (Calling upon) AhvAnaM, prahvAyaH, anukarzaRaM. — (Ap- -pealing) punarAhvAnaM, punarvicAraprArTanA, anyaprAqvivAkasAkzAd AhvAnaM.

Evoke, v. t. A-hve 1 P, A-samA-kfz 1 P. 2 utpad c., jan c. (janayati); pra-buD c. protsah c., uttij c.; ‘his speech e(vok)ed laughter’ tasya vacaH prahAsAya baBUva, upa-hAsAspadaM jAtaM. Evocation, s. AhvAnaM. 2 Appeal, q. v.
EVOKE: (1) Ahvayati (hve, c. 1.) (= to call);(2) nizkarzati (kfz, c. 1.) (= to draw out)
To EVOKE , v. a. Ahve (c. 1. -hvayati -hvAtuM), prahve, anukfz (c. 1. -karzati -krazwuM). — (From one tribunal to another) anyavicAra- -saBAsAkzAd Ahve.
EVOLUTION: I Development: udBedaH, e. of affection: anurAgasyodBedaH, Ma.II A series: paramparA.III In arith: mUlalABaH (?).
EVOLUTION , s. (Unfolding) vistAraH -raRaM, prasAraRaM, prakawIkaraRaM, vivAraH, vivftiH f. — (In arithmetic) prAdurBAvaH. — (Series) SreRI, SreDI.

Evolve, v. t. vi-vf 5 U, udBid c. 2 vi-stF c., pra-sf c., vitan 8 U. Evolution, s. udBedaH, vivaraRaM. 2 vistAraH-raRaM, prasAraRaM. 3 paraMparA, SreRI. 4 mUlalABaH. 5 pariRAmaH; ‘theory of e(volution)’ pariRAmavAdaH.
EVOLVE (v.): I To disclose: q. v.: vivfRoti (vf, c. 5.).II To emit: q. v.
To EVOLVE , v. a. vistF in caus. (-stArayati -yituM), prasf in caus. (-sArayati -yituM), vivf (c. 5. -vfRoti -varituM -rItuM), apAvf, vitan (c. 8. -tanoti -nituM), vitatIkf.
EVOLVED , p. p. vistAritaH -tA -taM, prasAritaH -tA -taM, vivftaH -tA -taM.
Evulsion, s. utpAwanaM, utkarzaRaM, avaluMcanaM.
EVULSION: (1) luYcanam, ava-, ut-;(2) pAwanam, ut-, vi-.
EVULSION , s. utpAwanaM, utkarzaRaM, vikarzaRaM, ulluYcanaM, avaluYcanaM.
Ewe, s. mezI, eqakA, uraRI, avilA; ‘e(ve)ʼs milk’ avisoQaM, avidUsaM.
EWE: (1) mezI;(2) BeqI;(3) uraRI;(4) eqakA.
EWE , s. mezI -zikA, eqakA, uraRI, BeqI, avilA; ‘ewe's milk,’ avisoQaM, avidUsaM, avimarIsaM.
Ewer, s. kamaMqaluH, kuMBaH, udakapAtraM.
EWER: kamaRqaluH: v. Pitcher.
EWER , s. GawI, udakapAtraM, udapAtraM, kumBaH, puwagrIvaH, kamaRqaluH m.
Exacerbate, v. t. pra-kup c. uttij c., kroDaM uddIp c.; See Enrage. [Exacerbat]ion, s. prakopaRaM-naM, kroDoddIpanaM.
To EXACERBATE , v. a. prakup in caus. (-kopayati -yituM), uttij in caus. (-tejayati -yituM), tIkzRIkf, tigmataraM -rAM -raM kf, tIvataraM -rAM -raM kf, ugrataraM -rAM -raM kf.
EXACERBATION , s. prakopaH -paRaM, uttejanaM, samuttejanaM, ugratvaM, kopajvalanaM, kopavarDanaM, rogavfdDiH f.

Exact, s. yaTArTa, yaTAtaTa, fta, satya. 2 Suci, nirdoza, SudDa. 3 avahita, apramatta; oft. by viSeza in comp.; sTalaviSezaH, naraviSezaH ‘e(xact) place’, ‘e(xact) man &c.’. 4 sUkzma, vi-Sizwa. 5 nirviSeza, samAna. v. t. balena grah 9 U or AdA 3 A, balAd grah or nizkfz 1 P or A-hf c., dA c. (dApayati); oft. by causal. 2 bAD 1 A, ard c., upapIq 10. [Exact]ion, s. balAd grahaRaM or AdAnaM, ni-zkarzaH, dApanaM. 2 upadravaH, viplavaH, bADA-DanaM, upapIqA. [Exact]ly, adv. yaTArTataH, yaTAvat, yaTAtaTaM, tattvataH, samyak, satyaM, sUkzmatayA. 2 nADikaM, na nyUnaM; oft. by eva; ‘e(xactly) so’ evameva, aTa kiM, taTEva; ‘they two are e(xactly) alike’ nAsti kimapi tayoraMtaraM. [Exact]ness, s. yATArTyaM, satyatA, tattvatA. 2 sUkzmatA. 3 avaDAnaM, apramAdaH.
EXACT (adj.): I Precise: q. v.: yaTArTaH (rTA, rTaM).II Accurate, punctual: q. v.: svavahitaH (tA, taM).
EXACT (v.): nizkarzati (kfz, c. 1.): v. To extort take.

EXACT , a. (Accurate, correct) yaTArTaH -rTA -rTaM, yATArTikaH -kI -kaM, samaYjasaH -sA -saM, aYjasaH -sA -saM, satyaH -tyA -tyaM, ftaH -tA -taM, taTyaH -TyA -TyaM, yaTAtaTaH -TA -TaM, SuciH -ciH -ci, SudDaH -dDA -dDaM, nirdozaH -zA -zaM, dozarahitaH -tA -taM, spazwaH -zwA -zwaM. — (Careful) sayatnaH -tnA -tnaM, avahitaH -tA -taM, apramAdI -dinI -di (n). — (Nice, precise) sUkzmaH -kzmA -kzmaM. — (Not different) samAnaH -nA -naM, nirviSezaH -zA -zaM, ananyaH -nyA -nyaM -nyat, samasamAnaH -nA -naM. — (Neither more nor less) nADiko na ca nyUnaH; ‘the exact state,’ tAratamyaM; ‘exact measurement,’ sUkzmamAnaM.

To EXACT , v. a. (Compel to pay) dA in caus. (dApayati -yituM), vihA in caus. (-hApayati -yituM); ‘exact tribute,’ baliM or Sulkam Ahf in caus. (-hArayati -yituM) or avahf. — (Take forcibly) balAt or balena grah (c. 9. gfhlAti, grahItuM) or AdA (c. 3. -dadAti -datte -dAtuM). — (Demand) yAc (c. 1. yAcati -cituM), prArT (c. 10. -arTayati -te -yituM). — (Enforce) kf in caus. (kArayati -yituM) with 2 acc.; ‘exact punishment,’ daRqaM praRI (c. 1. -Rayati -RetuM).
To EXACT , v. n. bAD (c. 1. bADate -DituM), bADaM kf, upadravaM kf, upaDiM kf.
EXACT , a. samyaN -mIcI -myak (Yc). EXACTION, s. balAtkAraH.
EXACTED , p. p. balAdgfhItaH -tA -taM, avahAritaH -tA -taM, AhAritaH -tA -taM, AkAritaH -tA -taM, vihApitaH -tA -taM.
EXACTER , s. balAtkArapUrvvaM parasvAdAyI m. (n) or parasvagrAhakaH, upaDikaH, [Page241-b+ 51] OpaDikaH, bADakaH, AhArakaH, avahArakaH, hArakaH.
EXACTING , a. bADakaH -kA -kaM, vipralumpakaH -kA -kaM, prArTakaH -kA -kaM.
EXACTION: I Extortion: q. v.: nizkarzaH, -Ram. II That which is exacted: perh nizkarzaH, -Ram (after utpIqanam).
EXACTION , s. balena grahaRaM or AdAnaM or haraRaM, BartsanapUrvvaM prArTanaM or yAcanA, bADaH -DanaM, upadravaH, viplavaH, upaDikaraRaM, parasvAdAnaM, arkavrataM.
EXACTLY: I Precisely, accurately: q. v.: yaTArTataH.II Nicely: sUkzmam, Ph.: these are e. alike: nAsti kaScidanayorviSezaH; e. so: evameva: v. Just (adv.).

EXACTLY , adv. yaTArTaM, yaTAvat, samyak, aYjasA, samaYjasaM, yaTAtaTaM, taTyaM, satyaM, ftaM, sUkzmatvena, sUkzmatayA; ‘neither more nor less,’ nADikaM na ca nyUnaM; ‘exactly so,’ evameva, taTEva; ‘exactly alike,’ samasamAnaH -nA -naM.
EXACTNESS: I Accuracy: q. v.: SudDatA.II Nicety: q. v.: sUkzmatA.III Carefulness: q.v.: avahitatA.IV Regularity: q. v.

EXACTNESS , s. (Accuracy) yATArTyaM, yaTArTatA, samyaktvaM, yATAtaTyaM, satyatA, taTyaM, sAmaYjasyaM, SudDatA. — (Niceness, precision) sUkzmatA, sOkzmyaM. — (Carefulness) avahitatvaM, apramAdaH, yatnaH, AsTA. — (Regularity, method) pAripAwyaM, samatA, anukramaRaM, kramAnusAraH, nyAyaH.
Exaggerate, v. t. atiSayena-atyuktyA varR 10 or kaT 10; saMvfD c. (Mr. 9), vistF c. [Exaggerat]ion, s. atyukti f., atiSayokti f., ati-varRanaM, vAgupacayaH, saMvarDanaM.
EXAGGERATE (v.): perh. varDayati (c. of vfD) or aDikaM kaTayati (kaT, c. 10.).

To EXAGGERATE , v. a. atyktyA or atiSayoktyA vfD (c. 10. varDayati -yituM) or vistF in caus. (-stArayati -yituM) or aDikIkf, or upaci (c. 5. -cinoti -cetuM), atiSayena varR (c. 10. varRayati -yituM), ativarRanaM kf, atyuktiM kf, vAgvistAraM kf.
EXAGGERATED , p. p. varDitaH -tA -taM, aDikIkftaH -tA -taM, vistAritaH -tA -taM, upacitaH -tA -taM, atyuktipUrvvaM varRitaH -tA -taM or prapaYcitaH -tA -taM.
EXAGGERATION: (1) atyuktiH or atiSayoktiH (= hyperbole).
EXAGGERATION , s. atyuktiH f., atiSayoktiH f., aDikaM, vAgADikyaM, aDikI- -karaRaM, vAgupacayaH, vAkyabAhulyaM, citroktiH, ativarRanA, atiprapaYcaH.
To EXAGITATE , v. a. vikzuB in caus. (-kzoBayati -yituM). See AGITATE.

Exalt, v. t. unnam c. (namayati), nI 1 P or prAp c., unnI 1 P, ucCri c., utkfz 1 P; uccapadaM, prAp c. or aDiruh c. (ropayati), utkfzwapade niyuj 7 A, 10. [Exalt]ation, s. unnati f., ucCrAyaH, unnamanaM, utkarzaH, uccapadAropaRaM; ‘self e(xaltation)’ AtmotkarzaH. [Exalt]ed, a. unnata, ucCrita, utkfzwa, parama, uccEH; ‘e(xalted) place’ uccEH-padaM; ‘e(xalted) rank’ gOravapadaM; See Elevate.

EXALT: I Lit.: unnamayati (c. of nam), e. ed by the echoes: pratisvanErunnamitaH (tA, taM), Ki.: v. To lift.II Fig., to elevate:(1) unnamayati, sam- or unnatiM or samunnatiM nayati (nI, c. 1.), prApayati (c. of Ap) etc., e. s some: kAMScinnayatyunnatim, Mr.; (2) ucCrAyayati, sam-, (c. of Sri), e. ing (his) prowess by arms: astrErvIryamucCrAyayizyan, Vi.III To elate: ullAsayati (c. of las), e. s Daśaratha: daSaraTamullAsayati, An.

To EXALT , v. a. unnam in caus. -namayati -yituM), ucCri (c. 1. ucCrayati -yituM, rt. Sri), samucCri, uccIkf, UrdDvIkf, unnI (c. 1. -nayati -netuM), unnatiM kf, samunnatiM kf, udDf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM), aDiruh in caus. (-ropayati -yituM). See ELEVATE.
EXALTATION: I The act: unnamanam.II The state:(1) unnatiH, sam-,.(2) ucCrAyaH, sam-.
EXALTATION , s. unnatiH f., samunnatiH f., utkarzaH, utkfzwatA, OtkarzaM, ucCrayaH, samucCrayaH, utseDaH, udDatiH f., udayaH, uccatA, UrdDvatvaM, aDirohaH. See ELEVATION.

EXALTED: (1) unnataH (tA, taM), sam-, bending the e.: unnatAnnamayan, K.(2) ucCritaH (tA, taM), sam-, in a very e. minister: atyucCrite mantriRi, Mu.; (3) uccEH (= high), a more e. place: uccEstaraM padam, Ku.
EXALTED, TO BE: unnamati (nam, c. 1.), as if the sky was e.: dyOrunnanAmeva, K.

EXALTED , p. p. unnataH -tA -taM, samunnataH -tA -taM, ucCritaH -tA -taM, utkfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, udDataH -tA -taM, udyataH -tA -taM, aDiropitaH -tA -taM, aDirUQaH -QA -QaM, udDftaH -tA -taM, AByudayikaH -kI -kaM. See ELEVATED.
EXAMINATION: parIkzA, e. of gems: ratnaparIkzA, Mal.; e. -in-chief: *pUrvaparIkzA; post mortem e.: *pretaparIkzA; e. of urine: mUtraparIkzA, Bha.; after e. (of a book): parIkzya, Mal.

EXAMINATION , s. (Investigation) parIkzA -kzaRaM, nirUpaRaM, anusanDAnaM, vicAraH -raRaM -RA, jijYAsA, anvezaRA -RaM, anuyogaH, samIkzaRaM, saMvIkzaRaM, prasamIkzA, nirRayaH, carccA, nirUpyatvaM, vimarSaH, niScayaH, parIzwiH f., vivecanA, SoDanaM. — (By question) praSnena parIkzA, praSnottarakrameRa jijYAsA or parIkzA. — (Inspection) nirIkzaRaM, AlocanaM, avekzA -kzaRaM, darSanaM, sandarSanaM. — (Judicial) vicAraH, vyavahAradarSanaM, AhvAna- -darSanaM; ‘examination of a witness,’ sAkziparIkzA.

Examine, v. t. parIkz 1 A, nirUp 10, anu-saMDA 3 U, vicar c., vimfS 6 P, avekz, A-paryA-loc 10. 2 nirRI 1 P, niSci 5 U, paricCid 7 P. 3 anuyuj 7 A, pracC 6 P; mfg 10 A, anviz 4 P, carcAM kf 8 U, jYA desid. (jijYAsate). 4 nirIkz, samIkz, parIkz, nirUp, dfS 1 P, A-ava-lok 1 A, 10. [Examin]ation, s. parIkzA-kzaRaM, vicAraH-raRaM-RA, nirUpaRaM, anusaMDAnaM, anuyogaH, praSnaH. 2 nirIkzaRaM, AlocanaM, saMdarSanaM, avekzA; ‘judicial e(xamination)’ vyavahAradarSanaM. [Examin]er, s. parI-kzakaH, vicArakaH, anuyoktf m., prASnikaH.

EXAMINE (v.): parIkzate, saM-, (Ikz, c. 1.), one should e. and then form association: saNgataM parIkzya kartavyam, Sa.; shall e. a sick man by look, touch and question: darSanasparSanapraSnE rogiRaM parIkzeta, Bha.; shall not e. witnesses in all cases of violence: sAhasesu ca sarvezu na parIkzeta sAkziRaH, N. s.

To EXAMINE , v. a. (Investigate) parIkz (c. 1. -Ikzate -kzituM), nirUp (c. 10. -rUpayati -yituM), anusanDA (c. 3. -daDAti -DAtuM), jYA in des. (jijYAsate -situM), anviz (c. 4. -ipyati -ezituM) or anvez (c. 1. -ezate -zituM), anuyuj (c. 7. -yunakti -yuMkte -yoktuM), vicar in caus. (-cArayati -yituM), carc (c. 1. carcati -rcituM), vimfS (c. 6. -mfSati -mrazwuM), nirRI (c. 1. -Rayati -RetuM), niSci (c. 5. -cinoti -cetuM), viniSci, vici, aBiniDyE (c. 1. -DyAyati -DyAtuM), mArg (c. 10. mArgayati -yituM). — (In- -spect) nirIkz, avekz, samIkz, vIkz, aBivIkz, dfS (c. 1. paSyati drazwuM), anudfS, paridfS, sandfS, pratidfS, Aloc (c. 10. -locayati -yituM), Alok (c. 10. -lokayati -yituM). — (Interrogate) anupracC (c. 6. -pfcCati -prazwuM), paripracC, samanupracC, praSnena parIkz, praSnottarakrameRa parIkz or anuyuj. — (Judicially) vica r in caus. vicAraM kf; ‘examine witnesses,’ sAkziRaH parIkza.

EXAMINED , p. p. nirUpitaH -tA -taM, parIkzitaH -tA -taM, nirIkzitaH -tA -taM, avekzitaH -tA -taM, jijYAsitaH -tA -taM, vicAritaH -tA -taM, anuyuktaH -ktA -ktaM, carccitaH -tA -taM, anvezitaH -tA -taM, nirRItaH -tA -taM, AlocitaH -tA -taM.
EXAMINER: (1) parIkzakaH or parIkzin (m.), e. of coins: nARakaparIkzI, Y.;(2) prASnikaH (by ques- -tions), your Reverence should take the post of e.: BagavatyA prASnikapadamaDyAsitavyam, Mal.
EXAMINER , s. parIkzakaH, vicArakaH, vicArakarttA m. (rttf), anusanDAtA m. (tf), nirUpakaH, anuyoktA m. (ktf), nirRetA m. (tf), jijYAsAkft.

sanskrit.slp1: yat pramARaM sa kurute lokas tad anuvarttate
sanskrit.word: यत् प्रमाणं स कुरुते लोकस् तद् अनुवर्त्तते
sanskrit.iast: yat pramāṇaṃ sa kurute lokas tad anuvarttate

details.body: Example, s. udAharaRaM, nidarSanaM, dfzwAMtaH; ‘for e(xample)’ yaTA, taTAhi. 2 AdarSaH, pramARaM; ‘follow an e(xample)’ anukf 8 U, pramARaM man 4 A, vartma anugam 1 P, padamanuviDA 3 U, (padamanuviDeyaM ca mahatAM). Exemplary, a. pramARI-AdarSI-BUta, dfzwAMtayogya, pramARa-yogya. 2 praSasya, SlAGya; anukaraRIya-karaRArha. [Exemplari]ly, adv. pramARavat, pramARamiva, dfzwAMta-rUpeRa, anukaraRIyatayA. Exemplify, v. t. udAhf 1 P, dfzwAMtena spazwIkf 8 U or prakAS c. or pra-dfS c. [Exemplif]ication, s. udAharaRaM, nidarSanaM, udAharaRena spazwIkaraRaM.

EXAMPLE: I Lit.:(1) udAharaRam, I am an e. of it: tasyAhamasmyudAharaRaBUtA, D. vi.;(2) nidarSanam, with e. s: sanidarSanaH (nA, naM), K.;(3) dfzwAntaH, an e. of the weak: durbalAnAM dfzwAntaH, M. n.: v. Also instance.II Fig., =way: q. v. “to give e.”: panTAnaM darSyati (c. of dfS).

EXAMPLE , s. (Pattern for imitation) pramARaM, pramA, AdarSaH, pratirUpaM, pratimA -mAnaM; ‘to follow an example,’ anukf; ‘following an example,’ anukaraRaM; ‘whatever example he sets, the world follows,’ yat pramARaM sa kurute lokas tad anuvarttate; ‘men follow my example,’ mama vartma manuzyA anuvarttante or anugacCanti. — (Person fit for an example) pramARaM, pramAtA m. (tf). — (Instance serving for illustration) dfzwAntaH, nidarSanaM, udAhAraH -haraRaM, upodGAtaH; ‘for example,’ dfzwAntarUpeRa, dfzwAntakrameRa, yaTA, taTAhi.
Exanimate, a. nirjIva, vicetana. 2 nirutsAha, BagnotsAha.
EXANIMATE: I Dead: q. v.: gatajIvitaH (tA, taM).II Spiritless, dejected: q. v.
EXANIMATE , a. nirjIvaH -vA -vaM, ajIvaH -vA -vaM, vicetanaH -nA -naM, nistejAH -jAH -jaH (s), BagnamanAH -nAH -naH (s), nirutsAhaH -hA -haM, prARahInaH -nA -naM.
To EXANIMATE , v. a. nirjIvIkf, manoBaNgaM kf, tejo hf (c. 1. harati, harttuM).
EXANIMATION , s. prARahatyA, manoBaNgaH, utsAhaBaNgaH, tejoharaRaM.

Exasperate, v. t. prakup c., saMkzuB c., ruz c., kruD c., saM-raB c. (raMBayati), kroDaM uddIp c. [Exasperat]ed, a. prakopita, saMrabDa, jAtAmarza, idDamanyu, pradIptakroDa, saMkzubDa, prakzoBita. [Exasperat]ion, s. prakopaRaM-naM, saMraMBaH, kroDoddIpanaM.
EXASPERATE: I To enrage: q. v.:(1) ut- kopayati (c. of kup);(2) saMkzoBayati (c. of kzuB).II To aggravate: varDayati (c. of vfD).
To EXASPERATE , v. a. kup in caus. (kopayati -yituM), prakup, saNkup, kopaM or kroDaM jan (c. 10. janayati -yituM), kruD in caus. (kroDayati -yituM).
EXASPERATED , p. p. prakopitaH -tA -taM, prakupitaH -tA -taM, upajAtakopaH -pA -paM, jAtakroDaH -DA -DaM, saMrabDaH -bDA -bDaM, jAtAmarzaH -rzA -rzaM, idDamanyuH -nyuH -nyu.
EXASPERATION: I Irritation: utkopanam.II Increase: vfdDiH.
EXASPERATION , s. prakopaH -paRaM, kroDakaraRaM, kopakaraRaM, saMramBaH.
To EXAUCTORATE , v. a. padAt or aDikArAd BraMS (c. 10. BraMSayati -yituM). See DISMISS.

Excavate, v. t. utKan 1 P, nirBid 7 P or c., vidF 10. [Excavat]ion, s. vidAraRaM, utKananaM. 2 KAtaM, gartaH-rtA, raMDraM, bilaM, suziraM; ‘e(xcavation) underneath the ground’ suraMgA. [Excavat]or, s. KanakaH, KAtakft m.
EXCAVATE: (1) Kanati: v. To dig.:(2) vidArayati (c. of dF).

To EXCAVATE , v. a. Kan (c. 1. Kanati -te -nituM), utKan, niKan, aBiKan, protKan, KanitreRa BUmiM Bid (c. 7. Binatti, BettuM) or dF in caus. (dArayati -yituM) or BUmO garttaM or vivaraM kf, SuzirIkf, SUnyIkf.
EXCAVATED , p. p. niKAtaH -tA -taM, utKAtaH -tA -taM, KAtaH -tA -taM, KanitaH -tA -taM, SuzirIkftaH -tA -taM, SUnyIkftaH -tA -taM, puwitaH -tA -taM.
EXCAVATION: I The act:(1) Kananam;(2) vidAraRam.II A cavity or hollow q. v.: KAtam.
EXCAVATION , s. (Act of digging out) KananaM, utKananaM. — (A cavity) KAtaM, garttaH, ranDraM, kuharaM, avawaH -wiH m., vilaM, SuziraM.
EXCAVATOR: I A digger: q. v.II A machine: *vidAriRI.
EXCAVATOR , s. KanakaH, KanitA m. (tf), AKanikaH, KAtakaH.
To EXCECATE , v. a. anDIkf, timirIkf, timira (nom. timirayati -yituM).

Exceed, v. t. ati-i 2 P, ati-kram 1 U, 4 P; sa satkAro manoraTAnAmapyaBUmiH (S. 7) ‘e(xceed)ed even my expectations’; ati-car-gam 1 P, laMG 1 A, 10; See Beyond also. 2 ati-SI 2 A, ati-BU 1 P; See Excel. [Exceed]ing, a. atiSayin, atirikta, aDika, atirekin. 2 atyaMta, parama, para, BUri, su pr., ati pr.; ‘e(xceeding) manʼs power’ atimAnuza; ‘e(xceeding) written orders’ AjYA-patramullaMGayan. [Exceed]ingly, adv. atyaMtaM, nitAMtaM, ekAMtana atyarTaM, nirBaraM, pragAQaM, sutarAM, nitarAM, pra-ni-kAmaM, sAtiSayaM, atimAtraM, atIva, ati-su pr. Excess, s. utkarzaH, gAQatA, bAhu-lyaM, prAcuryaM, utsekaH, atiSayaH, upacayaH, ADikyaM, atirekaH, udrekaH. 2 pOnaruktyaM, punarutkatA. 3 maryAdAtikramaH, atikramaH, atyAcAraH, asaMyamaH, aparimitatA. [Excess]ive, a. atyaMta, atyaDika, atyarTa, atimAtra, pragAQa, para, parama, sAtiSaya, nirBara, utkawa, nitAMta, aparimita, ekAMta, atirikta, atiguru, tIvra; gen. by su-ati pr. [Excess]ively, adv. atyaMtaM, su-ati- pr., tIvraM, balavat; See above.
EXCEED (v.): (1) atikrAmati or krAmyati (kram, c. 1. and 4.);(2) atyeti (i, c. 2.), Ki.: v. Surpass, excel.

To EXCEED , v. a. and n. atikram (c. 1. -krAmati -kramituM), atiBU (c. 1. -Bavati -vituM), aBiBU, atI (c. 2. atyeti -tuM rt. i), atiSI (c. 2. -Sete -SayituM), aDiSI, aticar (c. 1. -carati -rituM), atigam (c. 1. -gacCati -gantuM), atiric in pass. (-ricyate), with abl. c. atiriktaH -ktA -ktaM, BU, aDikIBU, laNG (c. 10. laNGayati -yituM), vyatyas (c. 2. vyatiste).
EXCEEDED , p. p. atikrAntaH -ntA -ntaM, utkrAntaH -ntA -ntaM, atItaH -tA -taM, atyayitaH -tA -taM, atiSAyitaH -tA -taM, laNGitaH -tA -taM.
EXCEEDING (= prep.): (1) expr. by verb; (2) by ati- in comp. (rare), e. human spirit and prowess: atimAnuzaprARabalaH (lA, laM), D.
EXCEEDING, EXCEEDINGLY (adv.): (1) ati, you are e. arrogant: ati hi nAmAvalipyase, Vi.; (2) atyantam, e. proud: atyantamAnin (f. nI), Mu.; (3) atimAtram;(4) atIva: v. Also extremely, excessively.

EXCEEDING , a. (Surpassing) atikrAmakaH -kA -kaM, aticaraH -rA -raM, atigaH -gA -gaM, atirekI -kiRI -ki (n), atiSayI -yinI -yi (n), atiriktaH -ktA -ktaM, aDikaH -kA -kaM -kataraH -rA -raM, samaDikaH -kA -kaM -kataraH -rA -raM, aByaDikaH -kA -kaM. — (In a great degree, very) atyantaH -ntA -ntaM, ati or su or atiSaya prefixed, BUriH -riH -ri, gAQaH -QA -QaM, vAQaH -QA -QaM, paramaH -mA -maM, paraH -rA -raM, atimitaH -tA -taM, aparimitaH -tA -taM, puruH -ruH -ru; ‘exceeding large,’ atimahAn -hatI -hat (t), sumahAn &c.; ‘exceeding [Page242-b+ 51] bounds,’ atimaryyAdaH -dA -daM, atiBUmiH -miH -mi; ‘exceeding human power,’ atimAnuzaH -zA -zaM, janAtigaH -gA -gaM; ‘exceed- -ing orders,’ ullaNGitaSAsanaH -nA -naM.

EXCEEDINGLY , adv. ati or su or atiSaya prefixed, atiSayaM -yena, sAtiSayaM, BfSaM, atyantaM, nirBaraM, atyarTaM, atIva, nitAntaM, paraM, gAQaM, vAQaM, pragAQaM, ekAntatas, atitarAM, sutarAM, atimAtraM, aDikaM, nikAmaM, sumahat.

Excel, v. t. atiSI 2 A, dUrI-aDaH-aDarI-kf 8 U, viSiz c.; atiric-viSiz pass. (with abl. of person); atikram 1 U, 4 P, ati-i 2 P; oft. by ji 1 P, aBi-parA-BU 1 P, tiraskf, Dikkf, pratyAKyA 2 P, pratyAdiS 6 P. [Excel]lence, s. viSizwatA, u-tkarzaH, prakarzaH, atiSayaH, SrezWatA, uttamatA, saMpad f., ‘e(xcellance) of beauty’ rUpasaMpad. 2 guRotkarzaH, guRaviSizwatA-prakarzaH. 3 guRaH, guRavattA, paraBAgaH, utkfzwaguRaH. [Excel]lency, s. utkarzaH, &c. 2 devaH, mahArAjaH-BAgaH. [Excel]lent, a. viSizwa, utkfzwa, uttama, SrezWa, parama, agra, vareRya, praSasyatama, pravara, guRavat, sAravat, guRopeta; oft. by vara-viSeza in comp., and by words like fzaBaH, puMgavaH, vyAGraH, siMhaH, SArdUlaH, iMdraH, prakAMqaH, udDaH, tallajaH, matallikA, macarcikA, in comp.; pAtraviSezaH ‘e(xcellent) receptacle’; ‘e(xcellent) cow’ gomatallikA, gotallajaH, gavodDaH, goprakAMqaH, &c.; ‘e(xcellent) man’ puruzarzaBaH, puruzasiMhaH, &c. [Excel]lently, adv. suzWu, uttamaM, su pr.

EXCEL (v. t.): (1) prakfzyate or ut- (pass. of kfz) (= to be drawn up) (with abl.), no body e.s Viśvāmitra in greatness: na Kalu viSvAmitrAnmahatvena kaScidaparaH prakfzyate, Vi. i.;(2) ativartate (vft, c. 1.) (= to be beyond), what is eulogy to you whose dignity e.s the range of eulogy: kA te stutiH stutipaTAdativfttaDAmnaH, Vi.;(3) atiSete (SI, c. 2.) (= to lie beyond), in this your Excellency e. s your ancestors: pUrvAn mahABAgatayAtiSeze, R. v. 14; (4) atiricyate (pass. of ric) (to be more) (with abl.); truth e. s even thousand horse- sacrifices: aSvameDasahasrAdDi satyamevAtiricyate, H. iv.;(5) aDarayati (nomi.) (= put down: q. v.), e. ling the sages in his pure acts: caritE- rmunInaDarayan SuciBiH, Ki. vi. 24.;(6) tiraskaroti (= to eclipse: q. v.), M. n;(7) aBiBavati (BU, c. 1.) (= to humble: q. v.), e. ling the frag- rance of other flowers: aBiBUtAnyakusumaparimalam, K.; (8) jayati (ji, c. 1.) (= to conquer: q. v.), Si. i. 19.;(9) hepayati (c. of hI) (= to put to shame), Ki. xiii. 41.;(10) nindati (nind, c. 1.) (= to censure: q. v.), Gi. ii. 6.: v. To surpass.

To EXCEL , v. a. and n. viSiz in pass. (-Sizyate), with abl. c., atiric in pass. (-ricyate), with abl. c., atiSI (c. 2. -Sete -SayituM), atikram (c. 1. -krAmati -kramituM), atI (c. 2. anyeti -tuM rt. i), aticar (c. 1. -carati -rituM), atigam (c. 1. -gacCati -gantuM), atiBU, aBiBU, ji (c. 1. jayati, jetuM), viji, parAji, praSaMs in pass. (-Sasyate); ‘one whose eyes excel the lotus,’ aDikzipadabjanetraH -trI.
To EXCEL , l. 3. for anyeti, read atyeti.
EXCELLED , p. p. atItaH -tA -taM, atikrAntaH -ntA -ntaM, atiSAyitaH -tA -taM.
EXCELLENCE: I Superiority:(1) utkarzaH or prakarzaH;(2) utkfzwatA;(3) viSizwatA: v. Also greatness, loftiness.II Any good quality: guRaH or mahadguRaH or viSizwaguRaH.

EXCELLENCE , EXCELLENCY, s. (State of excelling or possessing good qualities) viSizwatA, vESizwyaM, SrezWatA -tvaM, utkfzwatA, utkarzaH, OtkarzyaM, prakarzaH, prakfzwatvaM, prASastyaM, praSastiH f., uttamatA, guRavESezyaM, guRotkarzaH, guRaprakarzaH, guRitA, guRatA, guRavattA -ttvaM, sAratvaM, kOSalaM, sOzWavaM, sAratvaM, matallikA, macarcikA, udGaH, tallajaH, prakARqaH -RqaM. — (Any valuable quality) guRaH, utkfzwaguRaH, paraBAgaH; ‘your excellency,’ Aryya.
EXCELLENCY: I Excellence: q. v.II A title: devaH (f. vI) (applied to kings and ministers); mahABAgaH (gA, gaM).

EXCELLENT: I Admirable, eminent: q. v.: (1) utkfzwaH (zwA, zwaM);(2) viSizwaH (zwA, zwaM); (3) prakfzwaH (zwA, zwaM), the bird parrot is of e. form: SukapakzI prakfzwarUpaH, S. p. b.II Extremes: q. v.

EXCELLENT , a. viSizwaH -zwA -zwaM, utkfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, SrezWaH -zWA -zWaM, uttamaH -mA -maM, anuttamaH -mA -maM, praSastaH -stA -staM, praSasyaH -syA -syaM, SastaH -stA -staM, SasyaH -syA -syaM, SreyAn -yasI -yaH (s), sattamaH -mA -maM, SizwaH -zwA -zwaM, paramaH -mA -maM, agriyaH -yA -yaM, agraH -grA -graM, paraH -rA -raM, varaH -rA -raM, pravaraH -rA -raM, vareRyaH -RyA -RyaM, pravarhaH -rhA -rhaM, puzkalaH -lA -laM, atiSoBanaH -nA -naM, sAravAn -vatI -vat (t), aryyaH -ryyA -ryyaM, BawwArakaH -kA -kaM, apIvyaH -vyA -vyaM. — (Having excellent qualities) guRI -RinI -Ri (n), guRavAn -vatI -vat (t), guRAtkfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, guRopetaH -tA -taM, guRamayaH -yI -yaM, guRavattamaH -mA -maM, aDiguRaH -RA -RaM; ‘having numberless good qualities,’ aparimitaguRagaRaH -RA -RaM. Excellent may be expressed by fzaBaH or puNgavaH or vyAGraH or siMhaH or SArdUlaH or indraH or prakARqaH in comp.; as, ‘an excellent or eminent man,’ puruzarzaBaH, puruzavyAGraH, narapuNgavaH &c.; ‘an excellent woman,’ uttamA, varArohA, varavarRinI, mattakASinI, kumArItallajaH.
EXCELLENTLY , adv. uttamaM, anuttamaM, praSastaM, SrezWaM, su, suzWu, BadraM.

Except, v. t. vfj 10, parivfj, apa-vi-hA 3 P, tyaj 1 P, apAs 4 U, muc 6 P. 2 vyAvft c. (a rule &c.), saMkuc 1 P or c. prep. [Except]ing, varjayitvA, vihAya, muktvA, aMtarA-aMtareRa (with acc.), vinA (with acc., instr., or abl.), fte (with abl.); oft. by varjaM, vyatiriktaM in comp.; gOtamI-varjamitarA nizkrAMtAH (S. 4). 2 yadi na. K.). 3 varjanIyaM, varjyaM. 4 dozaH, bADaH-DA, apavAdaH; ‘take e(xception)’ dozaM grah 9 U, (nAtra dozaM grahI-zyati kulapatiH S. 3); See Objection, Objectionable. a. bADya, pariharaRIya, varjya. EXCEPT (v.): I Trans.: to leave out:(1) varjayati, vi-, (vfj, c. 10.);(2) apAsyati (as, c. 4.).II Intrans, to object: q. v.

EXCEPT, EXCEPTING (prep.): (1) by part.s [Page253] varjayitvA, vihAya, apahAya, muktvA, etc. (with acc.), e. your acceptance of Sitā: sItAyAH svIkAraM varjayitvA, M. n.; e. Damayantī: vihAya BEmIm, N. i. 13; (2) fte (with acc. or abl.), e. the sun: fte raveH, Si. i. 33.: v. Also but, without.

To EXCEPT , v. a. vfj (c. 10. varjjayati -yituM), apAs (c. 4. -asyati -asituM), paryyudas, vyudas, apahA (c. 3. -jahAti -hAtuM), vihA, tyaj (c. 1. tyajati, tyaktuM), muc (c. 6. muYcati, moktuM), upasaMhf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM).

EXCEPT , prep. varjjayitvA, apAsya, apahAya, BuktA all with acc. c., vinA with inst. or acc. c., fte with abl. or acc. c., antareRa, antarA, vyatirekeRa, vyatiriktaM, varjjaM, anyatra, pfTak. — (Unless) yadi na. Sometimes expressed by the loc. absolute; as, ‘ex- -cept ye eat flesh,’ Amize na Bukte or by the indecl. part.; as, ‘except ye see,’ na dfzwvA.

EXCEPTING , part. varjjayitvA, apAsya, muktvA, apahAya, hitvA, tyaktvA.

EXCEPTION (subs.): I Excluding: varjanam, vi-, Ph.: with the e. of: varjayitvA (with acc.): v. Except (prep.).II To rules, etc.: apavAdaH, e. to theft: cOryApavAdaH, Viv.; like precepts by e. s: apavAdErivotsargAH, Ku. ii. 27.III Objection: q. v.: ApattiH.

EXCEPTION , s. (Act of excepting) varjjaH -rjjanaM, azAsanaM, paryyudAsaH, vyudAsaH, apahAniH f., vinirmokaH, parihAraH -haraRaM, vyatirekaH, vyAvftiH f., apavAdaH, nizeDaH. — (In grammar) nipAtanaM, grahaRaM, vipakzaH, viDi- -saNkocaH, viDiBaYjakaH. — (That which is to be excepted) varjjanIyaM, varjyaM. — (Objection) bADaH -DA, apavAdaH, udgrAhaH.
EXCEPTIONABLE , a. bADyaH -DyA -DyaM, pariharaRIyaH -yA -yaM, parihAryyaH -ryyA -ryyaM, varjyaH -rjyA -rjyaM, varjjanIyaH -yA -yaM, apraSastaH -stA -staM.
EXCEPTIONAL: i. e. uncommon: asADAraRa (f. RI).

EXCERPT: I udDarati (hf, c. 1.).II Subs.: expr. by udDftaH (tA, taM).
EXCERPTED , p. p. udDftaH -tA -taM, nirhftaH -tA -taM, vyavasTitaH -tA -taM.
EXCERPTION: I The act: udDaraRam.II Except: expr. by udDftaH (tA, taM).
EXCERPTION , s. udDAraH, nirhAraH, vyavasTitiH f., cUrRiH m., cUrRikaraRaM.

(n), utkarzaH, gAQatA, AtyantikatA, samaBihAraH, ekAntatvaM, aparimitatvaM, bAhulyaM, prAcuryyaM. — (Transgression of due limits) maryyAdAtikramaH, amaryyAdA, atikramaH, atyAcAraH, atyayaH. — (Intemperance in eating, &c.) AhArAdivizaye asaMyamaH.

EXCESSIVELY: (1) atIva, e. agitated: atIva vyAkulita- cittaH, P.;(2) nitAntam, e. fond: nitAntavatsalaH, R.;(3) sAtiSayam: v. Exceedingly.

EXCESSIVELY , adv. BfSaM, suBfSaM, nirBaraM, atyantaM, atiSayaM -yena, sAtiSayaM, gAQaM, pragAQaM, udgAQaM, nitAntaM, atimAtraM, ekAntatas, atyarTaM, nirdayaM, atimaryyAdaM, atitarAM, sutarAM, tIvraM, balavat, ativelaM. Often expressed by ati or su or atiSaya prefixed; as, ‘exces- -sively sharp,’ atitIkzRaH -kzRA -kzRaM.

Exchange, v. t. vi-, ni-me 1 A, pratidA 1 P, 3 U, (tileByaH pratiyacCati mAzAn), pratipaR 1 A, vyati-hf 1 P, parivft c.; ‘e(xchange) civilities’ satkAravinimayaM kf; ‘by e(xchang)ing clothes’ vezaparivartanena-vyatihAreRa; anyo-nyasaMBinnadfSAM (Mal. 1) ‘who e(xchang)ed glances with each other’ s. vinimayaH, pari(rI)vartaH, parivftti f., parivartanaM, nEmeyaH, ni(vi)mayaH, paridAnaM, prati-dAnaM-paRanaM, vyatihAraH; oft. by anyonya or prati in comp.; ‘e(xchange) of favours’ anyonyopakAraH, ‘e(xchange) of looks’ anyonyadfzwipAtaH, parasparA-lokanaM; ‘e(xchange) of blows’ pratiGAtaH; ‘in e(xchange) for’ vinimayena, vyatihAreRa, pratidAnena. 2 BAMqa-dravya-vinimayaH. 3 SrezWicatvaraM.

EXCHANGE (subs.): I Lit.: vinimayaH, how many pomegranates are to be got in e.: kati dAqimAni laByAni tadvinimayena Bavanti, Li.; e. of qualities: guRAnAM vinimayaH, Ki.: v. Also change, inter- -change. Ph.: take my life in e. of hers: vihAya jIvitaM tasyA gfhARa mama jIvitam; bill of e.: *vinimaya- patram; e. is in favour of London: *laRqanAnukUlo vinimayaH.II E. place: SrezWicatvaram (?); *vinimaya- gfham.
EXCHANGE (v.): (1) mayate, ni-, (gen.) vini-, (me, c. 1.);(2) parivartayati (c. of vft) (= change: q. v.);(3) by circumlo., e. these for fuel: imAndattvA kAzWAnyAhara, D.

(-varttayati -yituM), nime (c. 1. -mayate -mAtuM), vinime, vime, all with acc. and inst. c., pratidA, parivarttaM kf, vinimayaM kf, vyatihf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM), pratipaR (c. 10. -paRayati -yituM). ‘To exchange’ may be expressed by the phrase ‘having given one thing to take another,’ anyad dattvA anyad AdA, or anyat tyaktvA anyad grah (c. 9. gfhlAti, grahItuM); ‘he exchanges beans for sesamum seeds,’ tilEr mASAn parivarttayati or tileByaH prati mAzAn dadAti; ‘liquids to be ex- -changed for liquids,’ rasA rasEr nimAtavyAH; ‘not to be ex- -changed,’ aparivarttanIyaH -yA -yaM, apratipaRyaH -RyA -RyaM.

EXCHANGEABLE: vinimeyaH (yA, yaM); vinimayayogyaH (gyA, gyaM).

EXCITABILITY , s. uttejanIyatA, uddIpanIyatA, uttejanakzamatA, uttApanIyatA, prakopaRIyatA, SIGrakopitvaM.

EXERTED , p. p. cezwitaH -tA -taM, udyataH -tA -taM, udyuktaH -ktA -ktaM, prayuktaH -ktA -ktaM, vyavasitaH -tA -taM, yattaH -ttA -ttaM, vAhitaH -tA -taM, pravarttitaH -tA -taM.
EXERTION: AyAsaH, from e.: AyAsAt, Si.: v. Effort.

EXERTION , s. cezwA -zwanaM, udyogaH, udyamaH, utsAhaH, yatnaH, vyavasAyaH, cezwitaM, vicezwitaM, prayatnaH, aGyavasAyaH, AyAsaH, prayAsaH, pravfttiH f., GawanaM, -nA GawA, guraRaM, gUraRaM, goraRaM, vyApAraH, grahaH, karmmayogaH, utTAnaM, prayogaH, vyAyAmaH.
EXEUNT OMNES , nizkrAntAH sarvve.
Exfoliate, v. i. paripuw 6 P, vigal 1 P.
EXFOLIATE: paripuwati (puw, c. 6.) (?).
To EXFOLIATE , v. n. aDyasTivad valkarUpeRa gal (c. 1. galati -lituM) or vigal, duzwAsTivat or galitAsTivad valkarUpaparipuwanaM kf.
EXFOLIATION: paripuwanam (?).
EXFOLIATION , s. aDyasTi n., aDyasTiparipuwanaM, aDyasTigalanaM.
EXHALATION: I The act:(1) udgAraH;(2) utkzepaH.II That which is exhaled: perh. udgAraH, N.

EXHALATION , s. (Act or process of exhaling) udgAraH, niSvAsaH, praSvAsaH, niHSvAsaH, niHSvasanaM, utkzepaH. — (Rising of vapour, &c.) vAzpo- dgAraH, vAzpodgatiH f., DUmodgatiH f. — (The vapour exhaled) vAzpaH, DUmaH -mikA; ‘sending forth exhalations,’ udgArI -riRI -ri (n).

Exhale, v. t. ud-gF 6 P, ucCvas 2 P, niSvas, utkzip 6 P, udvam 1 P, nirmuc 6 P, udIr c., nirgam c. (gamayati), pra-vA 2 P, nizkF 6 P, udgam c. 2 (As water) A-pA 1 P, ucCuz c., Acam 1 P, bAzpIkf 8 U; ‘trees e(xhal)ing fragrance’ parimalodgAriRaH vfkzAH. [Exhal]ation, s. udgAraH, niSvAsaH, ucCvAsaH, ucCvasitaM, nirgamaH, udvamanaM, utkzepaH. 2 bAzpaH, DUmikA, DUmaH. 3 bAzpodgamanaM, DUmodgAraH.
EXHALE: (1) udgirati (gF, c. 6.), to e. a smell: parimalam udgirati, Me.;(2) utkzipati (kzip, c. 6.) (= to throw up): v. To emit.

To EXHALE , v. a. udgF (c. 6. -girati -garituM -rItuM), niSvas (c. 2. -Svasiti -tuM), niHSvas, praSvas, pravA (c. 2. -vAti -tuM), muc (c. 6. muYcati, moktuM), pramac, udIr (c. 10. -Irayati -yituM), utkzip (c. 6. -kzipati -SveptuM), udgam in caus. (-gamayati -yituM), nirgam.
EXHALED , p. p. udgIrRaH -rRA -rRaM, niSvasitaH -tA -taM, udIrita. -tA -taM.
EXHALEMENT , s. udgAraH, udgIrRaM, vAzyaH, DUmaH -mikA.

Exhaust, v. t. ut-saM-Suz c., A-pA 1 P. 2 SUnyIkf 8 U, niHSezIkf, sarvasAraM hf 1 P, viric 7 P or c. 3 kzi 1 P, kzE c. (kzapayati), naS c., vyayaM-kzayaM-kf, apa-ci 5 U; ‘his wealth was e(xhaust)ed in performing meritorious deeds’ DarmakarmAMRiDarmakarmARi kurvatastasya DanakzayaH saMjAtaH (P. v. 1); ‘who had e(xhaust)ed his whole treasure in gifts (charity)’ niHSezaviSrARitakozajAtaM (R. v. 1). 4 Kid c., klam c. (klamayati), Sram c., avasad c., glE c., (glA-gla-payati); ‘I feel e(xhaust)ed’ klAMtosmi, avasa-nnAni me gAtrARi. [Exhaust]ed, a. Sozita, virikta, niHSezIkfta. 2 kzIRa, apacita. 3 SrAMta, klAMta, gKannaKinna, avasanna, glAna. [Exhaust]ion, s. SozaRaM. 2 kzayaH, parikzayaH, nASaH, vyayaH, apacayaH. 3 KedaH, SramaH, klamaH, glAni f., avasAdaH, SrAMti-klAMti f. [Exhaust]less, a. akzaya, anASya, AvinASin
EXHAUST (v.): I To empty: q. v.: SUnyI- karoti.II To dry up: q. v.: Sozayati (c. of Suz).III To consume: kzayaM or parikzayaM karoti. IV To weary: Kedayati (c. of Kid).

To EXHAUST , v. a. (Drain off, dry up) Suz in caus. (Sozayati -yituM), ucCuz, viSuz, saMSuz, SuzkIkf. — (Empty, draw out all the con- -tents) SUnyIkf, virasIkf, niHsArIkf, sarvvasAraM hf (c. 1. harati, hartuM), niHSezIkf, niravaSezIkf. — (Consume) kzi (c. 1. kzayati, c. 5. kziRoti or caus. kzapayati -yituM), kzIRIkf, naS in caus. (nASayati -yituM), vyayIkf. — (Weary, fatigue) Kid in caus. (Kedayati -yituM), glE in caus. (glapayati -yituM), pariglE, klam in caus. (klamayati -yituM), sad in caus. (sAdayati -yituM), avasad. — (Drink up) ApA (c. 1. -pivati -pAtuM), paripA.

EXHAUSTED , p. p. (Drained) SozitaH -tA -taM, ucCozitaH -tA -taM, SuzkIkftaH -tA -taM. — (Consumed) kzIRaH -RA -RaM, parikzIRaH -RA -RaM. — (Fatigued, wearied) SrAntaH -ntA -ntaM, pariSrAntaH -ntA -ntaM, klAntaH -ntA -ntaM, avasannaH -nnA -nnaM, KinnaH -nnA -nnaM, glAnaH -nA -naM, pariglAnaH -nA -naM, klamI -minI -mi (n), AhitaklamaH -mA -maM, kzataH -tA -taM. — (Expended) vyayitaH -tA -taM; ‘exhausted of strength,’ gatasattvaH -ttvA -ttvaM, gatatejAH -jAH -jaH (s), cyutotsAhaH -hA -haM.
EXHAUSTION: I Emptying:(1) SUnyIkaraRam; (2) riktIkaraRam.II Drying up: SozaRam, vi-, ut-.III Consumption: kzayaH, pari-.IV Fatigue: q. v.: KedaH. v. Dejection: ava- sAdaH.

EXHAUSTION , s. (Act of draining, emptying) SozaRaM, ucCozaRaM, SUnyIkaraRaM, sarvvasAraharaRaM. — (Consumption) kzayaH, parikzayaH, nASaH, vyayaH. — (Fatigue) klAntiH f., SrAntiH f., klamaH, SramaH, klamaTaH, avasAdaH, glAniH f., KedaH, pariSrAntiH f., klamitvaM. — (State of being empty) SUnyatA -tvaM.
EXHAUSTIVE: kzayin (f. RI), pari-.
EXHAUSTLESS: akzayaH (yA, yaM): v. Inexhausti- -ble.
EXHAUSTLESS , a. akzayaH -yA -yaM, akzayI -yiRI -yi(n), anASyaH -SyA -SyaM.

Exhibit, v. t. pra-draS c., prakAS c., nirdiS 6 P, prakawIkf 8 U, prakawayati (D.), vyaMj 7 P or c., vyaktIkf, Avizkf, pra-sf c. 2 (On the stage) prayuj 7 A, 10, aBinI 1 P; See Act. [Exhibit]er s. pradarSakaH, prakASakaH. [Exhibit]ion, s. pradarSanaM, vyaMjanaM, AvizkaraRaM, &c. 2 vfttisADanaM, vftti f. 3 aBinayaH, AvirBAvaH. [Exhibit]ioner, s. vfttiBuj m.

EXHIBIT: (1) darSayati, pra-, ut-, (c. of dfS): v. To shew;(2) prakawayati (nomi.) or prakawIkaroti, discharged the magician who had e. ed skill: prakawIkftapAwavaM vidyeSvaraM visasarja, D.;(3) vyaYjayati (c. of aYj), e. ing your good fortune: sOmAgyaM te vyaYjayantI, Me.
EXHIBIT (subs.): nidarSanam (?).

To EXHIBIT , v. a. dfS in caus. (darSayati -yituM), pradfS, prakAS in caus. (-kASayati -yituM), sUc (c. 10. sUcayati -yituM), vyaktIkf, prakawIkf, prAduzkf, Avizkf, vyaYj (c. 7. -anakti -aMktuM, c. 10. -aYjayati -yituM), nirdiS (c. 6. -diSati -dezwuM), pradiS, prasf in caus. (-sArayati -yituM), Ahf in caus. (-hArayati -yituM), pratyakzIkf.
EXHIBITED , p. p. darSitaH -tA -taM, prakASitaH -tA -taM, vyaktIkftaH -tA -taM.
EXHIBITER , s. darSakaH, darSayitA m. (tf), pradarSakaH, prakASakaH, nirdezwA m. (zwf).
EXHIBITION: I Display:(1) darSanam, pra-,(2) prakawIkaraRam.II A show: pradarSanI (?).III A scholarship: vfttiH, (or fully) CAtravfttiH.

EXHIBITION , s. darSanaM, pradarSanaM, prakASanaM, nirdeSaH, sUcanaM, vyaktIkaraRaM, vyaYjanaM, vyaktiH f., vivaraRaM, prakawIkaraRaM, prAduzkaraRaM, AvizkaraRaM, prakASIkaraRaM, prekzaRaM. — (Maintenance in the university) rAja- vidyAlaye vfttiH f.
EXHIBITIONER: (1) vfttiBuj (mfn.);(2) CAtravftti- Bogin (f. nI).
EXHIBITIONER , s. rAjavidyAlaye vfttiBAk m. (j) or vfttiBuk m. (j).
EXHILARATE: ullAsayati (c. of las): v. To cheer, delight.

To EXHILARATE , v. a. hfz in caus. (harzayati -yituM), prahfz, parihfz, hlAd in caus. (hlAdayati -yituM), AhlAd, prahlAd, nanda in caus. (nandayati -yituM), aBinand; mud in caus. (modayati -yituM), pramud, ullas in caus. (-lAsayati -yituM), mad in caus. (mAdayati, madayati -yituM), ram in caus. (ramayati -yituM).
EXHILARATED , p. p. praharzitaH -tA -taM, AnanditaH -tA -taM, pramuditaH -tA -taM.
EXHILARATING (adj.): (1) ullAsin (f. nI), sam-; (2) ullAsakaraH (rI, raM).
EXHILARATING , a. praharzakaH -kA -kaM, AnandakArI -riRI -ri (n).
EXHILARATION: ullAsaH: v. Cheerfulness, de- -light.
EXHILARATION , s. harzaH, praharzaH, AnandaH, prahlAdaH, AhlAdaH, pramodaH, ullAsaH, praPullatA, cittaprasannatA, mAdaH, pramadaH.

Exhort, v. t. sotsukaM yAc 1 A or prArT 10 A, upa-diS 6 P, anu-SAs 2 P, pra-saM-buD c. 2 A-samA-Svas c., protsah c., pra-cud 10, pravft c., udyuj 10. [Exhort]ation, s. upadeSaH, upadeSavacanaM, sotsukaprArTanA, praboDanavAkyaM. 2 protsAhanaM, preraRaM, pracodanaM, uttejanaM, praboDanaM, samASvAsanaM, pravartanaM. [Exhort]ative, [Exhort]atory, a. praboDaka, upadeSaka. [Exhort]er, s. upadeSakaH, praboDakaH.
EXHORT (v.): protsAhayati (c. of sah): v. To incite, advise.

To EXHORT , v. a. (Advise) upadiS (c. 6. -diSati -dezWuM), prabuD (c. 10. -boDayati -yituM), pradiS (c. 10. -deSayati -yituM), mantraRAM dA. — (Ani- -mate) ASvas in caus. (-SvAsayati -yituM), samASvas. — (Instigate) utsah in caus. (-sAhayati -yituM), protsah, samutsah, cud (c. 10. codayati -yituM), pracud, cezw in caus. (cezwayati -yituM), pravft in caus. (-varttayati -yituM), prayuj (c. 10. -yojayati -yituM), udyuj, protsf in caus. (-sArayati -yituM), Ih in caus. (Ihayati -yituM).
EXHORTATION: protsAhaH, -nam: v. Incitement, advice.
EXHORTATION , s. upadeSaH, upadeSavAkyaM, praboDanaM, pracodanaM, praboDavAkyaM, [Page247-a+ 51] mantraRaM -RA, pravarttakavAkyaM, vinayavAkyaM, protsAhaH -hanaM, pravarttanaM, prayojanaM, preraRA.
EXHORTATIVE, EXHORTATORY: (1) by comp.; (2) protsAhaka (f. hikA).
EXHORTATIVE , EXHORTATORY, a. upadeSakaH -kA -kaM, praboDakaH -kA -kaM, pracodanaH -nA -naM.
EXHORTED , p. p. praboDitaH -tA -taM, pracoditaH -tA -taM, upadizwaH -zwA -zwaM.
EXHORTER: protsAhakaH: v. Inciter, adviser.
EXHORTER , s. upadezwA m. (zwf), upadeSI m. (n), pracodakaH, pravarttakaH, prayojakaH, protsAhakaH, utsAhahetukaH, prerakaH.
EXHUMATION: utKananam: e. of a corpse: SavotKananam.
EXHUMATION , s. SavotKananaM, mftaSarIrotKananaM.
Exhume, v. t. (SavaM) utKan 1 P. [Exhum]ation, s. utKananaM.
EXHUME (v.): utKanati, pra-, (Kan, c. 1.).
To EXHUME , v. a. SavaM or mftaSarIram utKan (c. 1. -Kanati -nituM).
EXHUMED , p. p. utKAtaH -tA -taM, protKAtaH -tA -taM, SmaSAnavahizkftaH -tA -taM.

Exigence, [Exigen]cy, s. AvaSyakatvaM, aparihAryatvaM, avaSyaprayojanaM-kAryaM. 2 avasaraH, prastAvaH, samayaH, kAlaH. 3 Apad-vipad f., saMkawa-kazwa-samayaH-kAlaH, vipatsamayaH, kfcCraM-kazwaH-zwaM, durgati f. Exigent ([Exig]eant), a. aparihArya, AvaSyaka.
EXIGENCE, EXIGENCY: e. of business: kAryagOravam; “in the present e. of affairs:” vartamAne kAryasaMkawe; in this e.: asmin kfcCe: v. Urgency, import- -ance, crisis.

EXIGENCE , EXIGENCY, s. (Urgent need) prayojanaM, avaSyakatA, Ava- -SyakatvaM, kAryyavaSaH, — (Occasion) avasaraH, samayaH, prastAvaH. — (Dis- -tress) Apad f., vipad f., vipattiH f.; ‘according to the exi- -gency,’ yaTAprayojanaM, prayojanavat, arTavat, yaTAsamayaM, yaTAvasaraM, prastAvasadfSaM; ‘in this exigency,’ iha samaye.
EXIGENT (adj.): gurutaraH (rA, raM) (= very impor- -tant).
Exiguous, a. tanu, alpa.

Exile, v. t. pra-nir-vi-vas c., pra-vraj c., (svadeSAt) niHsf c., apAkf 8 U, bahizkf. s. vi-pra-vAsaH-sanaM, pravrAjanaM. 2 pravrajanaM, dUrasaMsTiti f., vivAsanaviDiH; ‘to go into e(xile)’ pravraj 1 P.
EXILE (subs.): I Banishment: q. v.: nirvAsanam. II The person e. d: nirvAsitaH or vivAsitaH or pravrAjitaH (tA, taM).
EXILE (v.): nirvAsayati (c. of vas): v. To banish.

EXILE , s. pravAsaH -sanaM, vivAsaH -sanaM, nirvAsanaM, vipravAsaH -sanaM, udvAsaH -sanaM, pravrAjanaM, gfhaBaNgaH, svadeSAd dUrIBAvaH or nirasanaM or nirAkaraRaM, dUrasaMsTAnaM; ‘the person exiled,’ pravAsI m. (n), vipravAsI m.

To EXILE , v. a. vivas in caus. (-vAsayati -yituM), pravas, nirvas, vipravas; pravraj in caus. (-vrAjayati -yituM), svadeSAd vahizkf or nirAkf or dUrIkf or niras (c. 4. -asyati -asituM) or apAnud (c. 6. -nudati -nottuM) or niHsf in caus. (-sArayati -yituM), deSAntarIkf.
EXILED , p. p. pravAsitaH -tA -taM, vivAsitaH -tA -taM, svadeSadUrIkftaH -tA -taM.

Exist, v. i. BU 1 P, vft 1 A, vid 4 A, as 2 P; jan 4 A, utpad 4 A. 2 jIv 1 P, prAR 2 P. 3 sTA 1 P, pravft, As 2 A. [Exist]ence, s. asTitvaM, sattA, sattvaM, avasTA, BAvaH, sadBAvaH, saMBavaH, vartanaM. 2 jIvitaM, jIvanaM, vftti f., prARa-asu-DAraRaM; ‘worldly e(xistence)’ saMsAraH, BavaH. [Exist]ent, a. sat, vidyamAna, vartamAna, jIvin; ‘self-e(xistent)’ AtmaBUH, svayaMBUH.

EXIST: I To be: q. v.: asti (as, c. 2.), everybody would believe that he does not e.: sarvo loko nAyamastIti pratIyAt, S.;(2) vartate (vft, c. 1.), H.II To live, remain: q. v.: tizWati, ava-, (sTA, c. 1.).

To EXIST , v. n. (Be) as (c. 2. asti), BU (c. 1. Bavati -vituM), samBU, vft (c. 1. varttate -rttituM), pravft, vid in pass. (vidyate), jan (c. 4. jAyate), utpad (c. 4. -padyate -pattuM). — (Live) jIv (c. 1. jIvati -vituM), prAR (c. 2. prARiti -tuM, rt. an). — (Remain) sTA (c. 1. tizWati, sTAtuM), vft, As (c. 2. Aste).
EXISTENCE: (1) astitvam (as opposed to non-e.), e. of God: brahmAstitvam, S.;(2) avasTAnam or sTitiH (= continuance), birth, e. and destruction: janma- sTitinASAH, S.;(3) jIvanam (= life: q. v.).

EXISTENCE , s. jIvanaM, jIvitaM, jIvaH -vA, vfttiH f., varttanaM, BavaH, BAvaH, samBavaH, vfttitA, asti ind., sattvaM, sattA, prARaparigrahaH, prARaDAraRaM, asuDAraRaM, niSvasanapraSvasanaM, sadBAvaH, avasTA, sTitiH f.
EXISTENT: vartamAnaH (nA, naM). To be e.: v. To exist.
EXISTENT , a. jIvI -vinI -vi (n), jIvan -vantI -vat (t), varttamAnaH -nA -naM, vidyamAnaH -nA -naM, varttizRuH -zRuH -zRu, BavizRuH -zRuH -zRu, Driya- mARaH -RA -RaM, san satI sat (t).
Exit, s. nizkramaH-maRaM, niryARaM; apakramaH, apagamaH, nirgamaH. 2 (In dramas) nizkrAMta a.; ‘exeunt omnes’ nizkrAMtAH sarve.
EXIT: (1) nizkramaH;(2) nirgamaH;(3) niryARam. E. (in drama) nizkrAntaH (ntA, ntaM). Exeunt (pl.) or e. omnes: nizkrAntAH sarve, Y.
EXIT , s. nizkramaH -maRaM, nirgamaH, vinirgamaH, niryARaM, nizkrAntiH f., apagamaH, apakramaH -maRaM, apayAnaM. — (In dramatic language) nizkrAntaH -ntA -ntaM.
Exodus, s. nirgamaH, bahirgamanaM.
EXODUS: (1) niryARam, e. of the Jews: *ihudInAM niryARam;(2) nirgamaH, -Ram.
Ex-officio, adv. aDikAravaSAt.
Exonerate, v. t. Exculpate, q. v. 2 BAraM apanI 1 P or avatF c.
EXONERATE: SoDayati (c. of SuD): v. To ex- -culpate.

To EXONERATE , v. a. (Unload) BArAd muc (c. 6. muYcati, moktuM) or vimuc; BAram utF in caus. (-tArayati -yituM) or apanI (c. 1. -nayati -netuM), nirBAraM -rAM -raM kf. — (Clear) SuD (c. 10. SoDayati -yituM), viSuD; dozAd muc, nirdozaM -zAM -zaM kf.
EXONERATED , p. p. BAramuktaH -ktA -ktaM, dozamuktaH -ktA -ktaM, viSoDitaH -tA -taM.
Exorable, a. anuneya, prasAdanIya, sAMtvanIya; ‘not e(xorable)’ niranukroSa.
EXORABLE: (1) anuneyaH (yA, yaM);(2) prasAdanIyaH (yA, yaM);(3) or by circumlo., he is e.: sa anunayaM gfhRAti or prasAdayituM SakyaH.
EXORABLE , a. varadaH -dA -daM, suprasAditaH -tA -taM, sAntvanIyaH -yA -yaM.
EXORBITANCE , EXORBITANCY, s. aparimitatvaM, amaryyAdA, maryyAdAtikramaH, nirmADyasTyaM, amADyasTaM, amitatvaM, ADikyaM, AtirekyaM, aDikatA, udrekaH, vEzamyaM, utkramaH.
Exorbitant, a. amaryAda, amita, aparimita, atirikta, sAtiSaya, atimAtra, atyaDika, See Excessive. Exhorbitance, [Exhorbitan]cy, s. atirekaH, maryAdAtikramaH, udrekaH, ADikyaM.
EXORBITANT: atyaDikaH (kA, kaM): v. Excessive, extravagant.

EXORBITANT , a. aparimitaH -tA -taM, amitaH -tA -taM, atimaryyAdaH -dA -daM, amaryyAdaH -dA -daM, atimAtraH -trA -traM, atiriktaH -ktA -ktaM, udriktaH -ktA -ktaM, amaDyasTaH -sTA -sTaM, nirmaDyasTaH -sTA -sTaM, utkrAntamaryyAdaH -dA -daM, aDikaH -kA -kaM, vizamaH -mA -maM.
EXORBITANTLY: atyaDikam: v. Excessively.
EXORBITANTLY , adv. aparimitaM, atimaryyAdaM, atimAtraM, vizamaM.

details.body: Exorcise, v. i. (BUtaM) dUrIkf 8 U, niHsf c., BUtAveSAd muc c. Exorcism, s. BUtApasAraRaM.
EXORCISE: (1) BUtaM dUrIkaroti;(2) BUtAveSAt moca- yati (muc, c. 10.).
To EXORCISE , v. a. BUtopahatajanAt SapanamantrAdinA BUtam apasf in [Page247-b+ 51] caus. (-sArayati -yituM), amukajanaM tyaktvA dUram apEhi iti SapaTapUrvvaM BUtaM vad (c. 1. vadati -dituM).

Exponent, s. (In mathematics) GAtacihaM. a. prakASaka, dyotaka.

(= to take), grain should not be e. ed during famine: durBikze DAnyaM deSAntaraM na neyam, K. b.;(2) videSe or deSAntare prerayati (Ir, c. 10.) (= to send);(3) nirharati (hf, c. 1.) (rare), to e. contraband (articles): pratizidDAni nirharati, M.

(Goods to a foreign country) bARijyadravyARi or vastUni videSe or deSAntare or vahirdeSe vah (c. 1. vahati, voQuM or caus. vAhayati -yituM) or Avah or upavah or nirvivah or tF in caus. (tArayati -yituM) or santF in caus. or AnI (c. 1. -nayati -netuM or caus. -nAyayati -yituM) or upanI or prer (c. 10. -Irayati -yituM).

EXPORTATION , s. deSAntare or vahirdeSe vAhanaM or upavAhanaM or aBivAhyaM or tAraRaM or preraRaM.
EXPORTED , p. p. videSe or vahirdeSe vAhitaH -tA -taM or tAritaH -tA -taM or santAritaH -tA -taM or preritaH -tA -taM, deSAntarIkftaH -tA -taM.
EXPORTS (subs.): deSAntaranItAni dravyARi; nirhfta- dravyARi (?).
EXPORTS , s. pl. videSe or vahirdeSe vAhyAni bARijyadravyARi or vastUni.

Expose, v. t. (lit.) ucCad 10, upA-vf 5 U, vivastrIkf 8 U, prakAS c., pradfS c. 2 vya-ktIkf, pratyakzIkf, Avizkf, satyasvarUpaM Avizkf; See Explain also. 3 (Make liable) padaM nI 1 P or kf 8 U, sTAnaM-AspadaM kf; ‘e(xpos)ed yourself to trouble’ BavatAtmA kleSasya padamupanItaH (S. 1); ‘e(xpos)ed to the charge of cowardice’ kAtara iti vAcyatAM gataH-dozapAtraM jAtaH; ‘e(xpos)ed to hundreds of calamities’ vyasanaSata-SaravyatAmupagatAH (Ka. 107); ‘e(xpose) to contempt’ tiraskArasTAnaM kf; ‘e(xpose) to the sun’ Atape dA 3 U or Suz c., AtapAya ujJ 6 P; ‘e(xpose) for sale’ krayArTaM pra-sf c. [Expos]ed, a. anAcCAdita, anAdfta, &c.; ‘e(xpose)d for sale’ krayya. [Expos]ition, s. vivaraRaM, vyAKyAnaM, prakA-SanaM, spazwIkaraRaM. [Expos]itor, s. vivftikAraH, vftti-kAraH, vyAKyAtf m., arTaprakASakaH. [Expos]ure, s. vivfti f., pradarSanaM, prakASanaM, vyaktIkaraRaM, svarUpAvizkaraRaM ‘e(xposure) to heat’ AtapalaMGanaM; (S. 3).

EXPOSE (v.): I To lay out, disclose: vivfRoti (vf, c. 5.), you have e. d your heart from rapture: tvayAtiharzAdvivfto'ntarAtmA, B.II To explain: q. v.: vivfRoti.III To shew: q. v.: darSayati (c. of dfS).IV To put: q. v.: dadAti (dA, c. 3.). v. To e. a child: apaviDyati (vyaD, c. 4.) D. iv.

To EXPOSE , v. a. (Uncover) vivf (c. 5. -vfRoti -Rute -varituM -rItuM), apavf, apAvf, ucCad (c. 10. -CAdayati -yituM). — (Make public) prakAS (c. 10. -kASayati -yituM), vikAS, prakASIkf, prakawIkf, vyaktIkf, pratyakzIkf, prAduzkf, Avizkf. — (Expose to view) pratyakzIkf, sarvvadf- -ggocaraM -rAM -raM kf. — (For sale) paRyavITikAyAM prasf in caus. (-sArayati -yituM)). — (Make liable) aDInaM -nAM -naM kf. — (To the air) vAyuvyAppaM -ppAM -ppaM kf. — (To the sun) sUryyavyAptaM -ptAM -ptaM kf. (To contempt, ridicule) avamAnAspadaM kf, avahAsasTAnaM kf, hAsyaM -syAM -syaM kf. — (To danger) BayasTAnaM kf, SaNkAspadaM kf; ‘to ex- -pose the failings of others,’ paraCidrARi vivf or apavf.

EXPOSED , p. p. vivftah -tA -taM, apAvftaH -tA -taM, anAvftaH -tA -taM, [Page250-b+ 51] anAcCAditaH -tA -taM, prakASIkftaH -tA -taM, prakawIkftaH -tA -taM, prasAritaH -tA -taM; ‘caught out in a crime,’ dfzwadozaH -zA -zaM; ‘exposed to the weather,’ aBrAvakASikaH -kI -kaM; ‘exposed for sale,’ kraye prasAritaH -tA -taM, krayyaH -yyA -yyaM, paRyaH -RyA -RyaM, paRyavITikAyAM prasAritaH -tA -taM.
EXPOSITION: (1) vivfti:(2) vyAKyA (= expla- -nation: q. v.).
EXPOSITION , s. vivftiH f., vivaraRaM, vyAKyA -KyAnaM, spazwIkaraRaM, prakASanaM, vyAkftiH f., vyAkaraRaM, vyaktIkaraRaM, cUrRaka.
EXPOSITOR: vivftikAraH: v. Explainer.
EXPOSITOR , s. vyAKyAtA m. (tf), prakASakaH, pravaktA m. (ktf), arTapariSoDakaH, arTavijYApakaH, cUrRikft m.
EXPOSITORY: Ph.: e. index: sUcipatram.
EXPOSITORY , a. vAcakaH -kA -kaM, prakASakaH -kA -kaM, uddeSakaH -kA -kaM.

sanskrit.word: नैतत् त्वया करणीयम् इत्यादिवाक्यैर् अन्यायकारिणा सह विचर्
sanskrit.iast: naitat tvayā karaṇīyam ityādivākyair anyāyakāriṇā saha vicar

details.body: Expostulate, v. i. pratyAdiS 6 P, (apa-TAt) vyAvft c., nivArayituM-niyaMtuM udyam 1 P or prayat 1 A; See Dissuade. [Expostulat]ion, s. pratyAdeSaH, nivartanavAkyaM, nizeDaH, nivA-raRaM, praboDavacanaM.
EXPOSTULATE: tarkayati (tark, c. 10.): v. To remonstrate, reason.

To EXPOSTULATE , v. a. ApattiM kf, anyAyena or asamyak or anucitaM karozi or anyAyyakarmma tvayA kftam ityAdinindAvAkyEr akftyakAriRaM kaYcijjanaM nivf in caus. (-vArayati -yituM), mEvaM kArzIH or mEvaM kfTAH or nEtat tvayA karaRIyam ityAdivAkyEr anyAyakAriRA saha vicar (c. 10. carayati -yituM) or anyAyyakarmmaRaH kaYcijjanaM nivft in caus. (-varttayati -yituM), pratyAdiS (c. 6. -diSati -dezwuM).
EXPOSTULATION: virudDatarkaH: v. Remonstrance, dissuasion.

EXPOSTULATION , s. ApattiH f., anyAyyakarmma or asamyakkarmma or ayuktakarmma karozi or kukarmma tvayA kftam ityAdinindArTakaM vAkyaM or ityAdivAkyEr anyAyakAriRA saha vicAraRaM, nivarttanArTaM vAkyaM, nizeDArTakaM praboDavAkyaM, prativAdaH, pratyAdeSaH.
EXPOSTULATORY: virudDatarkamayaH (yI, yaM) (?).
EXPOSTULATORY , a. ApattimayaH -yI -yaM, nindAmayaH -yI -yaM, pratyAdeSakaH -kA -kaM.

EXPOUND (v.): vivfRoti (vf, c. 5.), it has been e. ed in Tatvakaumudi: vivftaM tattvakOmudyAm, D. s.: v. To explain.

Express, a. vyakta, sPuwa, parisPuwa, suprakASa, BinnArTa, asaMdigDa; ‘in e(xpress) terms’ BinnArTaM, spazwaM. 2 viSizwa. s. (Messenger) jaMGA-kArikaH, jAMGikaH. 2 jaMGAlaH, atijavaH, pra-javin-vegin m., javanaH, tvaritaH, tarasvin m. v. t. vyaMj 7 P or c., Avizkf 8 U, pradfS c., sUc 10, dyut c., prakawIkf, nirdiS 6 P, lakz 10, prakawayati (D.). 2 vac 2 P, uccar c., udIr c. kaT 10, SaMs 1 P, vad 1 P, udAhf 1 P, vyAhf, A-ni-vid c., KyA 2 P, prakAS c., buD c., jYA c. (jYApayati), aBi-DA 3 U; ‘e(xpress) oneself’ mano-gataM SaMs, vAcaM udIr; ‘e(xpress) by gesticulation’ naw 10, nirUp 10, sUc, aBinI 1 P. 3 nizpIq 10, nizkfz 1 P, nirduh 2 U, nirhf 1 P. [Express]ion, s. vyaMjanaM, prakASanaM, boDanaM, A-ni-vedanaM, jYApanaM, AvizkaraRaM, kaTanaM, udAhAraH-haraRaM, KyApanaM. 2 nizpIqanaM, nizkarzaRaM. 3 vadanaM, AsyaM; ‘he had a smiling e(xpression)’ hAsyavadana AsIt; ‘wore an angry e(xpression)’ kupita iva baBO. 4 vacanaM, ukti f.; vAkyaM, padaM, SabdaH, vacas n., vAc f.; ‘authoritative e(xpression)’ AptavacanaM, pramARaM. 5 rIti f., mArgaH, padDati-saraRi f. [Express]ly, adv. spazwaM, vyaktaM, parisPuwaM, BinnArTaM. [Express]ive, a. vyaMjaka, vAcaka, sUcaka, dyotaka, aBiDAyaka, gamaka darSaka. 2 sArTa, sAkUta, pUrRArTa, arTavat [Express]ively, adv. sArTaM, sAkUtaM. 2 spazwaM, suvyaktaM BinnArTaM, parisPuwaM, vyaMjakatayA. [Express]iveness, s. vyaMjakatvaM, arTavattA, sAkUtatA.

EXPRESS (v. t.): I To press out of:(1) nizkarzati (kfz, c. 1.);(2) nizpIqya gfhRAti (grah, c. 9.). II To indicate, exhibit: q. v.: vyanakti (aYj, c. 7.), your interview e. es worthiness: BavadIya- darSanaM yogyatAM vyanakti, Si.; or it e. es “you are saying false”: aTavA miTyA vadasIti vyajyate, Kav. III To denote: q. v.: vakti (vac, c. 2.), here the word beast is intended to e. illiberal: atra jantupadamadAtaryarTe vivakzitam, Kav.IV To declare, speak: q. v.: vakti, what he was [Page259] about to e.: vivakzitAM giram, Si.V To send: q. v.: visfjati (sfj, c. 6.).VI To represent: q. v.
EXPRESS (adj.): I Explict, plain: q. v.: spazwaH (zwA, zwaM).II Special: viSizwaH (zwA, zwaM), e. messenger: viSizwavArtAvAhakaH.
EXPRESS (subs.): I A courier: jaNGAkarikaH.II An e. train: *viSizwayAnAvaliH.

To EXPRESS , v. a. (Press out) nizpIq (c. 10. -pIqayati -yituM), nipIq, nizkfz (c. 1. -karzati -krazwuM), nirhf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM), nirduh (c. 2. -dogDi -gDuM). — (Utter, declare) vad (c. 1. vadati -dituM), kaT (c. 10. kaTayati -yituM), udAhf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM), vyAhf, uccar (c. 10. -cAra- yati -yituM), jYA in caus. (jYApayati -yituM), vijYA, Avid in caus. (-vedayati -yituM), kFt (c. 10. kIrttayati -yituM), prakAS (c. 10. -kASa- -yati -yituM), sUc (c. 10. sUcayati -yituM), buD (c. 10. boDayati -yituM). — (Represent, exhibit) sUc, dfS in caus. (darSayati -yituM); ‘by gestures, &c.,’ naw (c. 10. nAwayati -yituM), aBinI (c. 10. -nayati -netuM), rUp (c. 10. rUpayati -yituM); ‘they express love,’ SfNgAraBAvaM nAwayanti; ‘he expresses delight,’ harzaM nAwayati; ‘in painting, &c.,’ pratirUpaM kf, pratimUrttiM kf, pratimAnaM kf. — (Indicate) sUc, uddiS (c. 6. -diSati -dezwuM), nirdiS, lakz (c. 10. lakzayati -yituM).

EXPRESS , s. (Courier) vegI m. (n), prajavI m. (n), javI m., tarasvI m. (n), udvegaH, tvaritaH, cavanaH, javaH, DAvakaH, aDvagaH, vArDAharaH.
EXPRESSED , p. p. (In words) uktaH -ktA -ktaM, kaTitaH -tA -taM, AveditaH -tA -taM, aBihitaH -tA -taM. — (Shewn indicated) darSitaH -tA -taM, [Page251-a+ 51] sUcitaH -tA -taM.
EXPRESSIBLE: I What can be declared:(1) kaTanIyaH (yA, yaM);(2) AKyeyaH (yA, yaM).II What can be squeezed: nizkarzaRIyaH (yA, yaM).
EXPRESSIBLE , a. kaTanIyaH -yA -yaM, kaTyaH -TyA -TyaM, nirvacanIyaH -yA -yaM, AKyeyaH -yA -yaM. — (To be pressed out) nizkarzaRIyaH -yA -yaM, nirharaRIyaH -yA -yaM.

EXPRESSION: I Pressing out:(1) nizkarzaRam; (2) nizpIqya grahaRam.II Declaration:(1) kaTanam; (2) sTApanam.III Significance: indication: vyaYjanam.IV Look: q. v.V Phrase: vAkyam, here the fault is of e.: atra vAkyasyEva dozaH, Kav. VI In arith: rASiH.

EXPRESSION , s. (Declaration) vAdaH, kaTanaM, jYApanaM, vijYApanaM, KyApanaM, AvedanaM, aBiDAnaM, boDanaM, kIrttanaM, pravacanaM. — (Utterance) udAharaRaM, vyAharaRaM, uccAraRaM. — (Phrase, word) uktiH f., vAkyaM, vacanaM, uktaM, vAk f. (c), SabdaH, aBiDeyaM, vacaH n. (s), padaM; ‘authorized ex- -pression,’ AptoktiH. — (Style, manner) rItiH f., mArgaH, vyApAraH; ‘style of expression,’ vAgvyApAraH. — (Feeling, tone) rasaH.

EXPRESSIVE: I Lit.:(1) vyaYjakaH (f. YjikA) (= indicative), e. of shame: vrIqAvyaYjakaH, Kav.; (2) vAcakaH (f. cikA) (= denoting), day is not e. of light: dinamiti prakASamayamitTarTe'vAcakam, Kav. II Significant: q. v. arTavat (f. tI).

EXPRESSIVELY , adv. pUrRArTatas, vyaktArTatas, sArTaM, sAkUtaM, sagOravaM.

EXPRESSIVENESS , s. vAcakatvaM, pUrRArTatvaM, arTavattvaM, sArTatvaM, gOravaM.
EXPRESSLY: (1) spazwam;(2) BinnArTam: v. Expli- -citly, plainly.

To EXPROBATE , v. a. nind (c. 1. nindati -ndituM), garh (c. 1. garhate -rhituM), vigarh, kuts (c. 10. kutsayati -yituM), upAlaB (c. 1. -laBate -labGuM), tiraskf.
EXPROBATION , s. nindA, garhA, tiraskAraH, durvAkyaM, BartsanavAkyaM, upakroSaH.
EXPUGN: vijayate (ji, c. 1.): v. To conquer.
To EXPUGN , v. a. durgaMlaNG (c. 10. laNGayati -yituM), viji (c. 1. -jayate -ti -jetuM).
EXPUGNABLE , a. laNGanIyaH -yA -yaM, AkramaRIyaH -yA -yaM, vijetavyaH -vyA -vyaM.
EXPUGNATION , s. durgalaNGanaM, durgAkramaRaM, vijayaH, jayaH.
EXPUGNER: jetf (f. trI) vi-: v. Conqueror.
EXPULSION: (1) nirasanam;(2) niHsAraRam;(3) nirvAsanam.

Expunge, v. t. vi-, lup c., vyA-apa-mfj 2 P or c., vyAmfS 6 P or c., ucCid 7 P, vinaS c. Expunction, s. vi-, lopaH, vyAmarzaH, ucCedaH, nASaH.
EXPUNGE: unmArzwi or mArjayati (mfj, c. 2. and 10.): v. To blot out, erase.

Expurgate, v. t. pU 9 U, SuD c., pavitrIkf 8 U. [Expurgat]ion, s. pAvanaM, SoDanaM. [Expurgat]ory, a. pAvaka-na.
EXPURGATE: punAti (pU, c. 9.): v. To purge, purify.

Eye, s. cakzus n., vi-, locanaM, netraM, nayanaM, akzi n., dfS f., dfzwi f., IkzaRaM-RA, dfSA. 2 (View) dfzwi f.; ‘in the e(ye)s of the public’ lokadfzwyA. 3 raMDraM, CidraM. 4 Bud, q. v.; ‘corners of the e(ye)’ apAMgaH-gaM, na-yanopAMtaH; ‘mindʼs e(ye)’ jYAnacakzus n., manomayaM jYAnaM; ‘before oneʼs e(ye)s’ samakzaM, sA-kzAt, pratyakzaM-kzataH; oft. by paSyat; ‘before my very e(ye)s’ paSyatopi mama; ‘in my e(ye)s’ mama dfzwyA, mAM prati. v. t. nirIkz 1 A, A-ava-lok 1 A, 10, dfS 1 P; See See, ‘e(ye) pupil’ tArA, kanInikA, tA-rakA; ‘e(ye) beam’ nayana-dfzwi-pAtaH; ‘e(ye)-drop’ netrajalaM, bAzpAbaduH, aSru n.; ‘e(ye)-brow’ BrUH, BrUlatA; ‘e(ye)-glass’ upanetraM-nayanaM; ‘e(ye)-lash’ pakzman n.; ‘e(ye)-let, e(ye)-hole’ gavAMkzaH, CidraM, raMDraM; ‘e(ye)-lid’ netra-nayana-cCadaH; ‘e(ye) reach (shot)’ cakzurvi-zayaH, nayanagocaraH-raM, dfkpaTaH; ‘e(ye)-sore’ akziSUlaM, cakzuHpIqA; akzigataH, dvezyaH; ‘I am an e(ye) sore to him’ akzigatohamasya; ‘e(ye)-wink’ nayanasaMjYA-saMketaH, kawAkzaH, ‘e(ye)-witness’ pratyakzasAkzin m., darSin m., sAkzAd drazwf m. [Eye]less, a. cakzurhIna, anayana, dfzwivikala. 2 acCidra.

EYE (subs.): (1) cakzuH, have divine e.s in seeing others' fault: paradozekzaRadivyacakzuzaH, Si.; where a king places his e.: yasmin pArTivaScakzurAropayati, P.; (2) locanam, vi-, shut the e.s never to open again (i.e. died): apunarunmIlanAya nimimIla locane, C.; pass with e.s shut: locane mIlayitvA gamaya, Me.; (3) netram, the observed of hundreds of e.s: netraSatEka- lakzyaH (kzyA, kzyaM), R.;(4) nayanam, his e. fell on her e.s: asya tasyA nayanayugale nipapAta cakzuH, K.; (5) akzi (n.), the thousand-e.d. (Indra): sahasrAkzaH; the external coat of the e.: akzRayorbAhya pawalam, [Page262] Bha.;(6) dfS (f), all the fine -e.d (companions) drunk him with (their) e.s: amuM dfSA papustAH sudfSaH samastAH, N. Blind of one e.: kARaH (RA, RaM). The outer corner of the e.:(1) apANgaH;(2) nayanopAntaH. Before the e.s of:(1) samakzaM or pratyakzam (with gen. or absol.), before the e.s of kings: pratyakzaM kzmApatInAm, Ve.;(2) by gen. or loc. of paSyat (f. ntI) before my e.s: paSyato me or paSyati mayi.
EYE (v.): nirIkzate (Ikz, c. 1.): v. To see.
